```cc
#include "reshade_texture_pool.hh"

#include "format.hh"
#include "image.hh"
#include "logger.hh"
#include "util.hh"
#include "vk_handle.hh"

#include <stdexcept>

namespace VkHook
{
    namespace
    {
        VkImageView createView(LogicalDevice* logicalDevice, VkImage image, VkFormat format,
                               VkImageViewType viewType, uint32_t mipLevels)
        {
            // The vector-based view helpers allocate twice for a single view.
            // Keep this fixed-size creation on the stack, with the same defaults.
            VkImageViewCreateInfo info = {};
            info.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO;
            info.image = image;
            info.viewType = viewType;
            info.format = format;
            info.subresourceRange.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
            info.subresourceRange.levelCount = mipLevels;
            info.subresourceRange.layerCount = 1;
            // Mutable images also support storage through their UNORM view.
            // sRGB formats cannot inherit that storage-image usage.
            VkImageViewUsageCreateInfo usage = {};
            if (isSRGB(format))
            {
                usage.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_USAGE_CREATE_INFO;
                usage.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
                if (viewType != VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D)
                    usage.usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
                info.pNext = &usage;
            }
            VkImageView view = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            const VkResult result = logicalDevice->vkd.CreateImageView(logicalDevice->device, &info, nullptr, &view);
            if (result != VK_SUCCESS || view == VK_NULL_HANDLE)
                throw std::runtime_error("ReShade shared texture view creation failed: " + std::to_string(result));
            return view;
        }

        std::string describe(const ReshadeTextureDesc& desc)
        {
            return std::to_string(desc.extent.width) + "x" + std::to_string(desc.extent.height) + "x"
                + std::to_string(desc.extent.depth) + " format=" + std::to_string(desc.format)
                + " mips=" + std::to_string(desc.mipLevels) + " viewType=" + std::to_string(desc.viewType);
        }
    }

    bool ReshadeTextureDesc::operator==(const ReshadeTextureDesc& other) const noexcept
    {
        return extent.width == other.extent.width && extent.height == other.extent.height
            && extent.depth == other.extent.depth && format == other.format
            && mipLevels == other.mipLevels && viewType == other.viewType;
    }

    ReshadeTexture::ReshadeTexture(LogicalDevice* logicalDevice, const ReshadeTextureDesc& description)
        : desc(description), device(logicalDevice->device), destroyImage(logicalDevice->vkd.DestroyImage),
          destroyImageView(logicalDevice->vkd.DestroyImageView), freeMemory(logicalDevice->vkd.FreeMemory)
    {
        try
        {
            VkImageUsageFlags usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT
                | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
            if (desc.viewType != VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D)
                usage |= VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
            image = createSingleImage(logicalDevice, desc.extent, desc.format, usage,
                                      VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT, memory, desc.mipLevels);
            if (image == VK_NULL_HANDLE || memory == VK_NULL_HANDLE)
                throw std::runtime_error("ReShade shared texture image allocation failed");

            const VkFormat unormFormat = convertToUNORM(desc.format);
            const VkFormat srgbFormat = convertToSRGB(desc.format);
            unormView = createView(logicalDevice, image, unormFormat, desc.viewType, desc.mipLevels);
            srgbView = srgbFormat == unormFormat ? unormView
                : createView(logicalDevice, image, srgbFormat, desc.viewType, desc.mipLevels);
            unormRenderView = desc.mipLevels == 1 ? unormView
                : createView(logicalDevice, image, unormFormat, desc.viewType, 1);
            srgbRenderView = srgbFormat == unormFormat ? unormRenderView
                : desc.mipLevels == 1 ? srgbView
                : createView(logicalDevice, image, srgbFormat, desc.viewType, 1);

            changeImageLayout(logicalDevice, {image}, desc.mipLevels);
        }
        catch (...)
        {
            // A throwing constructor has no destructor, and initialization may
            // already have submitted GPU work. Use the same deferred ownership.
            deferRelease();
            throw;
        }
    }

    ReshadeTexture::~ReshadeTexture()
    {
        deferRelease();
    }

    void ReshadeTexture::deferRelease()
    {
        auto& queue = DeferredDestroyQueue::instance();
        if (image != VK_NULL_HANDLE)
            queue.push(DestroyPhase::Resource, [device = device, release = destroyImage, image = image] {
                release(device, image, nullptr);
            });

        // Reverse registration within Resource releases all distinct views
        // before their image, without a heap-allocated deduplication container.
        const VkImageView views[] = {unormView, srgbView, unormRenderView, srgbRenderView};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
        {
            if (views[i] == VK_NULL_HANDLE)
                continue;
            bool duplicate = false;
            for (size_t j = 0; j < i; ++j)
                duplicate |= views[j] == views[i];
            if (!duplicate)
                queue.push(DestroyPhase::Resource, [device = device, release = destroyImageView, view = views[i]] {
                    release(device, view, nullptr);
                });
        }
        if (memory != VK_NULL_HANDLE)
            queue.push(DestroyPhase::Memory, [device = device, release = freeMemory, memory = memory] {
                release(device, memory, nullptr);
            });
    }

    std::shared_ptr<ReshadeTexture> ReshadeTexturePool::acquire(const std::string& uniqueName, const ReshadeTextureDesc& desc)
    {
        const auto found = textures.find(uniqueName);
        if (found != textures.end())
        {
            if (!(found->second->desc == desc))
                throw std::runtime_error("Incompatible shared ReShade texture '" + uniqueName + "': existing "
                                         + describe(found->second->desc) + ", requested " + describe(desc));
            Logger::debug("[reshade-texture-pool] reuse name=" + uniqueName
                          + " image=" + convertToString(found->second->image));
            return found->second;
        }

        auto texture = std::make_shared<ReshadeTexture>(logicalDevice, desc);
        textures.emplace(uniqueName, texture);
        Logger::debug("[reshade-texture-pool] create name=" + uniqueName + " image=" + convertToString(texture->image));
        return texture;
    }
}
```

```hh
#ifndef RESHADE_TEXTURE_POOL_HPP_INCLUDED
#define RESHADE_TEXTURE_POOL_HPP_INCLUDED

#include "vulkan_include.hh"

#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>

namespace VkHook
{
    struct LogicalDevice;

    struct ReshadeTextureDesc
    {
        VkExtent3D extent;
        VkFormat format;
        uint32_t mipLevels;
        VkImageViewType viewType;

        bool operator==(const ReshadeTextureDesc& other) const noexcept;
    };

    struct ReshadeTexture
    {
        ReshadeTexture(LogicalDevice* logicalDevice, const ReshadeTextureDesc& description);
        ~ReshadeTexture();
        ReshadeTexture(const ReshadeTexture&) = delete;
        ReshadeTexture& operator=(const ReshadeTexture&) = delete;

        const ReshadeTextureDesc desc;
        VkImage image = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkDeviceMemory memory = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkImageView unormView = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkImageView srgbView = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkImageView unormRenderView = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkImageView srgbRenderView = VK_NULL_HANDLE;

    private:
        void deferRelease();

        const VkDevice device;
        const PFN_vkDestroyImage destroyImage;
        const PFN_vkDestroyImageView destroyImageView;
        const PFN_vkFreeMemory freeMemory;
    };

    // One pool per effect-chain build. Its strong references preserve producers
    // during construction; consumers retain their own references afterward.
    class ReshadeTexturePool
    {
    public:
        explicit ReshadeTexturePool(LogicalDevice* logicalDevice) : logicalDevice(logicalDevice) {}
        ReshadeTexturePool(const ReshadeTexturePool&) = delete;
        ReshadeTexturePool& operator=(const ReshadeTexturePool&) = delete;

        std::shared_ptr<ReshadeTexture> acquire(const std::string& uniqueName, const ReshadeTextureDesc& desc);

    private:
        LogicalDevice* logicalDevice;
        std::unordered_map<std::string, std::shared_ptr<ReshadeTexture>> textures;
    };
```

```cc
#include <algorithm>

// The headless executable never creates overlay objects. Complete these
// forward-declared owners so LogicalDevice's null unique_ptrs can be destroyed
// without linking the unrelated ImGui renderer.
namespace VkHook
{
    struct OverlayPersistentState {};
    class ImGuiOverlay {};
}

using namespace VkHook;

namespace
{
    int failures = 0;
    int checks = 0;
    uintptr_t nextHandle = 1;
    unsigned imageCalls = 0;
    unsigned viewCalls = 0;
    unsigned initCalls = 0;
    unsigned failView = 0;

    bool failInit = false;
    VkDevice expectedDevice = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImageUsageFlags lastUsage = 0;
    VkExtent3D lastExtent = {};
    VkFormat lastFormat = VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    uint32_t lastMips = 0;

    struct View
    {
        VkImage image;
        VkFormat format;
        VkImageViewType type;
        uint32_t levels;
    };
    std::unordered_map<VkImage, VkDeviceMemory> images;
    std::unordered_map<VkDeviceMemory, bool> memories;
    std::unordered_map<VkImageView, View> views;
    std::unordered_map<VkImage, unsigned> initializations;
    std::vector<char> releases;

    void expect(bool condition, const char* message)
    {
        ++checks;
        if (!condition)
        {
            ++failures;
            std::printf("FAILED: %s\n", message);
        }
    }

    template<class T> T handle()
    {
        if constexpr (std::is_pointer_v<T>)
            return reinterpret_cast<T>(nextHandle++);
        else
            return static_cast<T>(nextHandle++);
    }

    VKAPI_ATTR VkResult VKAPI_CALL createImageView(VkDevice device, const VkImageViewCreateInfo* info,
                                                  const VkAllocationCallbacks*, VkImageView* output)
    {
        expect(device == expectedDevice, "view creation uses owning device");
        expect(images.count(info->image) == 1, "view references a live image");
        expect(info->subresourceRange.baseMipLevel == 0 && info->subresourceRange.baseArrayLayer == 0
                   && info->subresourceRange.layerCount == 1 && info->subresourceRange.aspectMask == VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT,
               "view covers color starting at mip zero");
        ++viewCalls;
        if (failView == viewCalls)
            return VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DEVICE_MEMORY;
        *output = handle<VkImageView>();
        views.emplace(*output, View{info->image, info->format, info->viewType, info->subresourceRange.levelCount});
        return VK_SUCCESS;
    }

    VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL destroyImageView(VkDevice device, VkImageView view, const VkAllocationCallbacks*)
    {
        expect(device == expectedDevice, "view destruction retains device");
        const auto found = views.find(view);
        expect(found != views.end(), "each view destroyed exactly once");
        if (found != views.end())
        {
            expect(images.count(found->second.image) == 1, "view destroyed before its image");
            views.erase(found);
        }
        releases.push_back('v');
    }

    VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL destroyImage(VkDevice device, VkImage image, const VkAllocationCallbacks*)
    {
        expect(device == expectedDevice, "image destruction retains device");
        expect(std::none_of(views.begin(), views.end(), [image](const auto& view) { return view.second.image == image; }),
               "all dependent views destroyed before image");
        const auto found = images.find(image);
        expect(found != images.end(), "each image destroyed exactly once");
        if (found != images.end())
        {
            expect(memories.count(found->second) == 1, "image destroyed before its backing memory");
            images.erase(found);
        }
        releases.push_back('i');
    }

    VKAPI_ATTR void VKAPI_CALL freeMemory(VkDevice device, VkDeviceMemory memory, const VkAllocationCallbacks*)
    {
        expect(device == expectedDevice, "memory destruction retains device");
        expect(std::none_of(images.begin(), images.end(), [memory](const auto& image) { return image.second == memory; }),
               "memory freed after every backed image");
        expect(memories.erase(memory) == 1, "each allocation freed exactly once");
        releases.push_back('m');
    }

    void reset()
    {
        DeferredDestroyQueue::instance().flush();
        expect(images.empty() && memories.empty() && views.empty(), "previous case leaves no live GPU handles");
        imageCalls = viewCalls = initCalls = failView = 0;
        failImage = failInit = false;
        releases.clear();
        initializations.clear();
    }

    void finish(unsigned expectedViews, unsigned expectedImages = 1)
    {
        expect(releases.empty(), "destruction is deferred until flush");
        expect(DeferredDestroyQueue::instance().pending() == expectedViews + 2 * expectedImages,
               "one queued release per distinct owned handle");
        DeferredDestroyQueue::instance().flush();
        expect(images.empty() && memories.empty() && views.empty(), "flush releases every owned handle");
        expect(std::count(releases.begin(), releases.end(), 'v') == expectedViews, "exact view release count");
        expect(std::count(releases.begin(), releases.end(), 'i') == expectedImages, "exact image release count");
        expect(std::count(releases.begin(), releases.end(), 'm') == expectedImages, "exact memory release count");
        const auto count = releases.size();
        DeferredDestroyQueue::instance().flush();
        expect(releases.size() == count && DeferredDestroyQueue::instance().pending() == 0,
               "second flush never repeats destruction");
    }

    const ReshadeTextureDesc standard = {{128, 64, 1}, VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, 4, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D};

    void aliasAndLifetime(LogicalDevice& device)
    {
        reset();
        std::shared_ptr<ReshadeTexture> consumer;
        VkImage producerImage = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        {
            ReshadeTexturePool pool(&device);
            auto producer = pool.acquire("DH_MotionVectors", standard);
            producerImage = producer->image;
            consumer = pool.acquire("DH_MotionVectors", standard);
            expect(consumer == producer && consumer->image == producerImage, "consumer retains producer's exact image and owner");
            expect(imageCalls == 1 && viewCalls == 4 && initCalls == 1,
                   "reuse performs no image allocation, view creation, or initialization");
            expect(lastExtent.width == 128 && lastExtent.height == 64 && lastExtent.depth == 1
                       && lastFormat == standard.format && lastMips == 4, "image receives complete descriptor");
            expect(lastUsage == (VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_STORAGE_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT
                                 | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT),
                   "2D generated image supports sampling, compute, copies, and rendering");
            expect(views.at(consumer->unormView).format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM
                       && views.at(consumer->srgbView).format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB,
                   "sampled views use corresponding UNORM and SRGB formats");
            expect(views.at(consumer->unormView).levels == 4 && views.at(consumer->srgbView).levels == 4,
                   "sampled views span all mips");
            expect(views.at(consumer->unormRenderView).levels == 1 && views.at(consumer->srgbRenderView).levels == 1,
                   "attachment views expose only base level");
            producer.reset();
            DeferredDestroyQueue::instance().flush();
            expect(images.count(producerImage) == 1 && releases.empty(), "dropping producer cannot release consumer's image");
            consumer.reset();
            DeferredDestroyQueue::instance().flush();
            expect(images.count(producerImage) == 1 && releases.empty(), "pool retains texture with no external consumers");
            consumer = pool.acquire("DH_MotionVectors", standard);
            expect(consumer->image == producerImage && imageCalls == 1 && initCalls == 1,
                   "later consumer receives retained producer image without reinitializing");
        }
        DeferredDestroyQueue::instance().flush();
        expect(images.count(producerImage) == 1 && releases.empty(), "dropping pool cannot release consumer's image");
        consumer.reset();
        finish(4);
        expect(releases == std::vector<char>({'v', 'v', 'v', 'v', 'i', 'm'}), "single texture releases views then image then memory");
    }

    void mismatchAndScope(LogicalDevice& device)
    {
        reset();
        {
            ReshadeTexturePool pool(&device);
            auto first = pool.acquire("shared", standard);
            ReshadeTextureDesc variants[] = {standard, standard, standard, standard, standard, standard};
            ++variants[0].extent.width;
            ++variants[1].extent.height;
            ++variants[2].extent.depth;
            variants[3].format = VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT;
            ++variants[4].mipLevels;
            variants[5].viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D;
            for (const auto& variant : variants)
            {
                bool rejected = false;
                try { pool.acquire("shared", variant); }
                catch (const std::runtime_error&) { rejected = true; }
                expect(rejected, "each incompatible descriptor field is rejected");
                expect(imageCalls == 1 && viewCalls == 4 && initCalls == 1, "mismatch rejected before allocating or initializing");
                expect(pool.acquire("shared", standard) == first, "mismatch preserves existing texture");
            }
            auto otherName = pool.acquire("other", standard);
            ReshadeTexturePool otherPool(&device);
            auto otherScope = otherPool.acquire("shared", standard);
            expect(first->image != otherName->image && first->image != otherScope->image
                       && otherName->image != otherScope->image, "different names and chain scopes never alias");
        }
        finish(12, 3);
    }

    void deduplicateViews(LogicalDevice& device)
    {
        for (const VkFormat format : {VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT})
            for (const uint32_t mips : {1u, 4u})
            {
                reset();
                const bool sameFormat = format == VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT;
                const unsigned expected = (sameFormat ? 1u : 2u) * (mips == 1 ? 1u : 2u);
                {
                    ReshadeTexturePool pool(&device);
                    auto texture = pool.acquire("dedup", {{32, 16, 1}, format, mips, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D});
                    expect(viewCalls == expected, "only distinct format/mip combinations create views");
                    expect((texture->unormView == texture->srgbView) == sameFormat, "identical sampled formats share view");
                    expect((texture->unormRenderView == texture->srgbRenderView) == sameFormat, "identical attachment formats share view");
                    expect((texture->unormView == texture->unormRenderView) == (mips == 1), "single mip shares sampled and render view");
                }
                finish(expected);
            }
        reset();
        {
            ReshadeTexturePool pool(&device);
            auto texture = pool.acquire("volume", {{16, 16, 8}, VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT, 1, VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D});
            expect(!(lastUsage & VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT), "3D texture excludes unsupported attachment usage");
            expect(lastExtent.depth == 8 && views.at(texture->unormView).type == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D,
                   "volume preserves depth and view type");
        }
        finish(1);
    }

    void constructionFailures(LogicalDevice& device)
    {
        // Fail each of the four distinct view acquisitions, then initialization.
        for (unsigned stage = 0; stage <= 5; ++stage)
        {
            reset();
            failImage = stage == 0;
            failView = stage >= 1 && stage <= 4 ? stage : 0;
            failInit = stage == 5;
            ReshadeTexturePool pool(&device);
            bool threw = false;
            try { pool.acquire("partial", standard); }
            catch (const std::runtime_error&) { threw = true; }
            expect(threw, "failed construction reports failure");
            finish(stage == 0 ? 0 : stage == 5 ? 4 : stage - 1, stage == 0 ? 0 : 1);
            failImage = failInit = false;
            failView = 0;
            releases.clear();
            auto retry = pool.acquire("partial", standard);
            expect(images.count(retry->image) == 1, "failed acquire does not poison name in pool");
            expect(pool.acquire("partial", standard) == retry, "successful retry becomes canonical owner");
        }
        reset();
    }
}

// Only the GPU image allocation and initialization boundary is replaced. Pool
// lookup, format conversion, view creation dispatch, ownership and deferred
// release ordering all use the production implementations.
namespace VkHook
{
    VkImage createSingleImage(LogicalDevice*, VkExtent3D extent, VkFormat format, VkImageUsageFlags usage,
                              VkMemoryPropertyFlags properties, VkDeviceMemory& memory, uint32_t mipLevels)
    {
        ++imageCalls;
        lastUsage = usage;
        lastExtent = extent;
        lastFormat = format;
        lastMips = mipLevels;
        if (failImage)
            return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        memory = handle<VkDeviceMemory>();
        memories.emplace(memory, true);
        VkImage image = handle<VkImage>();
        images.emplace(image, memory);
        return image;
    }

    void changeImageLayout(LogicalDevice*, const std::vector<VkImage>& initializedImages, uint32_t mipLevels)
    {
        ++initCalls;
        expect(initializedImages.size() == 1 && mipLevels == lastMips, "initialization covers exactly the new image and all mips");
        for (auto image : initializedImages)
        {
            expect(images.count(image) == 1, "initialization receives a live image");
            expect(++initializations[image] == 1, "image is initialized once, never on reuse");
        }
        if (failInit)
            throw std::runtime_error("injected initialization failure");
    }
}

int main()
{
    LogicalDevice device = {};
    device.device = handle<VkDevice>();
    expectedDevice = device.device;
    device.vkd.CreateImageView = createImageView;
    device.vkd.DestroyImageView = destroyImageView;
    device.vkd.DestroyImage = destroyImage;
    device.vkd.FreeMemory = freeMemory;

    aliasAndLifetime(device);
    mismatchAndScope(device);
    deduplicateViews(device);
    constructionFailures(device);
    std::printf("ReShade texture pool: %d checks, %d failures\n", checks, failures);
    return failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

```cc
#include "reshade_uniforms.hh"

#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
#include <cstdlib>

#include "logger.hh"

namespace VkHook
{
    // Thread-safe RNG (avoids std::rand() which is not thread-safe)
    static thread_local std::mt19937 tlRng{std::random_device{}()};

    void enumerateReshadeUniforms(reshadefx::module module)
    {
        for (auto& uniform : module.uniforms)
        {
            auto it = std::find_if(uniform.annotations.begin(), uniform.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) {
                          return a.name == "source";
                      });
            if (it == uniform.annotations.end())
            {
                Logger::debug("uniform without source annotation (offset: " + std::to_string(uniform.offset) + ")");
                continue;
            }
            Logger::debug(it->value.string_data);
            Logger::debug("size: " + std::to_string(uniform.size));
            Logger::debug("offset: " + std::to_string(uniform.offset));
        }
    }

    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<ReshadeUniform>> createReshadeUniforms(reshadefx::module module)
    {
        std::vector<std::shared_ptr<ReshadeUniform>> uniforms;
        for (auto& uniform : module.uniforms)
        {
            auto it = std::find_if(uniform.annotations.begin(), uniform.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) {
                           return a.name == "source";
                       });
            if (it == uniform.annotations.end())
                continue;
            auto source = it->value.string_data;
            if (source == "frametime")
            {
                uniforms.push_back(std::make_shared<FrameTimeUniform>(uniform));
            }
            else if (source == "framecount")
            {
                uniforms.push_back(std::make_shared<FrameCountUniform>(uniform));
            }
            else if (source == "date")
            {
                uniforms.push_back(std::make_shared<DateUniform>(uniform));
            }
            else if (source == "timer")
            {
                uniforms.push_back(std::make_shared<TimerUniform>(uniform));
            }
            else if (source == "pingpong")
            {
                uniforms.push_back(std::make_shared<PingPongUniform>(uniform));
            }
            else if (source == "random")
            {
                uniforms.push_back(std::make_shared<RandomUniform>(uniform));
            }
            else if (source == "key")
            {
                uniforms.push_back(std::make_shared<KeyUniform>(uniform));
            }
            else if (source == "mousebutton")
            {
                uniforms.push_back(std::make_shared<MouseButtonUniform>(uniform));
            }
            else if (source == "mousepoint")
            {
                uniforms.push_back(std::make_shared<MousePointUniform>(uniform));
            }
            else if (source == "mousedelta")
            {
                uniforms.push_back(std::make_shared<MouseDeltaUniform>(uniform));
            }
            else if (source == "bufready_depth")
            {
                uniforms.push_back(std::make_shared<DepthUniform>(uniform));
            }
        }
        return uniforms;
    }

    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    FrameTimeUniform::FrameTimeUniform(reshadefx::uniform_info uniformInfo)
    {
        auto source = std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "source"; });
        if (source->value.string_data != "frametime")
        {
            Logger::err("Tried to create a FrameTimeUniform from a non frametime uniform_info");
        }
        lastFrame = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        offset    = uniformInfo.offset;
        size      = uniformInfo.size;
    }
    void FrameTimeUniform::update(void* mapedBuffer)
    {
        auto                                     currentFrame = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        std::chrono::duration<float, std::milli> duration     = currentFrame - lastFrame;
        lastFrame                                             = currentFrame;
        float frametime                                       = duration.count();
        std::memcpy((uint8_t*) mapedBuffer + offset, &(frametime), sizeof(float));
    }
    FrameTimeUniform::~FrameTimeUniform()
    {
    }

    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    FrameCountUniform::FrameCountUniform(reshadefx::uniform_info uniformInfo)
    {
        auto source = std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "source"; });
        if (source->value.string_data != "framecount")
        {
            Logger::err("Tried to create a FrameCountUniform from a non framecount uniform_info");
        }
        offset = uniformInfo.offset;
        size   = uniformInfo.size;
        floatingPoint = uniformInfo.type.is_floating_point();
    }
    void FrameCountUniform::update(void* mapedBuffer)
    {
        if (floatingPoint) {
            const float value = static_cast<float>(count);
            std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(mapedBuffer) + offset, &value, sizeof(value));
        } else {
            std::memcpy(static_cast<uint8_t*>(mapedBuffer) + offset, &count, sizeof(count));
        }
        count++;
    }
    FrameCountUniform::~FrameCountUniform()
    {
    }

    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    DateUniform::DateUniform(reshadefx::uniform_info uniformInfo)
    {
        auto source = std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "source"; });
        if (source->value.string_data != "date")
        {
            Logger::err("Tried to create a DateUniform from a non date uniform_info");
        }
        offset = uniformInfo.offset;
        size   = uniformInfo.size;
    }
    void DateUniform::update(void* mapedBuffer)
    {
        // Date only changes once per second — cache the result and only
        // recompute when the second changes. Saves ~234 localtime_r calls/sec
        // at 235 FPS.
        static thread_local std::time_t lastSecond = 0;
        static thread_local float cachedDate[4] = {};

        auto        now  = std::chrono::system_clock::now();
        std::time_t nowC = std::chrono::system_clock::to_time_t(now);

        if (nowC != lastSecond)
        {
            lastSecond = nowC;
            struct tm currentTimeBuf;
            localtime_r(&nowC, &currentTimeBuf);
            cachedDate[0] = 1900.0f + static_cast<float>(currentTimeBuf.tm_year);
            cachedDate[1] = 1.0f + static_cast<float>(currentTimeBuf.tm_mon);
            cachedDate[2] = static_cast<float>(currentTimeBuf.tm_mday);
            cachedDate[3] = static_cast<float>((currentTimeBuf.tm_hour * 60 + currentTimeBuf.tm_min) * 60 + currentTimeBuf.tm_sec);
        }

        std::memcpy((uint8_t*) mapedBuffer + offset, cachedDate, sizeof(float) * 4);
    }
    DateUniform::~DateUniform()
    {
    }

    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    TimerUniform::TimerUniform(reshadefx::uniform_info uniformInfo)
    {
        auto source = std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "source"; });
        if (source->value.string_data != "timer")
        {
            Logger::err("Tried to create a TimerUniform from a non timer uniform_info");
        }
        start  = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        offset = uniformInfo.offset;
        size   = uniformInfo.size;
    }

        auto                                     currentFrame = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
        std::chrono::duration<float, std::milli> duration     = currentFrame - start;
        float                                    timer        = duration.count();
        std::memcpy((uint8_t*) mapedBuffer + offset, &(timer), sizeof(float));
    }

    {

    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    PingPongUniform::PingPongUniform(reshadefx::uniform_info uniformInfo)
    {
        auto source = std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "source"; });
        if (source->value.string_data != "pingpong")
        {
            Logger::err("Tried to create a PingPongUniform from a non pingpong uniform_info");
        }
        if (auto minAnnotation =
                std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "min"; });
            minAnnotation != uniformInfo.annotations.end())
        {
            min = minAnnotation->type.is_floating_point() ? minAnnotation->value.as_float[0] : static_cast<float>(minAnnotation->value.as_int[0]);
        }
        if (auto maxAnnotation =
                std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "max"; });
            maxAnnotation != uniformInfo.annotations.end())
        {
            max = maxAnnotation->type.is_floating_point() ? maxAnnotation->value.as_float[0] : static_cast<float>(maxAnnotation->value.as_int[0]);
        }
        if (auto smoothingAnnotation =
                std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "smoothing"; });
            smoothingAnnotation != uniformInfo.annotations.end())
        {
            smoothing = smoothingAnnotation->type.is_floating_point() ? smoothingAnnotation->value.as_float[0]
                                                                      : static_cast<float>(smoothingAnnotation->value.as_int[0]);
        }
        if (auto stepAnnotation =
                std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "step"; });
            stepAnnotation != uniformInfo.annotations.end())
        {
            stepMin =
                stepAnnotation->type.is_floating_point() ? stepAnnotation->value.as_float[0] : static_cast<float>(stepAnnotation->value.as_int[0]);
            stepMax =
                stepAnnotation->type.is_floating_point() ? stepAnnotation->value.as_float[1] : static_cast<float>(stepAnnotation->value.as_int[1]);
        }

        lastFrame = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        offset = uniformInfo.offset;
        size   = uniformInfo.size;
    }
    void PingPongUniform::update(void* mapedBuffer)
    {
        auto currentFrame = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();

        std::chrono::duration<float, std::ratio<1>> frameTime = currentFrame - lastFrame;

        float increment = stepMax == 0 ? stepMin : (stepMin + std::fmod(static_cast<float>(tlRng()), stepMax - stepMin + 1.0f));
        if (currentValue[1] >= 0)
        {
            increment = std::max(increment - std::max(0.0f, smoothing - (max - currentValue[0])), 0.05f);
            increment *= frameTime.count();

            if ((currentValue[0] += increment) >= max)
            {
                currentValue[0] = max, currentValue[1] = -1.0f;
            }
        }
        else
        {
            increment = std::max(increment - std::max(0.0f, smoothing - (currentValue[0] - min)), 0.05f);
            increment *= frameTime.count();

            if ((currentValue[0] -= increment) <= min)
            {
                currentValue[0] = min, currentValue[1] = 1.0f;
            }
        }
        std::memcpy((uint8_t*) mapedBuffer + offset, currentValue, sizeof(float) * 2);
    }
    PingPongUniform::~PingPongUniform()
    {
    }

    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    RandomUniform::RandomUniform(reshadefx::uniform_info uniformInfo)
    {
        auto source = std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "source"; });
        if (source->value.string_data != "random")
        {
            Logger::err("Tried to create a RandomUniform from a non random uniform_info");
        }
        if (auto minAnnotation =
                std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "min"; });
            minAnnotation != uniformInfo.annotations.end())
        {
            min = minAnnotation->type.is_integral() ? minAnnotation->value.as_int[0] : static_cast<int>(minAnnotation->value.as_float[0]);
        }
        if (auto maxAnnotation =
                std::find_if(uniformInfo.annotations.begin(), uniformInfo.annotations.end(), [](const auto& a) { return a.name == "max"; });
            maxAnnotation != uniformInfo.annotations.end())
        {
            max = maxAnnotation->type.is_integral() ? maxAnnotation->value.as_int[0] : static_cast<int>(maxAnnotation->value.as_float[0]);
        }
        offset = uniformInfo.offset;
        size   = uniformInfo.size;
    }
    void RandomUniform::update(void* mapedBuffer)
    {
        if (min > max) std::swap(min, max);
        std::uniform_int_distribution<int32_t> dist(min, max);
        int32_t value = dist(tlRng);
        std::memcpy((uint8_t*) mapedBuffer + offset, &(value), sizeof(int32_t));
    }
    RandomUniform::~RandomUniform()
    {
    }

    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    KeyUniform::KeyUniform(reshadefx::uniform_info uniformInfo)
    {

            Logger::err("Tried to create a KeyUniform from a non key uniform_info");
        }
        offset = uniformInfo.offset;
        size   = uniformInfo.size;
```

`src/effects/reshade_uniforms_test.cc`:

```cc
#include "reshade_uniforms.hh"

#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <iostream>

int main()
{
    // CompleteRT uses a float framecount for temporal sampling; integer bits
    // reinterpreted as float leave it effectively stuck at frame zero.
    for (auto type : {reshadefx::type::t_float, reshadefx::type::t_int, reshadefx::type::t_uint}) {
        reshadefx::uniform_info info{};
        info.type.base = type;
        info.type.rows = info.type.cols = 1;
        info.offset = sizeof(uint32_t);
        info.size = sizeof(uint32_t);
        reshadefx::annotation source{};
        source.name = "source";
        source.value.string_data = "framecount";
        info.annotations.push_back(source);
        VkHook::FrameCountUniform uniform(info);
        std::array<uint32_t, 3> buffer{0x12345678u, 0, 0x87654321u};
        for (uint32_t frame = 0; frame < 130; ++frame) {
            uniform.update(buffer.data());
            bool correct;
            if (type == reshadefx::type::t_float) {
                float value;
                std::memcpy(&value, &buffer[1], sizeof(value));
                correct = value == static_cast<float>(frame);
                if (!correct)
                    std::cerr << "float framecount at " << frame << " was " << value << '\n';
            } else {
                correct = buffer[1] == frame;
            }
            if (!correct || buffer[0] != 0x12345678u || buffer[2] != 0x87654321u)
                return 1;
        }
    }
    std::cout << "float, int and uint framecount advance numerically without overwriting adjacent uniforms\n";
}
```

`src/effects/shader_check.cc`:

```cc
#include "reshade_parser.hh"
#include "config_serializer.hh"
#include "logger.hh"

#include <filesystem>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace
{
    void printUsage(const char* argv0)
    {
        std::cerr << "Usage: " << argv0 << " <shader.fx> [--effect-name NAME] [--include DIR ...]\n";
    }
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (argc < 2)
    {
        printUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    std::string shaderPath;
    std::string effectName;
    std::vector<std::string> includePaths;

    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i)
    {
        std::string arg = argv[i];
        if (arg == "--effect-name")
        {
            if (i + 1 >= argc)
            {
                std::cerr << "Missing value for --effect-name\n";
                return 1;
            }
            effectName = argv[++i];
            continue;
        }

        if (arg == "--include")
        {
            if (i + 1 >= argc)
            {
                std::cerr << "Missing value for --include\n";
                return 1;
            }
            includePaths.emplace_back(argv[++i]);
            continue;
        }

        if (shaderPath.empty())
        {
            shaderPath = arg;
            continue;
        }

        std::cerr << "Unexpected argument: " << arg << "\n";
        printUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    if (shaderPath.empty())
    {
        printUsage(argv[0]);
        return 1;
    }

    if (effectName.empty())
        effectName = std::filesystem::path(shaderPath).stem().string();

    VkHook::ShaderTestResult result;
    if (includePaths.empty())
    {
        result = VkHook::testShaderCompilation(effectName, shaderPath);
    }
    else
    {
        result = VkHook::testShaderCompilation(effectName, shaderPath, includePaths);
    }

    std::cout << "effect: " << result.effectName << "\n";
    std::cout << "path: " << result.filePath << "\n";
    std::cout << "success: " << (result.success ? "true" : "false") << "\n";
    std::cout << "usesDepth: " << (result.usesDepth ? "true" : "false") << "\n";
    if (!result.errorMessage.empty())
        std::cout << "message: " << result.errorMessage << "\n";

    return result.success ? 0 : 2;
}
```

`src/effects/shaders/glsl/depth_resolve_alpha.frag.glsl`:

```glsl
#version 450

// Alpha-based depth resolve shader
// Reads depth from the alpha channel instead of luminance (R channel)
// Supports optional depth inversion via push constant

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D depthTexture;

layout(location = 0) in vec2 textureCoord;
layout(location = 0) out float resolvedDepth;

// Push constant for runtime-configurable inversion
layout(push_constant) uniform DepthParams {
    bool invertDepth;
} depthParams;

void main()
{
    float depth = textureLod(depthTexture, textureCoord, 0.0).a;
    
    // Apply inversion if enabled: depth = 1.0 - depth
    if (depthParams.invertDepth)
    {
        depth = 1.0 - depth;
    }
    
    resolvedDepth = depth;
}
```

`src/effects/shaders/glsl/depth_resolve_alpha_msaa.frag.glsl`:

```glsl
#version 450

// Alpha-based MSAA depth resolve shader (multi-sample average)
// Reads depth from the alpha channel instead of luminance (R channel)
// Supports optional depth inversion via push constant
//
// MSAA depth resolve fallback for depth images in GENERAL layout, where the
// depth-stencil resolve subpass path cannot be used (it requires attachment-
// optimal layouts). Manually averages all samples via texelFetch. When the
// device does not advertise VK_RESOLVE_MODE_AVERAGE_BIT, the caller selects
// sample 0 instead, which this shader also implements via a uniform flag.
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2DMS depthTexture;

layout(location = 0) in vec2 textureCoord;
layout(location = 0) out float resolvedDepth;

layout(constant_id = 0) const int NUM_SAMPLES = 1;
layout(constant_id = 1) const int AVERAGE_MODE = 1;  // 1 = average, 0 = sample 0

// Push constant for runtime-configurable inversion
layout(push_constant) uniform DepthParams {
    bool invertDepth;
} depthParams;

void main()
{
    ivec2 coords = ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy);
    float depth;

    if (AVERAGE_MODE == 1)
    {
        float sum = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < NUM_SAMPLES; ++i)
            sum += texelFetch(depthTexture, coords, i).a;
        depth = sum / float(NUM_SAMPLES);
    }
    else
    {
        depth = texelFetch(depthTexture, coords, 0).a;
    }
    
    // Apply inversion if enabled: depth = 1.0 - depth
    if (depthParams.invertDepth)
    {
        depth = 1.0 - depth;
    }
    
    resolvedDepth = depth;
}

```

`src/effects/shaders/glsl/depth_resolve_universal.frag.glsl`:

```glsl
#version 450

// Universal depth resolve shader with comprehensive mode support
// Handles all common depth buffer encodings used by deferred renderers
//
// Modes:
//   0 = Luminance/Red (standard Vulkan depth)
//   1 = Alpha channel (alpha-encoded depth)
//   2 = Packed RGB (depth distributed across RGB, e.g. RGB24/RGB32)
//   3 = Logarithmic (log-encoded depth)
//   4 = View-space Z (raw view-space Z, typically negative)
//   5 = Normalized Device Coordinates (NDC, post-projection [-1,1] or [0,1])
//   6 = Reversed-Z (inverted depth range for precision)

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2D depthTexture;

layout(location = 0) in vec2 textureCoord;
layout(location = 0) out float resolvedDepth;

// Push constants for runtime-configurable depth handling
layout(push_constant) uniform DepthParams {
    int  depthMode;      // Source channel/mode selection
    bool invertDepth;    // Invert after reading: depth = 1.0 - depth
    bool normalize;      // Normalize to [0,1] range if needed
    bool flipDepth;      // Mirror sampling vertically (uv.y -> 1 - uv.y)
    bool flopDepth;      // Mirror sampling horizontally (uv.x -> 1 - uv.x)
} depthParams;

void main()
{
    // mirror the source before sampling. branchless: mix picks uv or 1-uv per
    // axis, so a flipped/flopped renderer reads upright depth with no pipeline
    // rebuild.
    vec2 uv = textureCoord;
    vec2 mirror = vec2(float(depthParams.flopDepth), float(depthParams.flipDepth));
    uv = mix(uv, vec2(1.0) - uv, mirror);

    vec4 texel = textureLod(depthTexture, uv, 0.0);
    float depth = 0.0;

    // Extract depth based on selected source mode
    switch (depthParams.depthMode)
    {
        case 0: // Luminance/Red - Standard Vulkan depth
            depth = texel.r;
            break;
            
        case 1: // Alpha channel - Alpha-encoded depth
            depth = texel.a;
            break;
            
        case 2: // Packed RGB - Decode from RGB channels
            // Common packing: R=high bits, G=mid bits, B=low bits
            // Or could be normalized across all channels
            depth = dot(texel.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114)); // Luminance fallback
            // Alternative: treat as packed 24-bit value
            // depth = (texel.r * 65536.0 + texel.g * 256.0 + texel.b) / 16777215.0;
            break;
            
        case 3: // Logarithmic depth - exp() to linearize
            // log_depth = log(z/z_near) / log(z_far/z_near)
            // z = z_near * exp(log_depth * log(z_far/z_near))
            // For now, assume standard log encoding in R channel
            depth = exp(texel.r * 20.0) - 1.0; // Approximate linearization
            depth = clamp(depth, 0.0, 1.0);
            break;
            
        case 4: // View-space Z (typically negative in OpenGL convention)
            depth = texel.r;
            // Convert negative view-space Z to [0,1] depth
            if (depthParams.normalize)
            {
                depth = abs(depth); // Take absolute value
                // Normalize assuming typical view range of 0-1000 units
                depth = clamp(depth / 1000.0, 0.0, 1.0);
            }
            break;
            
        case 5: // Normalized Device Coordinates (NDC)
            depth = texel.r;
            // NDC can be [-1, 1] or [0, 1] depending on API/convention
            if (depthParams.normalize)
            {
                // Map from [-1, 1] to [0, 1]
                depth = depth * 0.5 + 0.5;
            }
            break;
            
        case 6: // Reversed-Z (already inverted at source level)
            depth = texel.r;
            // Reversed-Z is already "inverted" relative to standard depth
            // Don't apply additional inversion unless explicitly requested
            break;
            
        default: // Fallback to luminance
            depth = texel.r;
            break;
    }

    // Apply inversion if enabled (except reversed-z which is already inverted)
    if (depthParams.invertDepth && depthParams.depthMode != 6)
    {
        depth = 1.0 - depth;
    }

    resolvedDepth = depth;
}

```

`src/effects/shaders/glsl/depth_resolve_universal_ms.frag.glsl`:

```glsl
#version 450

// Universal MSAA depth resolve shader (single sample) with comprehensive mode support
// Handles all common depth buffer encodings used by deferred renderers
//
// Uses texelFetch for per-sample access instead of texture sampling

layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2DMS depthTexture;

layout(location = 0) in vec2 textureCoord;
layout(location = 0) out float resolvedDepth;

// Push constants for runtime-configurable depth handling
layout(push_constant) uniform DepthParams {
    int  depthMode;      // Source channel/mode selection
    bool invertDepth;    // Invert after reading: depth = 1.0 - depth
    bool normalize;      // Normalize to [0,1] range if needed
} depthParams;

void main()
{
    vec4 texel = texelFetch(depthTexture, ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy), 0);
    float depth = 0.0;

    // Extract depth based on selected source mode
    switch (depthParams.depthMode)
    {
        case 0: // Luminance/Red - Standard Vulkan depth
            depth = texel.r;
            break;
            
        case 1: // Alpha channel - Alpha-encoded depth
            depth = texel.a;
            break;
            
        case 2: // Packed RGB - Decode from RGB channels
            depth = dot(texel.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
            break;
            
        case 3: // Logarithmic depth
            depth = exp(texel.r * 20.0) - 1.0;
            depth = clamp(depth, 0.0, 1.0);
            break;
            
        case 4: // View-space Z
            depth = texel.r;
            if (depthParams.normalize)
            {
                depth = abs(depth);
                depth = clamp(depth / 1000.0, 0.0, 1.0);
            }
            break;
            
        case 5: // Normalized Device Coordinates (NDC)
            depth = texel.r;
            if (depthParams.normalize)
            {
                depth = depth * 0.5 + 0.5;
            }
            break;
            
        case 6: // Reversed-Z
            depth = texel.r;
            break;
            
        default:
            depth = texel.r;
            break;
    }

    // Apply inversion if enabled
    if (depthParams.invertDepth && depthParams.depthMode != 6)
    {
        depth = 1.0 - depth;
    }

    resolvedDepth = depth;
}

```

`src/effects/shaders/glsl/depth_resolve_universal_msaa.frag.glsl`:

```glsl
#version 450

// Universal MSAA depth resolve shader (multi-sample average) with comprehensive mode support
// Handles all common depth buffer encodings used by deferred renderers
//
// Averages all samples via texelFetch. When the device does not advertise
// VK_RESOLVE_MODE_AVERAGE_BIT, the caller selects sample 0 instead.
layout(set = 0, binding = 0) uniform sampler2DMS depthTexture;

layout(location = 0) in vec2 textureCoord;
layout(location = 0) out float resolvedDepth;

layout(constant_id = 0) const int NUM_SAMPLES = 1;
layout(constant_id = 1) const int AVERAGE_MODE = 1;  // 1 = average, 0 = sample 0

// Push constants for runtime-configurable depth handling
layout(push_constant) uniform DepthParams {
    int  depthMode;      // Source channel/mode selection
    bool invertDepth;    // Invert after reading: depth = 1.0 - depth
    bool normalize;      // Normalize to [0,1] range if needed
} depthParams;

float extractDepth(vec4 texel)
{
    float depth = 0.0;
    
    switch (depthParams.depthMode)
    {
        case 0: // Luminance/Red
            depth = texel.r;
            break;
            
        case 1: // Alpha channel
            depth = texel.a;
            break;
            
        case 2: // Packed RGB
            depth = dot(texel.rgb, vec3(0.299, 0.587, 0.114));
            break;
            
        case 3: // Logarithmic
            depth = exp(texel.r * 20.0) - 1.0;
            depth = clamp(depth, 0.0, 1.0);
            break;
            
        case 4: // View-space Z
            depth = texel.r;
            if (depthParams.normalize)
            {
                depth = abs(depth);
                depth = clamp(depth / 1000.0, 0.0, 1.0);
            }
            break;
            
        case 5: // NDC
            depth = texel.r;
            if (depthParams.normalize)
            {
                depth = depth * 0.5 + 0.5;
            }
            break;
            
        case 6: // Reversed-Z
            depth = texel.r;
            break;
            
        default:
            depth = texel.r;
            break;
    }
    
    return depth;
}

void main()
{
    ivec2 coords = ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy);
    float depth;

    if (AVERAGE_MODE == 1)
    {
        float sum = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < NUM_SAMPLES; ++i)
        {
            vec4 texel = texelFetch(depthTexture, coords, i);
            sum += extractDepth(texel);
        }
        depth = sum / float(NUM_SAMPLES);
    }
    else
    {
        vec4 texel = texelFetch(depthTexture, coords, 0);
        depth = extractDepth(texel);
    }

    // Apply inversion if enabled
    if (depthParams.invertDepth && depthParams.depthMode != 6)
    {
        depth = 1.0 - depth;
    }

    resolvedDepth = depth;
}
```

`src/effects/shaders/glsl/dlss5_common.glsl`:

```glsl
#ifndef DLSS5_COMMON_GLSL
#define DLSS5_COMMON_GLSL

// Scalar std430 layout shared with VkHook::Dlss5Parameters (72 bytes).
layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer Parameters {
    uint width, height, fullWidth, fullHeight;
    uint bgra, seed;
    float intensity, localTone, localStructure, skinStructure;
    uint temporal, historyValid, flowWidth, flowHeight;
    float historyStrength;
    uint debugView;
    uint autoMask;
    float style;
} p;

bool dlss5Finite(vec3 value) {
    return !any(isnan(value)) && !any(isinf(value));
}

bool dlss5TemporalEnabled() {
    return p.temporal != 0u && p.historyValid != 0u && p.historyStrength > 0.0;
}

bool dlss5FrameAccepted(uint accepted, uint candidates) {
    // Measure disagreement among reliable motion candidates, not the entire
    // image: textureless sky/background often has no trustworthy optical flow.
    // A tiny accidental match must not keep a cut's history alive.
    uint count = p.width * p.height;
    return accepted >= max(64u, (count + 99u) / 100u)
        && accepted >= candidates / 2u + candidates % 2u;
}

bool dlss5SampleAccepted(vec4 sampleValue) {
    return sampleValue.a > 0.0 && sampleValue.a <= 1.0 && dlss5Finite(sampleValue.rgb);
}

#endif

```

`src/effects/shaders/glsl/dlss5_composite.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "dlss5_common.glsl"
layout(local_size_x = 8, local_size_y = 8) in;
layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer Source { uint pixels[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 2) readonly buffer Head { vec4 head[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 3) readonly buffer Features { float features[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 4) readonly buffer Reprojection {
    uint accepted, candidates, pad1, pad2;
    vec4 samples[];
} reprojection;
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer HistoryOutput { vec4 historyOutput[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 7) writeonly buffer Output { uint result[]; };
#include "dlss5_debug.glsl"
float truncateHalf(float v) {
    uint bits = packHalf2x16(vec2(v, 0.0)) & 0xffffu;
    if (unpackHalf2x16(bits).x > v) --bits;
    return unpackHalf2x16(bits).x;
}
void main() {
    uvec2 id = gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy;
    if (id.x >= p.width || id.y >= p.height) return;
    uint pixel = id.y * p.width + id.x;
    uint packed = pixels[pixel];
    uint padded = id.y * p.fullWidth + id.x;
    vec4 proxy = unpackUnorm4x8(packed);
    if (p.bgra != 0u) proxy = proxy.bgra;
    vec3 neural;
    for (uint c = 0u; c < 3u; ++c) {
        // Preserve the original no-history feature arithmetic.
        float inner = fma(head[padded][c], 0.03125, features[padded * 16u + 4u + c]);
        neural[c] = clamp(inner * 8.0 + 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
    }
    bool frameAccepted = false;
    vec4 previous = vec4(0.0);
    float weight = 0.0;
    if (dlss5TemporalEnabled()) {
        frameAccepted = dlss5FrameAccepted(reprojection.accepted, reprojection.candidates);
        if (frameAccepted) {
            previous = reprojection.samples[pixel];
            float headW = head[padded].w;
            if (dlss5SampleAccepted(previous) && !isnan(headW) && !isinf(headW)) {
                // OpenDLSS-NR's sigmoid, gated by measured reprojection confidence.
                weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + exp2(headW * uintBitsToFloat(0xbfb8aa3bu)));
                weight *= clamp(p.historyStrength, 0.0, 1.0) * previous.a;
                neural = fma(vec3(weight), previous.rgb - neural, neural);
            }
        }
    }
    for (uint c = 0u; c < 3u; ++c)
        neural[c] = truncateHalf(clamp(neural[c], 0.0, 1.0));
    // Feedback is the neural result, never the intensity-blended display output.
    if (p.temporal != 0u) historyOutput[pixel] = vec4(neural, 1.0);
    if (p.debugView == 0u && p.intensity == 0.0) { result[pixel] = packed; return; }
    vec3 displayColor = p.debugView == 0u ? mix(proxy.rgb, neural, p.intensity)
        : dlss5DebugColor(id, frameAccepted, previous, weight);
    vec4 outputColor = vec4(displayColor, proxy.a);
    if (p.bgra != 0u) outputColor = outputColor.bgra;
    result[pixel] = (packUnorm4x8(outputColor) & 0x00ffffffu) | (packed & 0xff000000u);
}

```

`src/effects/shaders/glsl/dlss5_debug.glsl`:

```glsl
#ifndef DLSS5_DEBUG_GLSL
#define DLSS5_DEBUG_GLSL

layout(std430, binding = 6) readonly buffer DebugForwardFlow { uint vectors[]; } debugFlow;

// Display only: never publish diagnostic colors into neural history.
vec3 dlss5DebugColor(uvec2 id, bool frameAccepted, vec4 previous, float weight) {
    bool available = p.temporal != 0u && p.flowWidth != 0u && p.flowHeight != 0u;
    bool valid = available && p.historyValid != 0u;
    vec3 status = !available ? vec3(1.0, 0.0, 1.0)
        : !valid ? vec3(1.0, 0.65, 0.0)
        : frameAccepted ? vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0) : vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
    // Top strip: magenta unavailable/off, amber reset, red rejected, green accepted.
    if (id.y < 8u) return status;
    if (!valid) return status * ((((id.x / 16u) ^ (id.y / 16u)) & 1u) != 0u ? 0.25 : 0.5);
    if (p.debugView == 1u) {
        uvec2 cell = min(id / 4u, uvec2(p.flowWidth - 1u, p.flowHeight - 1u));
        uint packed = debugFlow.vectors[cell.y * p.flowWidth + cell.x];
        vec2 motion = vec2(int(packed << 16u) >> 16, int(packed) >> 16) / 32.0;
        float magnitude = length(motion);
        if (magnitude == 0.0) return vec3(0.0);
        // Current -> previous displacement: right red, down yellow-green,
        // left cyan, up violet. Half brightness at eight pixels of displacement.
        float hue = fract(atan(motion.y, motion.x) / 6.28318530718 + 1.0);
        vec3 wheel = clamp(abs(fract(vec3(hue) + vec3(0.0, 2.0 / 3.0, 1.0 / 3.0)) * 6.0 - 3.0) - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        return wheel * (1.0 - exp2(-magnitude / 8.0));
    }
    bool accepted = frameAccepted && dlss5SampleAccepted(previous);
    if (p.debugView == 2u) return accepted ? vec3(0.0, previous.a, 0.0) : vec3(0.0);
    if (p.debugView == 3u) return accepted ? clamp(previous.rgb, 0.0, 1.0) : vec3(0.0);
    return vec3(weight); // Actual sigmoid * history strength * confidence.
}

#endif

```

`src/effects/shaders/glsl/dlss5_luma.comp`:

```comp
#version 450

layout(local_size_x = 64) in;
layout(set = 0, binding = 0, std430) readonly buffer Source { uint pixels[]; } source;
layout(set = 0, binding = 1, std430) readonly buffer Parameters
{
    uint width;
    uint height;
    uint bgra;
    uint pad;
} params;
layout(set = 0, binding = 7, std430) writeonly buffer Luminance { uint words[]; } luma;

void main()
{
    uint word = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x + gl_GlobalInvocationID.y * gl_NumWorkGroups.x * 64u;
    uint count = params.width * params.height;
    if (word >= (count + 3u) / 4u) return;
    uint packed = 0u;
    for (uint lane = 0u; lane < 4u; ++lane)
    {
        uint index = word * 4u + lane;
        if (index >= count) break;
        uint pixel = source.pixels[index];
        uint red = (pixel >> (params.bgra != 0u ? 16u : 0u)) & 255u;
        uint green = (pixel >> 8u) & 255u;
        uint blue = (pixel >> (params.bgra != 0u ? 0u : 16u)) & 255u;
        // Rec.709 luma on the original nonlinear SDR bytes. Integer weights
        // sum to 256, preserving black/white and avoiding cross-word races.
        uint y = (54u * red + 183u * green + 19u * blue + 128u) >> 8u;
        packed |= y << (lane * 8u);
    }
    luma.words[word] = packed;
}

```

`src/effects/shaders/glsl/dlss5_preprocess.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "common.glsl"
#include "dlss5_common.glsl"
// Feature arithmetic and noise sequence from OpenDLSS-NR (MIT).
layout(local_size_x = 8, local_size_y = 8) in;
layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer Source { uint pixels[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 2) readonly buffer Reprojection {
    uint accepted, candidates, pad1, pad2;
    vec4 samples[];
} reprojection;
layout(std430, binding = 7) writeonly buffer Features { float features[]; };
float hashUniform(uint value) {
    uint mixed = value;
    mixed = (mixed >> ((mixed >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ mixed;
    mixed *= 0x108ef2d9u;
    uint integer = ((mixed >> 30u) ^ (mixed >> 8u)) + 1u;
    return float(integer) * uintBitsToFloat(0x33800000u);
}
vec3 gaussian3(uint x, uint y, uint seed) {
    uint base = (x * 0x8da6b343u) ^ (seed * 0x9e3779b9u) ^ (y * 0xd8163841u) ^ 0x243f6a88u;
    base = (base >> ((base >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ base;
    base *= 0x108ef2d9u;
    base = (base >> 22u) ^ base;
    float u0 = hashUniform(base * 0x2c9277b5u + 0xac564b05u);
    float u1 = hashUniform(base * 0xfa6dc5f9u + 0x4712a88eu);
    float u2 = hashUniform(base * 0xcaa5b80du + 0x21dd796bu);
    float u3 = hashUniform(base * 0x83232c31u + 0x3463e0acu);
    float radius0 = sqrt(log2(u0) * uintBitsToFloat(0x3f317218u) * -2.0);
    float radius1 = sqrt(log2(u2) * uintBitsToFloat(0x3f317218u) * -2.0);
    float angle0 = u1 * uintBitsToFloat(0x40c90fdbu);
    float angle1 = u3 * uintBitsToFloat(0x40c90fdbu);
    return vec3(roundF16(radius0 * cos(angle0)), roundF16(radius0 * sin(angle0)), roundF16(radius1 * cos(angle1)));
}
uint mirror(uint x, uint size) {
    if (size == 1u) return 0u;
    uint period = 2u * (size - 1u);
    uint t = x % period;
    return t < size ? t : period - t;
}
void main() {
    uvec2 id = gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy;
    if (id.x >= p.fullWidth || id.y >= p.fullHeight) return;
    vec4 rgba = unpackUnorm4x8(pixels[mirror(id.y, p.height) * p.width + mirror(id.x, p.width)]);
    if (p.bgra != 0u) rgba = rgba.bgra;
    vec3 centred;
    for (uint c = 0u; c < 3u; ++c)
        centred[c] = roundF16(roundF16(roundF16(rgba[c]) - 0.5) * 0.125);
    vec3 noise = gaussian3(id.x, id.y, p.seed);
    vec3 history = centred;
    // Explicit guards keep first/reset frames away from uninitialized history.
    if (dlss5TemporalEnabled()) {
        if (dlss5FrameAccepted(reprojection.accepted, reprojection.candidates)) {
            uint pixel = mirror(id.y, p.height) * p.width + mirror(id.x, p.width);
            vec4 previous = reprojection.samples[pixel];
            if (dlss5SampleAccepted(previous)) {
                for (uint c = 0u; c < 3u; ++c)
                    history[c] = roundF16(roundF16(roundF16(previous[c]) - 0.5) * 0.125);
            }
        }
    }
    uint base = (id.y * p.fullWidth + id.x) * 16u;
    for (uint c = 0u; c < 3u; ++c) {
        features[base + c] = noise[c];
        features[base + 4u + c] = centred[c];
        features[base + 7u + c] = history[c];
    }
    features[base + 3u] = 1.0;
    features[base + 10u] = p.style / 128.0;
    features[base + 11u] = roundF16(p.localTone);
    features[base + 12u] = roundF16(p.autoMask != 0u ? 1.0 : p.localStructure);
    features[base + 13u] = roundF16(p.autoMask != 0u ? (p.skinStructure < 0.0 ? p.localStructure : p.skinStructure) : -1.0);
    features[base + 14u] = roundF16(p.autoMask != 0u ? p.localStructure : -1.0);
    features[base + 15u] = 0.0;
}

```

`src/effects/shaders/glsl/dlss5_reproject.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "dlss5_common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 8, local_size_y = 8) in;
layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer Source { uint pixels[]; } current;
layout(std430, binding = 2) readonly buffer PreviousSource { uint pixels[]; } previous;
layout(std430, binding = 3) readonly buffer PreviousHistory { vec4 pixels[]; } history;
layout(std430, binding = 4) readonly buffer ForwardFlow { uint vectors[]; } forwardFlow;
layout(std430, binding = 5) readonly buffer BackwardFlow { uint vectors[]; } backwardFlow;
layout(std430, binding = 6) readonly buffer FlowCost { uint words[]; } flowCost;
// Host clears the 16-byte header before dispatch, then barriers the entire buffer
// before preprocess/composite. History is tightly packed over the valid extent.
layout(std430, binding = 7) buffer Reprojection {
    uint accepted, candidates, pad1, pad2;
    vec4 samples[];
} reprojection;
shared uvec2 groupCounts[64];

vec3 unpackColor(uint value) {
    vec4 rgba = unpackUnorm4x8(value);
    return p.bgra != 0u ? rgba.bgr : rgba.rgb;
}

// NVIDIA R16G16_SFIXED5_NV: signed S10.5 displacement in source pixels,
// not normalized UVs and not the 4x4 output-grid units.
vec2 unpackFlow(uint value) {
    int x = int(value << 16u) >> 16;
    int y = int(value) >> 16;
    return vec2(x, y) * (1.0 / 32.0);
}

uint flowIndex(ivec2 position) {
    return uint(position.y) * p.flowWidth + uint(position.x);
}

float costAt(uint index) {
    return float((flowCost.words[index / 4u] >> ((index % 4u) * 8u)) & 255u);
}

vec2 sampleFlow(vec2 pixel, bool reverse, out float cost) {
    // Hardware grid4 cells are centred at pixel-space (2, 2), (6, 2), ... .
    vec2 grid = clamp((pixel + 0.5) * 0.25 - 0.5,
                      vec2(0.0), vec2(p.flowWidth - 1u, p.flowHeight - 1u));
    ivec2 low = ivec2(floor(grid));
    ivec2 high = min(low + 1, ivec2(p.flowWidth, p.flowHeight) - 1);
    vec2 f = fract(grid);
    uint a = flowIndex(low);
    uint b = flowIndex(ivec2(high.x, low.y));
    uint c = flowIndex(ivec2(low.x, high.y));
    uint d = flowIndex(high);
    vec2 va, vb, vc, vd;
    cost = 0.0;
    if (reverse) {
        va = unpackFlow(backwardFlow.vectors[a]);
        vb = unpackFlow(backwardFlow.vectors[b]);
        vc = unpackFlow(backwardFlow.vectors[c]);
        vd = unpackFlow(backwardFlow.vectors[d]);
    } else {
        va = unpackFlow(forwardFlow.vectors[a]);
        vb = unpackFlow(forwardFlow.vectors[b]);
        vc = unpackFlow(forwardFlow.vectors[c]);
        vd = unpackFlow(forwardFlow.vectors[d]);
        // Reject a footprint touching unreliable flow rather than averaging its cost away.
        cost = max(max(costAt(a), costAt(b)), max(costAt(c), costAt(d)));
    }
    return mix(mix(va, vb, f.x), mix(vc, vd, f.x), f.y);
}

vec3 previousColor(vec2 position) {
    ivec2 low = ivec2(floor(position));
    ivec2 high = min(low + 1, ivec2(p.width, p.height) - 1);
    vec2 f = fract(position);
    vec3 a = unpackColor(previous.pixels[uint(low.y) * p.width + uint(low.x)]);
    vec3 b = unpackColor(previous.pixels[uint(low.y) * p.width + uint(high.x)]);
    vec3 c = unpackColor(previous.pixels[uint(high.y) * p.width + uint(low.x)]);
    vec3 d = unpackColor(previous.pixels[uint(high.y) * p.width + uint(high.x)]);
    return mix(mix(a, b, f.x), mix(c, d, f.x), f.y);
}

vec3 boundedHistory(ivec2 position, inout bool valid) {
    vec3 value = history.pixels[uint(position.y) * p.width + uint(position.x)].rgb;
    if (!dlss5Finite(value)) {
        valid = false;
        return vec3(0.0);
    }
    return clamp(value, vec3(0.0), vec3(1.0));
}

vec3 bilinearHistory(vec2 position, inout bool valid) {
    // Positions use texel centres at 0.5, as in textureLod with clamp-to-edge.
    vec2 pixel = clamp(position - 0.5, vec2(0.0), vec2(p.width - 1u, p.height - 1u));
    ivec2 low = ivec2(floor(pixel));
    ivec2 high = min(low + 1, ivec2(p.width, p.height) - 1);
    vec2 f = fract(pixel);
    vec3 a = boundedHistory(low, valid);
    vec3 b = boundedHistory(ivec2(high.x, low.y), valid);
    vec3 c = boundedHistory(ivec2(low.x, high.y), valid);
    vec3 d = boundedHistory(high, valid);
    return mix(mix(a, b, f.x), mix(c, d, f.x), f.y);
}

// Five-tap Catmull-Rom from OpenDLSS-NR demo/shaders/nr_common.glsl (MIT).
// The four axis taps and centre use bilinear-weight folding; unlike repeatedly
// feeding back bilinear history, this preserves moving detail. Bound every tap
// and the reconstruction so negative cubic lobes cannot amplify color overshoot.
vec3 reconstructHistory(vec2 pixel, inout bool valid) {
    vec2 extent = vec2(p.width, p.height);
    vec2 position = pixel + 0.5;
    vec2 base = floor(position - 0.5) + 0.5;
    vec2 f = clamp(position - base, vec2(0.0), vec2(1.0));
    vec2 square = f * f;
    vec2 cube = f * square;
    vec2 w0 = fma(f + cube, vec2(-0.5), square);
    vec2 w1 = (cube * 1.5 - square * 2.5) + 1.0;
    vec2 w3 = (cube - square) * 0.5;
    vec2 w2 = ((1.0 - w0) - w1) - w3;
    vec2 middle = w1 + w2;
    vec2 low = clamp(base - 1.0, vec2(0.5), extent - 0.5);
    vec2 center = clamp(base + w2 / middle, vec2(0.5), extent - 0.5);
    vec2 high = clamp(base + 2.0, vec2(0.5), extent - 0.5);
    vec3 left = bilinearHistory(vec2(low.x, center.y), valid);
    vec3 top = bilinearHistory(vec2(center.x, low.y), valid);
    vec3 mid = bilinearHistory(center, valid);
    vec3 bottom = bilinearHistory(vec2(center.x, high.y), valid);
    vec3 right = bilinearHistory(vec2(high.x, center.y), valid);
    float a = w0.x * middle.y;
    float b = w0.y * middle.x;
    float c = middle.x * middle.y;
    float d = w3.y * middle.x;
    float e = w3.x * middle.y;
    vec3 value = fma(left, vec3(a), top * b);
    value = fma(mid, vec3(c), value);
    value = fma(bottom, vec3(d), value);
    value = fma(right, vec3(e), value);
    value *= 1.0 / (e + (d + (c + (a + b))));
    valid = valid && dlss5Finite(value);
    return clamp(value, vec3(0.0), vec3(1.0));
}

vec4 reproject(uvec2 id, out bool candidate) {
    candidate = false;
    // No flow, previous input or previous history access on first/reset frames.
    if (!dlss5TemporalEnabled() || p.flowWidth == 0u || p.flowHeight == 0u)
        return vec4(0.0);
    vec2 pixel = vec2(id);
    float cost;
    vec2 forward = sampleFlow(pixel, false, cost);
    vec2 position = pixel + forward; // Current -> previous, in full-resolution pixels.
    if (any(isnan(position)) || any(isinf(position)) || cost >= 64.0 ||
        any(lessThan(position, vec2(0.0))) ||
        any(greaterThan(position, vec2(p.width - 1u, p.height - 1u))))
        return vec4(0.0);
    float unusedCost;
    vec2 backward = sampleFlow(position, true, unusedCost);
    float disagreement = length(forward + backward);
    // Allow subpixel hardware uncertainty, not a second surface's velocity.
    float tolerance = min(2.0, 0.75 + 0.025 * length(forward));
    if (isnan(disagreement) || isinf(disagreement) || disagreement >= tolerance)
        return vec4(0.0);
    candidate = true;
    vec3 color = unpackColor(current.pixels[id.y * p.width + id.x]);
    vec3 difference = abs(color - previousColor(position));
    float mismatch = max(difference.r, max(difference.g, difference.b));
    if (!dlss5Finite(difference) || mismatch >= 0.10)
        return vec4(0.0);
    float confidence = (1.0 - smoothstep(8.0, 64.0, cost)) *
                       (1.0 - smoothstep(0.25, tolerance, disagreement)) *
                       (1.0 - smoothstep(0.02, 0.10, mismatch));
    if (confidence < 0.05) return vec4(0.0);
    bool valid = true;
    vec3 value = reconstructHistory(position, valid);
    return valid ? vec4(value, confidence) : vec4(0.0);
}

void main() {
    uvec2 id = gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy;
    uint lane = gl_LocalInvocationIndex;
    uvec2 counts = uvec2(0u);
    if (id.x < p.width && id.y < p.height) {
        bool candidate;
        vec4 value = reproject(id, candidate);
        reprojection.samples[id.y * p.width + id.x] = value;
        counts = uvec2(value.a > 0.0 ? 1u : 0u, candidate ? 1u : 0u);
    }
    // Out-of-range invocations participate too (odd/non-workgroup-sized images).
    groupCounts[lane] = counts;
    barrier();
    for (uint stride = 32u; stride != 0u; stride >>= 1u) {
        if (lane < stride) groupCounts[lane] += groupCounts[lane + stride];
        barrier();
    }
    if (lane == 0u) {
        if (groupCounts[0].x != 0u) atomicAdd(reprojection.accepted, groupCounts[0].x);
        if (groupCounts[0].y != 0u) atomicAdd(reprojection.candidates, groupCounts[0].y);
    }
}
```
