`src/overlay/params/fields/field_float.cc`:

```cc
#include "../field_editor.hh"
#include "../../../vendor/imgui/imgui.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>

namespace VkHook
{
    // Robust float field editor with custom value input via right-click
    // Uses deferred modal opening to avoid ImGui nested-popup issues
    class FloatFieldEditor : public FieldEditor
    {
    public:
        bool render(EffectParam& param) override
        {
            auto& p = static_cast<FloatParam&>(param);
            bool changed = false;

            // Generate stable unique IDs using parameter address (avoids label collisions)
            const void* paramAddr = static_cast<const void*>(&param);
            char contextId[64];
            char modalId[64];
            char inputId[64];
            snprintf(contextId, sizeof(contextId), "##flctx_%p", paramAddr);
            snprintf(modalId, sizeof(modalId), "Custom value###flmodal_%p", paramAddr);
            snprintf(inputId, sizeof(inputId), "##flinput_%p", paramAddr);

            // === Render the slider ===
            if (ImGui::SliderFloat(p.label.c_str(), &p.value, p.minValue, p.maxValue))
            {
                const float step = p.step > 0.0f ? p.step : 0.01f;
                p.value = std::round(p.value / step) * step;
                changed = true;
            }

            // === Right-click context menu ===
            if (ImGui::BeginPopupContextItem(contextId))
            {
                if (ImGui::MenuItem("Type in manually..."))
                {
                    // Mark modal as pending for THIS parameter, initialize buffer
                    activeModalParam = paramAddr;
                    snprintf(customValueBuf, sizeof(customValueBuf), "%.6g", p.value);
                    // Don't call OpenPopup here - defer to after context menu closes
                    focusCustomValueInput = true;
                    modalOpenRequested = true;
                }
                if (ImGui::MenuItem("Reset to default"))
                {
                    resetToDefault(param);
                    changed = true;
                }
                ImGui::EndPopup();
            }

            // === Deferred modal opening (must happen outside any popup context) ===
            if (modalOpenRequested && activeModalParam == paramAddr)
            {
                modalOpenRequested = false;
                ImGui::OpenPopup(modalId);
            }

            // === Render custom value popup for THIS parameter only ===
            if (activeModalParam == paramAddr &&
                ImGui::BeginPopupModal(modalId, nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize))
            {
                ImGui::TextUnformatted(p.label.c_str());
                ImGui::TextDisabled("Current range: [%.4g, %.4g]", p.minValue, p.maxValue);
                ImGui::TextDisabled("(values outside range are allowed)");
                ImGui::Spacing();

                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 20.0f);
                if (focusCustomValueInput)
                {
                    ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
                    focusCustomValueInput = false;
                }
                bool submit = ImGui::InputText(inputId, customValueBuf,
                    sizeof(customValueBuf), ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue | ImGuiInputTextFlags_AutoSelectAll);

                ImGui::Spacing();
                const bool cancel = ImGui::Button("Cancel");
                ImGui::SameLine();
                const bool ok = ImGui::Button("OK");

                // Handle submission
                if (submit || ok)
                {
                    float newVal;
                    if (sscanf(customValueBuf, "%f", &newVal) == 1)
                    {
                        p.value = newVal;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                    ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
                    activeModalParam = nullptr;  // Clear active state
                }

                // Handle cancellation
                if (cancel || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape))
                {
                    ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
                    activeModalParam = nullptr;  // Clear active state
                }

                ImGui::EndPopup();
            }

            return changed;
        }

        void resetToDefault(EffectParam& param) override
        {
            param.resetToDefault();
        }

    private:
        static constexpr size_t BUF_SIZE = 128;
        char customValueBuf[BUF_SIZE] = "";
        const void* activeModalParam = nullptr;  // Which param has modal open
        bool modalOpenRequested = false;
        bool focusCustomValueInput = false;
    };

    REGISTER_FIELD_EDITOR(ParamType::Float, FloatFieldEditor)

} // namespace VkHook

```

`src/overlay/params/fields/field_floatvec.cc`:

```cc
#include "../field_editor.hh"
#include "../../../vendor/imgui/imgui.h"
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>

namespace VkHook
{
    // Robust float vector (vec2/3/4) field editor with custom value input via right-click
    class FloatVecFieldEditor : public FieldEditor
    {
    public:
        bool render(EffectParam& param) override
        {
            auto& p = static_cast<FloatVecParam&>(param);
            bool changed = false;

            // Generate stable unique IDs using parameter address
            const void* paramAddr = static_cast<const void*>(&param);
            char contextId[64];
            char modalId[64];
            char inputId[64];
            snprintf(contextId, sizeof(contextId), "##fvcctx_%p", paramAddr);
            snprintf(modalId, sizeof(modalId), "Custom values###fvcmodal_%p", paramAddr);
            snprintf(inputId, sizeof(inputId), "##fvcinput_%p", paramAddr);

            // === Render the vector slider ===
            switch (p.componentCount)
            {
                case 2:
                    changed = ImGui::SliderFloat2(p.label.c_str(), p.value, 
                        p.minValue[0], p.maxValue[0]);
                    break;
                case 3:
                    changed = ImGui::SliderFloat3(p.label.c_str(), p.value,
                        p.minValue[0], p.maxValue[0]);
                    break;
                case 4:
                    changed = ImGui::SliderFloat4(p.label.c_str(), p.value,
                        p.minValue[0], p.maxValue[0]);
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }

            if (changed)
            {
                const float step = p.step > 0.0f ? p.step : 0.01f;
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p.componentCount; i++)
                    p.value[i] = std::round(p.value[i] / step) * step;
            }

            // === Right-click context menu ===
            if (ImGui::BeginPopupContextItem(contextId))
            {
                if (ImGui::MenuItem("Type in manually..."))
                {
                    activeModalParam = paramAddr;
                    // Format current values into buffer based on component count
                    formatValues(p);
                    focusCustomValueInput = true;
                    modalOpenRequested = true;
                }
                if (ImGui::MenuItem("Reset to default"))
                {
                    resetToDefault(param);
                    changed = true;
                }
                ImGui::EndPopup();
            }

            // === Deferred modal opening ===
            if (modalOpenRequested && activeModalParam == paramAddr)
            {
                modalOpenRequested = false;
                ImGui::OpenPopup(modalId);
            }

            // === Render custom value popup ===
            if (activeModalParam == paramAddr &&
                ImGui::BeginPopupModal(modalId, nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize))
            {
                ImGui::TextUnformatted(p.label.c_str());
                ImGui::TextDisabled("Components: %u (comma-separated)",
                    static_cast<unsigned int>(p.componentCount));
                ImGui::TextDisabled("(values outside range are allowed)");
                ImGui::Spacing();

                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 24.0f);
                if (focusCustomValueInput)
                {
                    ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
                    focusCustomValueInput = false;
                }
                bool submit = ImGui::InputText(inputId, customValueBuf,
                    sizeof(customValueBuf), ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue | ImGuiInputTextFlags_AutoSelectAll);

                ImGui::Spacing();
                const bool cancel = ImGui::Button("Cancel");
                ImGui::SameLine();
                const bool ok = ImGui::Button("OK");

                if (submit || ok)
                {
                    changed |= parseAndApply(p);
                    ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
                    activeModalParam = nullptr;
                }

                if (cancel || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape))
                {
                    ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
                    activeModalParam = nullptr;
                }

                ImGui::EndPopup();
            }

            return changed;
        }

        void resetToDefault(EffectParam& param) override
        {
            param.resetToDefault();
        }

    private:
        // Format current vector values into the buffer as comma-separated
        void formatValues(const FloatVecParam& p)
        {
            switch (p.componentCount)
            {
                case 2:
                    snprintf(customValueBuf, sizeof(customValueBuf),
                        "%.6g, %.6g", p.value[0], p.value[1]);
                    break;
                case 3:
                    snprintf(customValueBuf, sizeof(customValueBuf),
                        "%.6g, %.6g, %.6g", p.value[0], p.value[1], p.value[2]);
                    break;
                case 4:
                    snprintf(customValueBuf, sizeof(customValueBuf),
                        "%.6g, %.6g, %.6g, %.6g", 
                        p.value[0], p.value[1], p.value[2], p.value[3]);
                    break;
                default:
                    snprintf(customValueBuf, sizeof(customValueBuf), "%.6g", p.value[0]);
                    break;
            }
        }

        // Parse comma-separated values and apply to parameter
        bool parseAndApply(FloatVecParam& p)
        {
            float vals[4] = { p.value[0], p.value[1], p.value[2], p.value[3] };
            int count = sscanf(customValueBuf, "%f, %f, %f, %f",
                &vals[0], &vals[1], &vals[2], &vals[3]);

            if (count >= static_cast<int>(p.componentCount))
            {
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p.componentCount; i++)
                    p.value[i] = vals[i];
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        static constexpr size_t BUF_SIZE = 256;
        char customValueBuf[BUF_SIZE] = "";
        const void* activeModalParam = nullptr;
        bool modalOpenRequested = false;
        bool focusCustomValueInput = false;
    };

    REGISTER_FIELD_EDITOR(ParamType::FloatVec, FloatVecFieldEditor)

} // namespace VkHook
```

`src/overlay/params/fields/field_int.cc`:

```cc
#include "../field_editor.hh"
#include "../../../vendor/imgui/imgui.h"
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>

namespace VkHook
{
    // Robust int field editor with custom value input via right-click
    // Supports both slider mode and combo/dropdown mode
    class IntFieldEditor : public FieldEditor
    {
    public:
        bool render(EffectParam& param) override
        {
            auto& p = static_cast<IntParam&>(param);
            bool changed = false;

            // Generate stable unique IDs using parameter address
            const void* paramAddr = static_cast<const void*>(&param);
            char contextId[64];
            char modalId[64];
            char inputId[64];
            snprintf(contextId, sizeof(contextId), "##intctx_%p", paramAddr);
            snprintf(modalId, sizeof(modalId), "Custom value###intmodal_%p", paramAddr);
            snprintf(inputId, sizeof(inputId), "##intinput_%p", paramAddr);

            // === Render the control (combo or slider) ===
            if (!p.items.empty())
            {
                // Combo box mode for enumerated values
                const int itemCount = static_cast<int>(p.items.size());
                const int previewIdx = (p.value >= 0 && p.value < itemCount) ? p.value : 0;
                if (ImGui::BeginCombo(p.label.c_str(), p.items[previewIdx].c_str()))
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; ++i)
                    {
                        if (ImGui::Selectable(p.items[i].c_str(), i == p.value))
                        {
                            p.value = i;
                            changed = true;
                        }
                    }
                    ImGui::EndCombo();
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // Slider mode for numeric range
                if (ImGui::SliderInt(p.label.c_str(), &p.value, p.minValue, p.maxValue))
                {
                    if (p.step > 0.0f)
                    {
                        int step = static_cast<int>(p.step);
                        if (step > 0)
                            p.value = (p.value / step) * step;
                    }
                    changed = true;
                }
            }

            // === Right-click context menu ===
            if (ImGui::BeginPopupContextItem(contextId))
            {
                if (!p.items.empty())
                {
                    // Combo mode: only show reset option
                    if (ImGui::MenuItem("Reset to default"))
                    {
                        resetToDefault(param);
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    // Slider mode: show custom value AND reset
                    if (ImGui::MenuItem("Type in manually..."))
                    {
                        activeModalParam = paramAddr;
                        snprintf(customValueBuf, sizeof(customValueBuf), "%d", p.value);
                        focusCustomValueInput = true;
                        modalOpenRequested = true;
                    }
                    if (ImGui::MenuItem("Reset to default"))
                    {
                        resetToDefault(param);
                        changed = true;
                    }
                }
                ImGui::EndPopup();
            }

            // === Deferred modal opening (outside popup context) ===
            if (modalOpenRequested && activeModalParam == paramAddr)
            {
                modalOpenRequested = false;
                ImGui::OpenPopup(modalId);
            }

            // === Render custom value popup (only for slider mode) ===
            if (p.items.empty() &&
                activeModalParam == paramAddr &&
                ImGui::BeginPopupModal(modalId, nullptr, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize))
            {
                ImGui::TextUnformatted(p.label.c_str());
                ImGui::TextDisabled("Current range: [%d, %d]", p.minValue, p.maxValue);
                ImGui::TextDisabled("(values outside range are allowed)");
                ImGui::Spacing();

                ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 20.0f);
                if (focusCustomValueInput)
                {
                    ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
                    focusCustomValueInput = false;
                }
                bool submit = ImGui::InputText(inputId, customValueBuf,
                    sizeof(customValueBuf), ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue | ImGuiInputTextFlags_AutoSelectAll);

                ImGui::Spacing();
                const bool cancel = ImGui::Button("Cancel");
                ImGui::SameLine();
                const bool ok = ImGui::Button("OK");

                if (submit || ok)
                {
                    int newVal;
                    if (sscanf(customValueBuf, "%d", &newVal) == 1)
                    {
                        p.value = newVal;
                        changed = true;
                    }
                    ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
                    activeModalParam = nullptr;
                }

                if (cancel || ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape))
                {
                    ImGui::CloseCurrentPopup();
                    activeModalParam = nullptr;
                }

                ImGui::EndPopup();
            }

            return changed;
        }

        void resetToDefault(EffectParam& param) override
        {
            param.resetToDefault();
        }

    private:
        static constexpr size_t BUF_SIZE = 128;
        char customValueBuf[BUF_SIZE] = "";
        const void* activeModalParam = nullptr;
        bool modalOpenRequested = false;
        bool focusCustomValueInput = false;
    };

    REGISTER_FIELD_EDITOR(ParamType::Int, IntFieldEditor)

} // namespace VkHook
```

```cc
#include "../field_editor.hh"
#include "../../../vendor/imgui/imgui.h"
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdio>
#include <string>

namespace VkHook
{
    // Robust int vector (ivec2/3/4) field editor with custom value input via right-click
    class IntVecFieldEditor : public FieldEditor
    {
    public:
        bool render(EffectParam& param) override
        {
            auto& p = static_cast<IntVecParam&>(param);
            bool changed = false;

            // Generate stable unique IDs using parameter address
            const void* paramAddr = static_cast<const void*>(&param);
            char contextId[64];
            char modalId[64];
            char inputId[64];
            snprintf(contextId, sizeof(contextId), "##ivcctx_%p", paramAddr);
            snprintf(modalId, sizeof(modalId), "Custom values###ivcmodal_%p", paramAddr);
            snprintf(inputId, sizeof(inputId), "##ivcinput_%p", paramAddr);

            // === Render the vector slider ===
            switch (p.componentCount)
            {
                case 2:
                    changed = ImGui::SliderInt2(p.label.c_str(), p.value,
                        p.minValue[0], p.maxValue[0]);
                    break;

                        p.minValue[0], p.maxValue[0]);
                    break;

                        p.minValue[0], p.maxValue[0]);
                    break;
                default:
                    break;

            {
                int step = static_cast<int>(p.step);
                if (step > 0)
                {
                    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < p.componentCount; i++)
                        p.value[i] = (p.value[i] / step) * step;
                }

                    focusCustomValueInput = false;
```

```hh
#pragma once

#include "vendor/imgui/imgui.h"
#include "logger.hh"

namespace VkHook::UI
{
    inline ImVec4 Primary() { return ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_CheckMark); }
    inline ImVec4 Secondary() { return ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_SliderGrab); }
    inline ImVec4 Tertiary() { return ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_PlotLines); }
    inline ImVec4 Error() { return ImVec4(1.0f, 0.40f, 0.40f, 1.0f); }
    inline ImVec4 OnError() { return ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_Text); }
    inline ImVec4 Outline() { return ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_Border); }
    inline ImVec4 OnSurface() { return ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_Text); }
    inline ImVec4 Muted() { return ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_TextDisabled); }
    inline ImVec4 Container() { return ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_FrameBg); }
    inline ImVec4 ContainerLow() { return ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_ChildBg); }
    inline ImVec4 Surface() { return ImGui::GetStyleColorVec4(ImGuiCol_WindowBg); }
    inline ImVec4 Success() { return ImVec4(0.40f, 0.85f, 0.50f, 1.0f); }
    inline ImVec4 Warning() { return ImVec4(1.0f, 0.78f, 0.30f, 1.0f); }
    inline ImVec4 Attention() { return Warning(); }

    inline ImVec4 LogLevelColor(LogLevel level)
    {
        switch (level)
        {
        case LogLevel::Error: return Error();
        case LogLevel::Warn: return Warning();
        default: return Primary();
        }
    }

    inline void TextSupport(const char* text) { ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", text); }
}
```

```cc
#include "imgui_overlay.hh"
#include "version.hh"

#include "vendor/imgui/imgui.h"

namespace VkHook
{
    namespace
    {
        // compiled in from the top-level VERSION file, so the label and the
        // footer agree and neither depends on a file the installer may not have
        // written.
        const char* runtimeVersion()
        {
            return VKHOOK_VERSION;
        }
    }

    void ImGuiOverlay::renderAboutView()
    {
        ImGui::BeginChild("about_content");
        ImGui::SeparatorText("VkHook");
        ImGui::TextWrapped("ReShade-like Vulkan post processing layer, made Linux-first.");
        ImGui::TextDisabled("Version %s - beta", runtimeVersion());
        ImGui::TextWrapped("The overlay uses standard Dear ImGui controls.");
        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::SeparatorText("Credits");
        auto credit = [](const char* what, const char* handle, const char* url) {
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(what);
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextLinkOpenURL(handle, url);
        };
        credit("VKIntox by", "@buwryme", "https://github.com/buwryme/VKIntox");
        credit("vkShade by", "@slobodaapl", "https://github.com/slobodaapl");
        credit("vkBasalt by", "@DadSchoorse", "https://github.com/DadSchoorse/vkBasalt");
        credit("Overlay fork by", "@Boux", "https://github.com/Boux/vkBasalt_overlay");
        credit("Wayland overlay by", "@Daaboulex", "https://github.com/Daaboulex/vkBasalt_overlay_wayland");
        credit("ReShade FX support by", "@crosire", "https://github.com/crosire/reshade");
        credit("Dear ImGui by", "@ocornut", "https://github.com/ocornut/imgui");
        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::TextDisabled("VkHook  \xC2\xB7  version %s", runtimeVersion());
        ImGui::TextDisabled("Report issues:");
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::TextLinkOpenURL("github.com/sorche942/VkHook/issues", "https://github.com/sorche942/VkHook/issues");
        ImGui::EndChild();
    }

} // namespace VkHook
```

`src/overlay/view_add_effects.cc`:

```cc
#include "imgui_overlay.hh"
#include "effects/effect_registry.hh"
#include "settings_manager.hh"
#include "reshade_parser.hh"
#include "config_serializer.hh"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cctype>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "vendor/imgui/imgui.h"
#include "overlay/ui_theme.hh"

namespace VkHook
{
    // ---- Effect search -------------------------------------------------------
    //
    // The list routinely holds 300+ ReShade shaders, so the view is built around
    // a ranked, instantly-filtered search instead of a long scroll. Scoring is
    // cheap and deterministic: exact prefix beats word-prefix beats substring,
    // with a subsequence fallback so "sm" still finds "SMAA" and "smaa".

    static std::string toLower(std::string s)
    {
        std::transform(s.begin(), s.end(), s.begin(), [](unsigned char c) { return (char)std::tolower(c); });
        return s;
    }

    static bool isSubsequence(const std::string& needle, const std::string& haystack)
    {
        size_t j = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < haystack.size() && j < needle.size(); i++)
            if (haystack[i] == needle[j])
                j++;
        return j == needle.size();
    }

    // Lower score = better. Returns -1 when there is no match.
    static int matchScore(const std::string& name, const std::string& query)
    {
        if (query.empty())
            return 0;
        const std::string n = toLower(name);
        const std::string q = toLower(query);
        if (n.rfind(q, 0) == 0)
            return 0;   // prefix
        // word-prefix: the query starts a word inside the name
        for (size_t i = 1; i < n.size(); i++)
            if ((n[i - 1] == ' ' || n[i - 1] == '_' || n[i - 1] == '-') && n.compare(i, q.size(), q) == 0)
                return 1;
        if (n.find(q) != std::string::npos)
            return 2;   // substring
        if (isSubsequence(q, n))
            return 3;   // fuzzy
        return -1;
    }

    // The first directory under the shader root names the effect package. Nested
    // installs (Shaders/Package/Sub/Effect.fx) still report the top-level package,
    // and a shader sitting directly in Shaders/ reports none.
    static std::string effectPackageForPath(const std::string& path)
    {
        std::vector<std::string> parts;
        std::string current;
        for (char c : path)
        {
            if (c == '/' || c == '\\')
            {
                if (!current.empty()) parts.push_back(current);
                current.clear();
            }
            else
            {
                current.push_back(c);
            }
        }
        if (!current.empty()) parts.push_back(current);

        size_t shaders = parts.size();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < parts.size(); i++)
            if (parts[i] == "Shaders" || parts[i] == "Textures")
                shaders = i;
        return (shaders + 2 < parts.size()) ? parts[shaders + 1] : std::string();
    }

    void ImGuiOverlay::renderAddEffectsView()
    {
        if (!effectRegistry)
            return;

        std::vector<std::string> selectedEffects = effectRegistry->getSelectedEffects();

        // ESC clears the search (and, when already empty, leaves the view).
        if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape) && addEffectsSearch[0] != '\0')
            addEffectsSearch[0] = '\0';

        // Seamless typing: capture printable characters when no widget is focused.
        if (!ImGui::IsAnyItemActive())
        {
            ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
            if (io.InputQueueCharacters.Size > 0)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < io.InputQueueCharacters.Size; i++)
                {
                    ImWchar c = io.InputQueueCharacters[i];
                    if (c >= 32 && c < 127)
                    {
                        size_t len = strlen(addEffectsSearch);
                        if (len < sizeof(addEffectsSearch) - 1)
                        {
                            addEffectsSearch[len] = static_cast<char>(c);
                            addEffectsSearch[len + 1] = '\0';
                        }
                    }
                }
                io.InputQueueCharacters.clear();
            }
            if (ImGui::IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Backspace) && addEffectsSearch[0] != '\0')
            {
                size_t len = strlen(addEffectsSearch);
                if (len > 0)
                    addEffectsSearch[len - 1] = '\0';
            }
        }

        const size_t maxEffectsLimit = static_cast<size_t>(settingsManager.getMaxEffects());
        const size_t currentCount = selectedEffects.size();
        const size_t pendingCount = pendingAddEffects.size();
        // removals free slots, so they count against the limit too
        size_t removedPresent = 0;
        for (const auto& removed : addEffectsRemoved)
            if (std::find(selectedEffects.begin(), selectedEffects.end(), removed) != selectedEffects.end())
                removedPresent++;
        const bool atLimit = currentCount - removedPresent + pendingCount >= maxEffectsLimit;

        auto isNameUsed = [&](const std::string& name) {
            if (std::find(selectedEffects.begin(), selectedEffects.end(), name) != selectedEffects.end())
                return true;
            for (const auto& p : pendingAddEffects)
                if (p.first == name)
                    return true;
            return false;
        };
        auto isPending = [&](const std::string& effectType) {
            for (const auto& p : pendingAddEffects)
                if (p.second == effectType)
                    return true;
            return false;
        };
        auto getNextInstanceName = [&](const std::string& effectType) -> std::string {
            if (!isNameUsed(effectType))
                return effectType;
            for (int n = 2; n <= 99; n++)
            {
                std::string candidate = effectType + "." + std::to_string(n);
                if (!isNameUsed(candidate))
                    return candidate;
            }
            return effectType + ".99";
        };

        // Session-scoped recents, so frequently used shaders are one click away.
        static std::vector<std::string> recent;
        auto pushRecent = [&](const std::string& type) {
            auto it = std::find(recent.begin(), recent.end(), type);
            if (it != recent.end())
                recent.erase(it);
            recent.insert(recent.begin(), type);
            if (recent.size() > 8)
                recent.resize(8);
        };
        auto queueEffect = [&](const std::string& effectType) {
            if (atLimit || isPending(effectType))
                return;
            pendingAddEffects.push_back({getNextInstanceName(effectType), effectType});
            addEffectsRemoved.erase(effectType);
            pushRecent(effectType);
        };

        auto alreadyInConfig = [&](const std::string& type) {
            return std::find(selectedEffects.begin(), selectedEffects.end(), type) != selectedEffects.end();
        };
        auto removeQueued = [&](const std::string& type) {
            pendingAddEffects.erase(std::remove_if(pendingAddEffects.begin(), pendingAddEffects.end(),
                                                   [&](const auto& p) { return p.second == type; }),
                                    pendingAddEffects.end());
        };
        // the extras map starts empty, so an already-listed effect shows 0 copies
        auto duplicateCountFor = [&](const std::string& type) {
            auto it = addEffectsDuplicateCount.find(type);
            return (it == addEffectsDuplicateCount.end()) ? 0 : std::max(0, it->second);
        };
        auto queueCopies = [&](const std::string& type, int copies) {
            for (int i = 0; i < copies && selectedEffects.size() + pendingAddEffects.size() < maxEffectsLimit; i++)
                pendingAddEffects.push_back({getNextInstanceName(type), type});
            pushRecent(type);
        };
        // the switch is the whole group: an already-listed effect keeps its
        // original, a new one gets one copy, and the count adds extra copies
        auto groupActive = [&](const std::string& type) {
            return isPending(type) || (alreadyInConfig(type) && !addEffectsRemoved.count(type));
        };
        auto copiesFor = [&](const std::string& type) {
            return duplicateCountFor(type) + (alreadyInConfig(type) ? 0 : 1);
        };
        auto toggleQueued = [&](const std::string& type, bool on) {
            removeQueued(type);
            if (!on)
            {
                if (alreadyInConfig(type))
                    addEffectsRemoved.insert(type);
                return;
            }
            addEffectsRemoved.erase(type);
            queueCopies(type, copiesFor(type));
        };

        // ---- Build the working set ------------------------------------------
        // Rebuilding and re-sorting 300+ shaders every frame is wasted when the
        // inputs rarely move, so cache the result until state, search or package
        // tab actually changes.
        static std::string filterPackage;  // empty = All
        if (overlayStateVersion != addEffectsCacheVersion
            || std::string(addEffectsSearch) != addEffectsCacheSearch
            || filterPackage != addEffectsCacheFilter)
        {
            addEffectsEntries.clear();

            std::vector<std::string> sortedCurrent = state.currentConfigEffects;
            std::vector<std::string> sortedDefault = state.defaultConfigEffects;
            std::sort(sortedCurrent.begin(), sortedCurrent.end());
            std::sort(sortedDefault.begin(), sortedDefault.end());

            auto addEntry = [&](const std::string& type, const std::string& path, int group) {
                const int score = matchScore(type, addEffectsSearch);
                if (score >= 0)
                    addEffectsEntries.push_back({type, path, effectPackageForPath(path), group, score});
            };
            for (const auto& et : sortedCurrent)
            {
                auto it = state.effectPaths.find(et);
                addEntry(et, (it != state.effectPaths.end()) ? it->second : "", 0);
            }
            for (const auto& et : sortedDefault)
            {
                if (std::find(sortedCurrent.begin(), sortedCurrent.end(), et) != sortedCurrent.end())
                    continue;
                auto it = state.effectPaths.find(et);
                addEntry(et, (it != state.effectPaths.end()) ? it->second : "", 1);
            }

            // the tabs are the installed packages, not the working set: a package
            // whose effects are all already added has to stay reachable so its
            // duplicates can still be queued
            {
                std::set<std::string> packages;
                for (const auto& entry : state.effectPaths)
                {
                    const std::string package = effectPackageForPath(entry.second);
                    if (!package.empty())
                        packages.insert(package);
                }
                addEffectsPackages.assign(packages.begin(), packages.end());
                // VkHook's own shaders lead the tab row; the rest stay alphabetical
                std::sort(addEffectsPackages.begin(), addEffectsPackages.end(),
                          [](const std::string& a, const std::string& b) {
                              if ((a == "VkHook") != (b == "VkHook"))
                                  return a == "VkHook";
                              return a < b;
                          });
            }

            // a tab can vanish when the install changes; fall back to All
            if (!filterPackage.empty() &&
                std::find(addEffectsPackages.begin(), addEffectsPackages.end(), filterPackage) == addEffectsPackages.end())
                filterPackage.clear();

            if (!filterPackage.empty())
                addEffectsEntries.erase(std::remove_if(addEffectsEntries.begin(), addEffectsEntries.end(),
                                                       [&](const AddEffectsEntry& e) { return e.package != filterPackage; }),
                                        addEffectsEntries.end());

            // group results by their effect package, keeping search relevance first
            std::stable_sort(addEffectsEntries.begin(), addEffectsEntries.end(), [](const AddEffectsEntry& a, const AddEffectsEntry& b) {
                if (a.score != b.score)
                    return a.score < b.score;
                if (a.package != b.package)
                    return a.package < b.package;
                if (a.group != b.group)
                    return a.group < b.group;
                return a.type < b.type;
            });

            // the All tab, with no active search, shows a dimmed header per package
            addEffectsRows.clear();
            const bool groupHeads = filterPackage.empty() && addEffectsSearch[0] == '\0';
            std::string currentPackage;
            for (int i = 0; i < static_cast<int>(addEffectsEntries.size()); i++)
            {
                if (groupHeads && addEffectsEntries[i].package != currentPackage)
                {
                    currentPackage = addEffectsEntries[i].package;
                    addEffectsRows.push_back({currentPackage.empty() ? std::string("Other") : currentPackage, -1});
                }
                addEffectsRows.push_back({std::string(), i});
            }

            addEffectsCacheVersion = overlayStateVersion;
            addEffectsCacheSearch = addEffectsSearch;
            addEffectsCacheFilter = filterPackage;
        }
        const std::vector<AddEffectsEntry>& entries = addEffectsEntries;
        const std::vector<AddEffectsRow>& rows = addEffectsRows;

        const bool hasSearch = addEffectsSearch[0] != '\0';
        if (ImGui::Button("Back to effects"))
        {
            pendingAddEffects.clear();
            addEffectsDuplicateCount.clear();
            addEffectsRemoved.clear();
            insertPosition = -1;
            inSelectionMode = false;
            addEffectsSearch[0] = '\0';
            return;
        }
        ImGui::SeparatorText(insertPosition >= 0 ? "Insert effects" : "Add effects");
        ImGui::Text("%zu in preset, %zu queued, %zu to remove (limit %zu)",
                    currentCount, pendingCount, removedPresent, maxEffectsLimit);
        if (insertPosition >= 0)
            ImGui::Text("Inserting at position %d", insertPosition + 1);
        if (atLimit)
            ImGui::TextColored(UI::Warning(), "At the limit: remove an effect to queue another.");
        if (addEffectsFocusSearch)
        {
            ImGui::SetKeyboardFocusHere();
            addEffectsFocusSearch = false;
        }
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(-1);
        ImGui::InputTextWithHint("##search", "Search effects (type to filter)...",
                                 addEffectsSearch, sizeof(addEffectsSearch),
                                 ImGuiInputTextFlags_AutoSelectAll);
        ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(ImGui::GetFontSize() * 22.0f);
        if (ImGui::BeginCombo("Package", filterPackage.empty() ? "All" : filterPackage.c_str()))
        {
            if (ImGui::Selectable("All", filterPackage.empty()))
                filterPackage.clear();
            for (const auto& package : addEffectsPackages)
                if (ImGui::Selectable(package.c_str(), filterPackage == package))
                    filterPackage = package;
            ImGui::EndCombo();
        }
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%zu results", entries.size());
        if (!hasSearch && !recent.empty() && ImGui::BeginCombo("Recent", "Choose a recent effect"))
        {
            for (const auto& effect : recent)
            {
                if (ImGui::Selectable(effect.c_str()))
                {
                    const std::string selected = effect;
                    queueEffect(selected);
                    break;
                }
            }
            ImGui::EndCombo();
        }

        const float footerHeight = ImGui::GetFrameHeightWithSpacing();
        const float trayHeight = ImGui::GetFrameHeightWithSpacing() * 3.0f;
        ImGui::BeginChild("##results",
                          ImVec2(0, std::max(ImGui::GetFrameHeightWithSpacing() * 4.0f,
                                            ImGui::GetContentRegionAvail().y - footerHeight - trayHeight -
                                            ImGui::GetStyle().ItemSpacing.y * 2.0f)),
                          ImGuiChildFlags_Borders);
        if (rows.empty())
            ImGui::TextDisabled(hasSearch ? "No effects match this filter." : "No effects available.");
        if (ImGui::BeginTable("##effects", 3, ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable | ImGuiTableFlags_RowBg))
        {
            ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Effect", ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch);
            ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Included", ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed);
            ImGui::TableSetupColumn("Extra copies", ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed,
                                    ImGui::GetFontSize() * 10.0f);
            ImGui::TableHeadersRow();
            ImGuiListClipper clipper;
            clipper.Begin(static_cast<int>(rows.size()));
            while (clipper.Step())
            {
                for (int i = clipper.DisplayStart; i < clipper.DisplayEnd; ++i)
                {
                    const auto& row = rows[i];
                    ImGui::TableNextRow(0, ImGui::GetFrameHeightWithSpacing());
                    ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                    if (!row.header.empty())
                    {
                        ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
                        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", row.header.c_str());
                        continue;
                    }
                    const auto& entry = entries[row.entry];
                    ImGui::PushID(entry.type.c_str());
                    bool included = groupActive(entry.type);
                    ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
                    if (ImGui::Selectable(entry.type.c_str(), included, ImGuiSelectableFlags_None,
                                          ImVec2(0, ImGui::GetFrameHeight())))
                        queueEffect(entry.type);
                    if (ImGui::IsItemHovered() && !entry.path.empty())
                        ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", entry.path.c_str());
                    ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                    ImGui::BeginDisabled(!included && atLimit);
                    if (ImGui::Checkbox("##included", &included))
                        toggleQueued(entry.type, included);
                    ImGui::EndDisabled();
                    ImGui::TableNextColumn();
                    if (included)
                    {
                        const int copies = duplicateCountFor(entry.type);
                        ImGui::BeginDisabled(copies == 0);
                        if (ImGui::Button("-"))
                        {
                            addEffectsDuplicateCount[entry.type] = std::max(0, copies - 1);
                            toggleQueued(entry.type, true);
                        }
                        ImGui::EndDisabled();
                        ImGui::SameLine();
                        ImGui::Text("%d", copies);
                        ImGui::SameLine();
                        ImGui::BeginDisabled(atLimit || copies >= 99);
                        if (ImGui::Button("+"))
                        {
                            addEffectsDuplicateCount[entry.type] = copies + 1;
                            toggleQueued(entry.type, true);
                        }
                        ImGui::EndDisabled();
                    }
                    ImGui::PopID();
                }
            }
            ImGui::EndTable();
        }
        ImGui::EndChild();

        ImGui::BeginChild("##queued", ImVec2(0, trayHeight), ImGuiChildFlags_Borders);
        if (pendingAddEffects.empty())
            UI::TextSupport("Queued effects appear here.");
        for (size_t i = 0; i < pendingAddEffects.size(); ++i)
        {
            ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(i));
            if (ImGui::SmallButton("Remove"))
            {
                pendingAddEffects.erase(pendingAddEffects.begin() + i);
                ImGui::PopID();
                break;
            }
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::TextUnformatted(pendingAddEffects[i].first.c_str());
            ImGui::PopID();
        }
        ImGui::EndChild();
        const bool hasRemovals = !addEffectsRemoved.empty();
        const std::string applyLabel = hasRemovals ? "Apply" :
            "Add " + std::to_string(pendingAddEffects.size()) + " effects";
        if (ImGui::Button("Cancel"))
        {
            pendingAddEffects.clear();
            addEffectsDuplicateCount.clear();
            addEffectsRemoved.clear();
            insertPosition = -1;
            inSelectionMode = false;
            addEffectsSearch[0] = '\0';
        }
        ImGui::SameLine();
        ImGui::BeginDisabled(pendingAddEffects.empty() && addEffectsRemoved.empty());
        if (ImGui::Button(applyLabel.c_str()))
        {
            // removals first, so an insert position lines up with what is left
            bool removedAny = false;
            if (hasRemovals)
            {
                for (const auto& removed : addEffectsRemoved)
                {
                    auto it = std::find(selectedEffects.begin(), selectedEffects.end(), removed);
                    if (it == selectedEffects.end())
                        continue;
                    effectRegistry->removeEffect(*it);
                    selectedEffects.erase(it);
                    removedAny = true;
                }
                if (removedAny)
                    effectRegistry->setSelectedEffects(selectedEffects);
            }

            int pos = (insertPosition >= 0 && insertPosition <= static_cast<int>(selectedEffects.size()))
                      ? insertPosition : static_cast<int>(selectedEffects.size());
            for (const auto& [instanceName, effectType] : pendingAddEffects)
            {
                selectedEffects.insert(selectedEffects.begin() + pos, instanceName);
                pos++;
                effectRegistry->ensureEffect(instanceName, effectType);
                effectRegistry->setEffectEnabled(instanceName, true);
            }
            const bool addedAny = !pendingAddEffects.empty();
            if (addedAny)
                effectRegistry->setSelectedEffects(selectedEffects);

            if (removedAny || addedAny)
            {
                if (removedAny)
                {
                    paramsDirty = true;
                    lastChangeTime = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
                }
                applyRequested = true;
                profileDirty = true;
            }
            pendingAddEffects.clear();
            addEffectsDuplicateCount.clear();
            addEffectsRemoved.clear();
            insertPosition = -1;
            inSelectionMode = false;
            addEffectsSearch[0] = '\0';
        }
        ImGui::EndDisabled();
    }

} // namespace VkHook
```

`src/overlay/view_advanced.cc`:

```cc
#include "imgui_overlay.hh"
#include "settings_manager.hh"
#include "vkhook_internal.hh"
#include "logger.hh"
#include "overlay/ui_theme.hh"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <sstream>
#include <atomic>

#include "vendor/imgui/imgui.h"

namespace VkHook
{
    // Dirty flag for deferred saving — avoids blocking the UI thread with
    // synchronous disk I/O on every single checkbox/radio/combo change.
    // The actual save happens once per frame in renderAdvancedView().
    static std::atomic<bool> g_settingsDirty{false};
    
    // Mark settings as needing save (call from UI callbacks)
    static inline void markSettingsDirty()
    {
        g_settingsDirty.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    
    // Perform deferred save if dirty (call once per frame)
    static inline void flushSettingsSaveIfNeeded()
    {
        if (g_settingsDirty.exchange(false, std::memory_order_acq_rel))
        {
            settingsManager.save();
        }
    }

    // window-sized first (exact or titlebar-inset), then the swapchain-linked
    // candidate; the busiest buffer can be the wrong size
    static VkImageView defaultPinCandidateForSwapchain(const DepthInfo& info)
    {
        constexpr int64_t kChromeTolerancePx = 128;
        auto windowSized = [&](const DepthCandidateInfo& c) {
            const int64_t dw = static_cast<int64_t>(c.extent.width)  - static_cast<int64_t>(info.swapchainExtent.width);
            const int64_t dh = static_cast<int64_t>(c.extent.height) - static_cast<int64_t>(info.swapchainExtent.height);
            return dw >= -kChromeTolerancePx && dw <= kChromeTolerancePx
                && dh >= -kChromeTolerancePx && dh <= kChromeTolerancePx;
        };

        for (const auto& c : info.candidates)
            if (c.extent.width == info.swapchainExtent.width
                && c.extent.height == info.swapchainExtent.height)
                return c.imageView;
        for (const auto& c : info.candidates)
            if (windowSized(c))
                return c.imageView;
        for (const auto& c : info.candidates)
            if (c.hasPresentableSnapshotTarget)
                return c.imageView;
        return info.candidates.empty() ? VK_NULL_HANDLE : info.candidates.front().imageView;
    }

    // Convert a VkFormat to a short human-readable string for the UI.
    static const char* depthFormatName(VkFormat format)
    {
        switch (format)
        {
        case VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM:           return "D16_UNORM";
        case VK_FORMAT_X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32: return "X8_D24_PACK32";
        case VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT:          return "D32_SFLOAT";
        case VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM_S8_UINT:   return "D16_UNORM_S8_UINT";
        case VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT:   return "D24_UNORM_S8_UINT";
        case VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT:  return "D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT";
        case VK_FORMAT_R32_SFLOAT:          return "R32_SFLOAT (resolved)";
        case VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED:           return "none";
        default:                            return "other";
        }
    }

    static const char* layoutName(VkImageLayout layout)
    {
        switch (layout)
        {
        case VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL: return "DS_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL";
        case VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL:         return "D_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL";
        case VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL:  return "DS_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL";
        case VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL:          return "D_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL";
        case VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_GENERAL:                          return "GENERAL";
        case VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED:                        return "undefined";
        default:                                               return "other";
        }
    }

    static const char* sampleName(VkSampleCountFlagBits samples)
    {
        switch (samples)
        {
        case VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT:  return "1x";

        case VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_16_BIT: return "16x";
        case VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_32_BIT: return "32x";
        case VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_64_BIT: return "64x";
        default:                     return "?";
        }
    }

    void ImGuiOverlay::gatherDepthInfo()
    {
        if (!logicalDevice)
            return;

        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(globalLock);

        depthInfo.supportedResolveModes = logicalDevice->supportedDepthResolveModes;
        depthInfo.depthCaptureEnabled   = settingsManager.getDepthCapture();
        depthInfo.swapchainExtent       = currentSwapchainExtentLocked(logicalDevice);

        deviceInfo.gpuName      = logicalDevice->gpuName;
        deviceInfo.gpuDriverInfo = logicalDevice->gpuDriverInfo;
        deviceInfo.gpuPciSlot   = logicalDevice->gpuPciSlot;
        deviceInfo.gpuApiVersion = logicalDevice->gpuApiVersion;
        deviceInfo.gpuVendorId  = logicalDevice->gpuVendorId;

        const int modePref = settingsManager.getDepthResolveMode();
        const bool avgSupported = (logicalDevice->supportedDepthResolveModes & VK_RESOLVE_MODE_AVERAGE_BIT) != 0;
        if (modePref == 2 && avgSupported)
            depthInfo.depthResolveMode = VK_RESOLVE_MODE_AVERAGE_BIT;
        else
            depthInfo.depthResolveMode = VK_RESOLVE_MODE_SAMPLE_ZERO_BIT;

        // Snapshot pin state from the device.  If the pinned view was destroyed
        // by the render thread since last frame, clear the stale pin here so the
        // UI immediately falls back to auto instead of showing a ghost pin.
        depthInfo.pinnedView = logicalDevice->pinnedDepthImageView;
        depthInfo.depthIsPinned = (depthInfo.pinnedView != VK_NULL_HANDLE);

        if (depthInfo.depthIsPinned)
        {
            auto it = logicalDevice->depthViewStates.find(depthInfo.pinnedView);
            if (it != logicalDevice->depthViewStates.end())
            {
                // Pinned view is still valid — show it as the active buffer.
                const DepthState& pinned = it->second;
                depthInfo.active.imageView       = pinned.imageView;
                depthInfo.active.format          = pinned.format;
                depthInfo.active.extent          = pinned.extent;
                depthInfo.active.samples         = pinned.samples;
                depthInfo.active.observedLayout  = pinned.observedLayout;
                depthInfo.active.transient       = pinned.transient;
                depthInfo.active.drawCount = logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.valid
                                              && logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.depthState.imageView == pinned.imageView
                                              ? logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.drawCount : 0;
                depthInfo.active.hasPresentableSnapshotTarget =
                    logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.valid
                    && logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.depthState.imageView == pinned.imageView
                    ? logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.hasPresentableSnapshotTarget : false;
            }
            else
            {
                // Pinned view was destroyed since last frame — clear the stale pin
                // so we fall back to auto.  getDepthState() in vkhook.cpp does the
                // same check, but we need it here too so the UI is consistent.
                Logger::debug("gatherDepthInfo: pinned view no longer tracked, clearing stale pin");
                logicalDevice->pinnedDepthImageView = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
                depthInfo.depthIsPinned = false;
                depthInfo.pinnedView    = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
                // Don't set active here — fall through to the auto path below.
            }
        }

        // Auto path (also handles the case where the pin was just cleared above).
        if (!depthInfo.depthIsPinned)
        {
            const DepthState& active = logicalDevice->activeDepthState;
            depthInfo.active.imageView       = active.imageView;
            depthInfo.active.format          = active.format;
            depthInfo.active.extent          = active.extent;
            depthInfo.active.samples         = active.samples;
            depthInfo.active.observedLayout  = active.observedLayout;
            depthInfo.active.transient       = active.transient;
            depthInfo.active.drawCount       = logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.valid
                                                 ? logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.drawCount : 0;
            depthInfo.active.hasPresentableSnapshotTarget =
                logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.hasPresentableSnapshotTarget;
        }
        depthInfo.depthResolveIsMsaa = depthInfo.active.samples != VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;

        // Populate candidate list from all tracked depth views.
        depthInfo.candidates.clear();
        for (const auto& [view, ds] : logicalDevice->depthViewStates)
        {
            DepthCandidateInfo c;
            c.imageView      = view;
            c.format         = ds.format;
            c.extent         = ds.extent;
            c.samples        = ds.samples;
            c.observedLayout = ds.observedLayout;
            c.transient      = ds.transient;
            if (logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.valid &&
                logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.depthState.imageView == view)
            {
                c.drawCount = logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.drawCount;
                c.hasPresentableSnapshotTarget =
                    logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate.hasPresentableSnapshotTarget;
            }
            depthInfo.candidates.push_back(c);
        }
        // Sort by drawCount descending so the best candidate appears first.
        std::sort(depthInfo.candidates.begin(), depthInfo.candidates.end(),
                  [](const DepthCandidateInfo& a, const DepthCandidateInfo& b){
                      return a.drawCount > b.drawCount;
                  });
    }

    void ImGuiOverlay::applyDepthPinRequests()
    {
        if (!logicalDevice)
            return;

        if (depthPinPendingView != VK_NULL_HANDLE)
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(globalLock);
            auto it = logicalDevice->depthViewStates.find(depthPinPendingView);
            if (it != logicalDevice->depthViewStates.end())
            {
                logicalDevice->pinnedDepthImageView = depthPinPendingView;
                Logger::info("depth manual pin set to view 0x" +
                    std::to_string((uint64_t)depthPinPendingView));
                depthPinChanged = true;
                // Force deferred realloc so descriptor sets + MSAA framebuffers
                // get rebuilt for the new depth source view.
                logicalDevice->depthReallocPending = true;
            }
            else
            {
                Logger::warn("depth pin requested but view not found (may have been destroyed)");
            }
            depthPinPendingView = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        }

        if (depthPinPendingClear)
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(globalLock);
            logicalDevice->pinnedDepthImageView = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            depthPinPendingClear = false;
            depthPinChanged = true;
            // Same: force realloc so we stop using the just-unpinned view.
            logicalDevice->depthReallocPending = true;
            Logger::info("depth manual pin cleared (back to auto-promotion)");
        }

        if (depthTransformPending)
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(globalLock);
            // the resolve owns transforms now (macros no longer carry them),
            // so re-recording it is all a toggle needs
            logicalDevice->depthReallocPending = true;
            depthTransformPending = false;
        }
    }

    // The one-line describer under the card's hero header. Reads as a sentence
    // instead of the old column dump: 1920x1080 (D16_UNORM, MSAA 1x, ...).
    static std::string describeActiveDepth(const DepthInfo& info)
    {
        if (info.active.imageView == VK_NULL_HANDLE)
            return "No depth buffer detected yet";

        std::string s = std::to_string(info.active.extent.width) + "x" +
                        std::to_string(info.active.extent.height);
        s += " (";
        s += depthFormatName(info.active.format);
        s += ", MSAA ";
        s += sampleName(info.active.samples);
        s += info.depthIsPinned ? ", pinned manually" : ", picked automatically";
        s += ")";
        return s;
    }

    namespace
    {
        struct DepthRowAction
        {
            VkImageView pin = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            bool        unpin = false;
        };

        DepthRowAction drawDepthBufferRow(int index, const DepthCandidateInfo& c,
                                          bool isActive, bool isPinned)
        {
            DepthRowAction action;
            ImGui::PushID(index);
            char label[128];
            snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%d: %ux%u%s%s", index, c.extent.width, c.extent.height,
                     isActive ? " [active]" : "", isPinned ? " [pinned]" : "");
            if (ImGui::Selectable(label, isPinned))
            {
                if (isPinned)
                    action.unpin = true;
                else
                    action.pin = c.imageView;
            }
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            {
                ImGui::BeginTooltip();
                ImGui::Text("View: 0x%llx", reinterpret_cast<unsigned long long>(c.imageView));
                ImGui::Text("Layout: %s", layoutName(c.observedLayout));
                ImGui::TextUnformatted("Click to pin or unpin this buffer.");
                ImGui::EndTooltip();
            }
            ImGui::TextDisabled("%s | MSAA %s | %u draws%s%s", depthFormatName(c.format),
                                sampleName(c.samples), c.drawCount,
                                c.transient ? " | transient" : "",
                                c.hasPresentableSnapshotTarget ? " | swapchain" : "");
            ImGui::Separator();
            ImGui::PopID();
            return action;
        }
    } // namespace

    void ImGuiOverlay::renderAdvancedView()
    {
        const float d = ImGui::GetFontSize() / 16.0f;
        ImGui::SeparatorText("Depth buffer");
        // Capture hooks are armed at startup, so this setting requires a restart.
        static const bool s_depthCaptureAtStartup = settingsManager.getDepthCapture();
        bool depthCapture = settingsManager.getDepthCapture();
        if (ImGui::Checkbox("Capture depth buffer (requires restart)", &depthCapture))
        {
            settingsManager.setDepthCapture(depthCapture);
            markSettingsDirty();
            Logger::info(std::string("depth capture ") + (depthCapture ? "enabled" : "disabled") +
                         " (saved; takes effect on restart)");
            pushToast(LogLevel::Info, depthCapture
                ? "Depth buffer capture on. Restart to apply."
                : "Depth buffer capture off. Restart to apply.");
        }
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", describeActiveDepth(depthInfo).c_str());
        if (depthCapture != s_depthCaptureAtStartup)
        {
            ImGui::TextDisabled("Requires restart");
        }

        ImGui::Spacing();
        // --- Auto / Manual pin ---
        {
            const char* modes[] = { "Auto", "Manual pin" };
            const char* hints[] = {
                "Auto promotes the buffer with the most draws, or a swapchain-linked one.",
                "Manual pin starts from the buffer matching the window size; pick another from the list."
            };
            int mode = depthInfo.depthIsPinned ? 1 : 0;
            if (ImGui::Combo("Selection mode", &mode, modes, 2))
            {
                if (mode == 0)
                {
                    if (depthInfo.depthIsPinned)
                        depthPinPendingClear = true;
                }
                else if (!depthInfo.candidates.empty())
                {
                    // unbiassed: the first reported buffer, so the switch is
                    // immediate even before anything has been drawn this frame.
                    depthPinPendingView = defaultPinCandidateForSwapchain(depthInfo);
                }
                else
                {
                    Logger::info("manual pin requested but no depth buffers are tracked yet");
                }
            }
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", hints[mode]);
        }

        ImGui::Spacing();
        // --- Reported buffers live on their own page, pushed from here ---
        {
            if (ImGui::Button("Reported depth buffers"))
                openSubView = SubView_DepthBuffers;
        }

        ImGui::Spacing();
        // --- Encoding: the two modes that actually behave differently ---
        // Luminance/Red and every other single-channel mask decode depth the same
        // way, so they collapse to "Red"; View-space Z is the only transform with
        // distinct behaviour.
        {
            static const int kChannels[] = { 0, 4 };   // depth source channel indices
            const char* labels[] = { "Luminance/Red", "View-space Z" };
            const char* hints[] = {
                "Read depth from the red / luminance channel. The standard Vulkan depth layout.",
                "Convert raw view-space Z into [0,1]. Use when the red channel reads flat or inverted."
            };
            ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
            ImGui::TextUnformatted("Encoding");
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(240.0f * d);
            ImGui::PushID("##depth_encoding");
            int current = settingsManager.getDepthSourceChannel();
            int index = (current == kChannels[1]) ? 1 : 0;
            if (ImGui::Combo("##depth_channel", &index, labels, 2))
            {
                settingsManager.setDepthSourceChannel(kChannels[index]);
                depthTransformPending = true;
                markSettingsDirty();
            }
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", hints[index]);
            ImGui::PopID();
        }

        // --- Transforms: one compact row ---
        ImGui::Spacing();
        {
            bool depthInvert = settingsManager.getDepthInvert();
            bool depthFlip   = settingsManager.getDepthFlip();
            bool depthFlop   = settingsManager.getDepthFlop();
            bool changed = false;

            if (ImGui::Checkbox("Invert", &depthInvert))
            {
                settingsManager.setDepthInvert(depthInvert);
                changed = true;
            }
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("Invert: depth = 1.0 - depth. Flips the near/far interpretation.");

            ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 18.0f * d);
            if (ImGui::Checkbox("Flip", &depthFlip))
            {
                settingsManager.setDepthFlip(depthFlip);
                changed = true;
            }
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("Mirror the depth image vertically (uv.y -> 1 - uv.y).");

            ImGui::SameLine(0.0f, 18.0f * d);
            if (ImGui::Checkbox("Mirror", &depthFlop))
            {
                settingsManager.setDepthFlop(depthFlop);
                changed = true;
            }
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("Mirror the depth image horizontally (uv.x -> 1 - uv.x).");

            if (changed)
            {
                depthTransformPending = true;
                markSettingsDirty();
            }
        }

        // --- Rebuild timing: what the refresh button below and every transform use ---
        ImGui::Spacing();
        {
            const char* labels[] = { "Safe", "Fast" };
            const char* hints[] = {
                "Idle the GPU before rebuilding the depth resolve path, so nothing in flight is still reading what gets freed.",
                "Rebuild behind the layer's own submit fences without idling. Reacts a frame sooner; a driver can fault if the app still references an old resolve target."
            };
            ImGui::AlignTextToFramePadding();
            ImGui::TextUnformatted("Rebuild");
            ImGui::SameLine();
            ImGui::SetNextItemWidth(240.0f * d);
            ImGui::PushID("##depth_rebuild");
            int index = (settingsManager.getDepthRebuildMode() == 0) ? 0 : 1;
            if (ImGui::Combo("##depth_rebuild_mode", &index, labels, 2))
            {
                settingsManager.setDepthRebuildMode(index);
                markSettingsDirty();
            }
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", hints[index]);
            ImGui::PopID();
        }

        // --- Footer ---
        ImGui::Spacing();
        if (ImGui::Button("Refresh depth buffers"))
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> l(globalLock);
            logicalDevice->activeDepthState    = DepthState{};
            logicalDevice->bestDepthCandidate  = LogicalDevice::DepthCandidateTrackingState{};
            logicalDevice->pinnedDepthImageView = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
            depthPinChanged = true;
            Logger::info("depth re-detect requested from Advanced UI");
        }
        if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
            ImGui::SetTooltip("Clear the active buffer, the best candidate and any pin.\nThe layer re-evaluates every render pass next frame.");

        // --- Deferred save ---
        flushSettingsSaveIfNeeded();
    }

    // --- Pushed page: every tracked depth buffer -------------------------------
    void ImGuiOverlay::renderDepthBuffersView()
    {
        if (ImGui::Button("Back to settings"))
        {
            openSubView = SubView_None;
            return;
        }

        ImGui::Spacing();
        ImGui::SeparatorText("Reported depth buffers");
        ImGui::TextDisabled("%s", describeActiveDepth(depthInfo).c_str());
        ImGui::Spacing();

        // mode control, so the page stands on its own
        {
            const char* modes[] = { "Auto", "Manual pin" };
            const char* hints[] = {
                "Auto promotes the buffer with the most draws, or a swapchain-linked one.",
                "Manual pin starts from the buffer matching the window size; pick another from the list."
            };
            int mode = depthInfo.depthIsPinned ? 1 : 0;
            if (ImGui::Combo("Selection mode", &mode, modes, 2))
            {
                if (mode == 0)
                {
                    if (depthInfo.depthIsPinned)
                        depthPinPendingClear = true;
                }
                else if (!depthInfo.candidates.empty())
                {
                    depthPinPendingView = defaultPinCandidateForSwapchain(depthInfo);
                }
            }
            if (ImGui::IsItemHovered())
                ImGui::SetTooltip("%s", hints[mode]);
        }

        ImGui::Spacing();
        if (depthInfo.candidates.empty())
        {
            UI::TextSupport("No depth views tracked yet. Render a frame with depth.");
            flushSettingsSaveIfNeeded();
            return;
        }

        ImGui::BeginChild("##depth_page_list", ImVec2(0, 0), false);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < depthInfo.candidates.size(); ++i)
        {
            const DepthCandidateInfo& c = depthInfo.candidates[i];
            const bool isActive = (c.imageView == depthInfo.active.imageView);
            const bool isPinned = depthInfo.depthIsPinned && (c.imageView == depthInfo.pinnedView);
            const DepthRowAction action = drawDepthBufferRow(static_cast<int>(i), c, isActive, isPinned);
            if (action.pin != VK_NULL_HANDLE)
                depthPinPendingView = action.pin;
            else if (action.unpin)
                depthPinPendingClear = true;
        }
        ImGui::EndChild();

        flushSettingsSaveIfNeeded();
    }

} // namespace VkHook
```

`src/overlay/view_configs.cc`:

```cc
#include "imgui_overlay.hh"
#include "config_serializer.hh"
#include "overlay/ui_theme.hh"

#include <cstring>

#include "vendor/imgui/imgui.h"

namespace VkHook
{
    void ImGuiOverlay::renderConfigManagerView()
    {
        ImGui::SeparatorText("Manage Configs");
        UI::TextSupport("Click a config to load it. The default one is applied on launch.");
        ImGui::Spacing();

        // Refresh config list and get current default
        if (configListRefreshPending)
        {
            configList = ConfigSerializer::listConfigs();
            configListDefault = ConfigSerializer::getDefaultConfig();
            configListRefreshPending = false;
        }

        const float footerH = ImGui::GetFrameHeightWithSpacing();
        ImGui::BeginChild("ConfigList", ImVec2(0, -footerH), false);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < configList.size(); i++)
        {
            ImGui::PushID(static_cast<int>(i));
            const std::string& cfg = configList[i];
            const bool isDefault = (cfg == configListDefault);

            const bool load = ImGui::Selectable(cfg.c_str());
            if (isDefault)
                ImGui::TextDisabled("Default on launch");
            ImGui::BeginDisabled(isDefault);
            if (ImGui::Button("Set default"))
            {
                if (ConfigSerializer::setDefaultConfig(cfg))
                    configListDefault = cfg;
            }
            ImGui::EndDisabled();
            ImGui::SameLine();
            if (ImGui::Button("Delete"))
            {
                ConfigSerializer::deleteConfig(cfg);
                configListRefreshPending = true;
                ImGui::PopID();
                continue;
            }
            ImGui::Separator();

            if (load)
            {
                // Signal to vkhook.cpp to load this config
                pendingConfigPath = ConfigSerializer::getConfigsDir() + "/" + cfg + ".conf";
                strncpy(saveConfigName, cfg.c_str(), sizeof(saveConfigName) - 1);
                applyRequested = true;
                inConfigManageMode = false;
            }

            ImGui::PopID();
        }
        if (configList.empty())
        {
            UI::TextSupport("No saved configs yet. Use Save As in the config bar to create one.");
        }
        ImGui::EndChild();

        if (ImGui::Button("Back"))
        {
            inConfigManageMode = false;
        }
    }

} // namespace VkHook
```
