    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        queues[i].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO;
        queues[i].queueFamilyIndex = i;
        queues[i].queueCount = 1;
    }
    VkDeviceCreateInfo queueInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO};
    queueInfo.pQueueCreateInfos = queues;
    queueInfo.queueCreateInfoCount = 1;
    auto choice = selectDlss5OpticalQueue(families, queueInfo);
    require(choice.family == 1 && !choice.shared, "unused optical family not reserved privately");
    queueInfo.queueCreateInfoCount = 2;
    choice = selectDlss5OpticalQueue(families, queueInfo);
    require(choice.family == 1 && choice.shared, "Proton-reserved optical queue disabled history");
    families.push_back(families[1]);
    choice = selectDlss5OpticalQueue(families, queueInfo);
    require(choice.family == 2 && !choice.shared, "shared queue preferred over available private family");
    families.pop_back();
    queues[1].flags = VK_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_PROTECTED_BIT;
    require(selectDlss5OpticalQueue(families, queueInfo).family == VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
        "protected application queue borrowed for ordinary optical commands");
    queues[1].flags = 0;
    families[1].queueFlags |= VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT;
    require(selectDlss5OpticalQueue(families, queueInfo).family == VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
        "mixed compute queue can deadlock graphics/optical dependencies");
    families[1].queueFlags = VK_QUEUE_OPTICAL_FLOW_BIT_NV;
    families[1].queueCount = 0;
    require(selectDlss5OpticalQueue(families, queueInfo).family == VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED,
        "empty queue family selected");
    vk::DeviceRequirements requirements;
    std::vector<VkExtensionProperties> extensions;
    for (const char* name: requirements.extensions) { VkExtensionProperties ext{}; std::strcpy(ext.extensionName,name); extensions.push_back(ext); }
    VkPhysicalDeviceProperties properties{}; properties.vendorID=0x10de; properties.apiVersion=VK_API_VERSION_1_3;
    VkLayerDeviceCreateInfo loader2{}; loader2.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_LOADER_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO; loader2.function=VK_LOADER_DATA_CALLBACK;
    VkLayerDeviceCreateInfo loader1{}; loader1.sType=VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_LOADER_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO; loader1.function=VK_LAYER_LINK_INFO; loader1.pNext=&loader2;
    VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features original12{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES};
    original12.timelineSemaphore=VK_TRUE; original12.pNext=&loader1;
    VkPhysicalDevice16BitStorageFeatures original16{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_16BIT_STORAGE_FEATURES};
    original16.storagePushConstant16=VK_TRUE; original16.pNext=&original12;
    VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 original2{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2};
    original2.features.robustBufferAccess=VK_TRUE; original2.pNext=&original16;
    VkDeviceCreateInfo info{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO}; info.pNext=&original2;
    std::vector<const char*> names;
    Dlss5DeviceFeatures enabled;
    require(enabled.prepare(VK_NULL_HANDLE,VK_API_VERSION_1_3,available,properties,extensions,info,names,false),enabled.error().c_str());
    require(info.pEnabledFeatures==nullptr,"features2 and pEnabledFeatures cannot coexist");
    auto* f2=static_cast<const VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2*>(info.pNext);
    require(f2->features.robustBufferAccess && f2->features.shaderInt64,"base features lost");
    std::set<VkStructureType> seen; int loaders=0;
    for (auto* n=static_cast<const VkBaseInStructure*>(info.pNext);n;n=n->pNext) {
        if(n->sType==VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_LOADER_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO) { ++loaders; continue; }
        require(seen.insert(n->sType).second,"duplicate feature sType");
        if(n->sType==VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_1_FEATURES) {
            auto* f=reinterpret_cast<const VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan11Features*>(n);
            require(f->storageBuffer16BitAccess && f->storagePushConstant16,"promoted app feature lost");
        }
        if(n->sType==VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_2_FEATURES) {
            auto* f=reinterpret_cast<const VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan12Features*>(n);
            require(f->shaderFloat16 && f->bufferDeviceAddress && f->timelineSemaphore,"Vulkan12 feature merge failed");
        }
    }
    require(loaders==2,"loader callbacks not preserved");
    require(!original12.shaderFloat16 && !original12.bufferDeviceAddress && original12.pNext==&loader1,"app input mutated");
    require(original2.pNext==&original16 && original16.pNext==&original12 && !original16.storageBuffer16BitAccess,"app pNext mutated");
    // A requested but unsupported motion engine must leave base DLSS5 usable.
    VkExtensionProperties flowExtension{};
    std::strcpy(flowExtension.extensionName, VK_NV_OPTICAL_FLOW_EXTENSION_NAME);
    extensions.push_back(flowExtension);
    VkDeviceCreateInfo noFlowInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO};
    noFlowInfo.pNext = &original2;
    Dlss5DeviceFeatures noFlow;
    std::vector<const char*> noFlowNames;
    require(noFlow.prepare(VK_NULL_HANDLE, VK_API_VERSION_1_3, available, properties, extensions,
        noFlowInfo, noFlowNames, true), "optional flow failure disabled base DLSS5");
    require(!noFlow.opticalFlowEnabled(), "unsupported flow was enabled");
    for (const char* name : noFlowNames)
        require(std::strcmp(name, VK_NV_OPTICAL_FLOW_EXTENSION_NAME) != 0, "unsupported flow extension injected");

    // Merge an application-owned optical feature node, never duplicate or mutate it.
    flowSupported = true;
    VkPhysicalDeviceOpticalFlowFeaturesNV appFlow{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_OPTICAL_FLOW_FEATURES_NV};
    appFlow.pNext = &original2;
    VkDeviceCreateInfo flowInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO};
    flowInfo.pNext = &appFlow;
    std::vector<const char*> flowNames{VK_NV_OPTICAL_FLOW_EXTENSION_NAME};
    Dlss5DeviceFeatures withFlow;
    require(withFlow.prepare(VK_NULL_HANDLE, VK_API_VERSION_1_3, available, properties, extensions,
        flowInfo, flowNames, true), "supported flow negotiation failed");
    require(withFlow.opticalFlowEnabled(), "supported flow not enabled");
    unsigned flowNodes = 0, flowExtensions = 0;
    for (auto* n = static_cast<const VkBaseInStructure*>(flowInfo.pNext); n; n = n->pNext)
        if (n->sType == VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_OPTICAL_FLOW_FEATURES_NV) {
            ++flowNodes;
            require(reinterpret_cast<const VkPhysicalDeviceOpticalFlowFeaturesNV*>(n)->opticalFlow,
                "merged optical feature is false");
        }
    for (const char* name : flowNames)
        flowExtensions += std::strcmp(name, VK_NV_OPTICAL_FLOW_EXTENSION_NAME) == 0;
    require(flowNodes == 1 && flowExtensions == 1, "duplicate optical feature/extension");
    require(!appFlow.opticalFlow && appFlow.pNext == &original2, "application optical node mutated");
    properties.vendorID=0x1002;
    VkDeviceCreateInfo rejected{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO}; rejected.pNext=&original2;
    std::vector<const char*> rejectedNames;
    Dlss5DeviceFeatures unsupported;
    require(!unsupported.prepare(VK_NULL_HANDLE,VK_API_VERSION_1_3,available,properties,extensions,rejected,rejectedNames,false),"non-NVIDIA accepted");
    require(rejected.pNext==&original2 && rejectedNames.empty(),"failure modified app info");
    std::cout<<"PASS: feature promotion, existing bits, duplicate loader nodes, const app chain, unsupported GPU"<<std::endl;
}

```

`src/tests/dlss5_network_bench.cc`:

```cc
// DLSS5 network benchmark: the production PTX graph on a private device, timed with GPU timestamps.
// No layer, no swapchain: isolates the network that dominates the effect's frame cost.
//
//   vkhook-dlss5-bench --model DIR --shaders DIR --ptx DIR [--width W --height H --frames N]
//                       [--chain 0|1] [--profile] [--dump head.f32] [--compare head.f32]
//                       [--image in.rgba [--seed S] [--output out.rgba] [--expect reference.rgba]]
//
// The recording is made once and resubmitted, as the effect does with its secondary command buffer.
// --dump/--compare write or check the f32 head bit for bit against an earlier run.
// --image runs a raw RGBA8 frame of --width x --height through the proxy preprocess with NGX's default conditioning
// (Intensity 1, Style 0, LocalTone 1, LocalStructure 1, SkinStructure -1, AutoMask on) instead of synthetic features,
// and composes the output as the effect does for a frame without history. --output writes that RGBA8 frame;
// --expect compares it with another implementation's RGBA8 output (e.g. NVIDIA's DLL).
#define VK_NO_PROTOTYPES
#include <vulkan/vulkan.h>
#include "kernels.h"
#include "nr_graph.h"
#include "numeric.h"
#include "reference.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace {
void require(bool condition, const std::string& message)
{
    if (!condition) throw std::runtime_error(message);
}

#define VULKAN_ENTRYPOINTS(X) \
    X(vkGetInstanceProcAddr) X(vkGetDeviceProcAddr) X(vkCreateInstance) X(vkDestroyInstance) \
    X(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties) \
    X(vkCreateDevice) X(vkDestroyDevice) X(vkDeviceWaitIdle)
#define DECLARE_ENTRYPOINT(name) PFN_##name name{};
VULKAN_ENTRYPOINTS(DECLARE_ENTRYPOINT)
#undef DECLARE_ENTRYPOINT

struct Loader {
    std::unique_ptr<void, int (*)(void*)> library{dlopen("libvulkan.so.1", RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL), dlclose};
    Loader()
    {
        require(bool(library), "Vulkan loader unavailable");
#define LOAD_ENTRYPOINT(name) \
        name = reinterpret_cast<PFN_##name>(dlsym(library.get(), #name)); \
        require(name != nullptr, "Vulkan loader missing " #name);
        VULKAN_ENTRYPOINTS(LOAD_ENTRYPOINT)
#undef LOAD_ENTRYPOINT
    }
};

struct Device {
    VkInstance instance{};
    VkPhysicalDevice physical{};
    VkDevice device{};
    uint32_t family = UINT32_MAX;
    ~Device()
    {
        if (device) { vkDeviceWaitIdle(device); vkDestroyDevice(device, nullptr); }
        if (instance) vkDestroyInstance(instance, nullptr);
    }
};

std::string argument(int argc, char** argv, const char* name, const std::string& fallback = "")
{
    for (int index = 1; index + 1 < argc; ++index)
        if (!std::strcmp(argv[index], name)) return argv[index + 1];
    return fallback;
}

bool flag(int argc, char** argv, const char* name)
{
    for (int index = 1; index < argc; ++index)
        if (!std::strcmp(argv[index], name)) return true;
    return false;
}

void createDevice(Device& device, const vk::DeviceRequirements& requirements)
{
    VkApplicationInfo application{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO};
    application.apiVersion = vk::DeviceRequirements::apiVersion;
    VkInstanceCreateInfo instanceInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO};
    instanceInfo.pApplicationInfo = &application;
    VK_CHECK(vkCreateInstance(&instanceInfo, nullptr, &device.instance));
    uint32_t count = 0;
    VK_CHECK(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(device.instance, &count, nullptr));
    std::vector<VkPhysicalDevice> devices(count);
    VK_CHECK(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(device.instance, &count, devices.data()));
    for (const auto candidate : devices) {
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties properties{};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(candidate, &properties);
        if (properties.vendorID == 0x10de) { device.physical = candidate; break; }
    }
    require(device.physical != VK_NULL_HANDLE, "NVIDIA GPU required");
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(device.physical, &count, nullptr);
    std::vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> families(count);
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(device.physical, &count, families.data());
    for (uint32_t index = 0; index < count && device.family == UINT32_MAX; ++index)
        if ((families[index].queueFlags & (VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT | VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT))
            == (VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT | VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT)) device.family = index;
    require(device.family != UINT32_MAX, "graphics/compute queue required");
    const float priority = 1;
    VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo queue{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO};
    queue.queueFamilyIndex = device.family;
    queue.queueCount = 1;
    queue.pQueuePriorities = &priority;
    VkDeviceCreateInfo deviceInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO};
    deviceInfo.pNext = &requirements.features;
    deviceInfo.queueCreateInfoCount = 1;
    deviceInfo.pQueueCreateInfos = &queue;
    deviceInfo.enabledExtensionCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(requirements.extensions.size());
    deviceInfo.ppEnabledExtensionNames = requirements.extensions.data();
    VK_CHECK(vkCreateDevice(device.physical, &deviceInfo, nullptr, &device.device));
}

std::vector<uint8_t> readFile(const std::string& path)
{
    std::ifstream file(path, std::ios::binary);
    require(bool(file), "cannot read " + path);
    return {std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(file), std::istreambuf_iterator<char>()};
}

// The effect's composite for a frame without history at intensity 1 (dlss5_composite.comp).
uint8_t composeChannel(float head, float centred)
{
    const float inner = std::fmaf(head, 0.03125f, centred);
    const float neural = std::fmin(std::fmax(inner * 8.0f + 0.5f, 0.0f), 1.0f);
    uint16_t bits = num::f16Bits(neural);
    if (num::f16ToF32(bits) > neural) --bits;   // truncate to the half grid
    return static_cast<uint8_t>(std::lround(num::f16ToF32(bits) * 255.0f));
}

void compareImages(const std::vector<uint8_t>& actual, const std::vector<uint8_t>& expected, const std::string& name)
{
    require(actual.size() == expected.size(), name + " is not the output size");
    const size_t pixels = actual.size() / 4;
    size_t exact = 0, withinOne = 0;
    int largest = 0;
    double squared = 0, signedSum[3] = {};
    for (size_t pixel = 0; pixel < pixels; ++pixel) {
        int worst = 0;
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
            const int difference = int(actual[pixel * 4 + c]) - int(expected[pixel * 4 + c]);
            worst = std::max(worst, std::abs(difference));
            squared += double(difference) * difference;
            signedSum[c] += difference;
        }
        exact += worst == 0;
        withinOne += worst <= 1;
        largest = std::max(largest, worst);
    }
    const double mse = squared / (pixels * 3.0);
    std::printf("output vs %s: PSNR %.2f dB, mean difference %+.3f %+.3f %+.3f /255, %.2f%% pixels identical, "
        "%.2f%% within one step, largest %d\n", name.c_str(), mse ? 10 * std::log10(255.0 * 255.0 / mse) : INFINITY,
        signedSum[0] / pixels, signedSum[1] / pixels, signedSum[2] / pixels, 100.0 * exact / pixels,
        100.0 * withinOne / pixels, largest);
}
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    try {
        const std::string model = argument(argc, argv, "--model");
        const std::string shaders = argument(argc, argv, "--shaders");
        const std::string ptx = argument(argc, argv, "--ptx", shaders);
        require(!model.empty() && !shaders.empty(),
            "usage: vkhook-dlss5-bench --model DIR --shaders DIR [--ptx DIR] [--width W --height H --frames N] "
            "[--chain 0|1] [--profile] [--dump FILE] [--compare FILE] "
            "[--image FILE [--seed S] [--output FILE] [--expect FILE]]");
        const uint32_t width = std::stoul(argument(argc, argv, "--width", "1920"));
        const uint32_t height = std::stoul(argument(argc, argv, "--height", "1080"));
        const int frames = std::max(1, std::stoi(argument(argc, argv, "--frames", "40")));
        const bool profile = flag(argc, argv, "--profile");

        Loader loader;
        Device device;
        vk::DeviceRequirements requirements;
        createDevice(device, requirements);
        vk::Context context(device.instance, device.physical, device.device, device.family, 0,
            vkGetInstanceProcAddr, vkGetDeviceProcAddr);
        const auto& vkd = context.dispatch();
        std::printf("device: %s, %u SMs\n", context.deviceName().c_str(), context.smCount());

        nr::Model network(context, model, false);
        nr::Kernels kernels(context, shaders, ptx);
        // The effect's barrier schedule unless --chain 1 asks for upstream's counter chains; profile timings need
        // barriers between launches.
        kernels.setChainEnabled(argument(argc, argv, "--chain", "0") != "0" && !profile);
        kernels.setSiluTable(ref::siluTable());
        const nr::Geometry geometry = nr::Geometry::fromValid(width, height);
        nr::Graph graph(context, network, kernels, geometry, nr::Graph::Options{});
        const uint32_t fullRows = geometry.fullWidth * geometry.fullHeight;
        nr::Activation* features = graph.allocate("input features", fullRows, 16, nr::Format::F32);
        const std::string image = argument(argc, argv, "--image");
        std::vector<uint8_t> source;
        if (image.empty()) {
            std::vector<float> synthetic(static_cast<size_t>(fullRows) * 16);
            for (size_t index = 0; index < synthetic.size(); ++index)
                synthetic[index] = num::roundF16(std::sin(index * 0.0017f) * 0.125f);
            context.upload(features->buffer, synthetic.data(), synthetic.size() * sizeof(float));
        } else {
            source = readFile(image);
            require(source.size() == static_cast<size_t>(width) * height * 4,
                image + " is not a raw " + std::to_string(width) + "x" + std::to_string(height) + " RGBA8 frame");
            std::vector<float> proxy(source.size());
            for (size_t index = 0; index < source.size(); ++index) proxy[index] = source[index] / 255.0f;
            vk::Buffer proxyBuffer = context.createBuffer(proxy.size() * sizeof(float), false, "proxy");
            context.upload(proxyBuffer, proxy.data(), proxy.size() * sizeof(float));
            const nr::Kernels::PreprocessArgs conditioning{geometry.fullWidth, geometry.fullHeight, width, height, width,
                height, static_cast<uint32_t>(std::stoul(argument(argc, argv, "--seed", "0"))), true, 1.0f, 1.0f,
                -1.0f, 0.0f};
            VkCommandBuffer preprocess = context.beginCommands();
            kernels.preprocessFromProxy(preprocess, proxyBuffer, *features, conditioning);
            context.endAndSubmit(preprocess, true);
            context.destroyBuffer(proxyBuffer);
        }

        VkQueryPool queries = context.createTimestampPool(2);
        VkCommandPoolCreateInfo poolInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO};
        poolInfo.flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
        poolInfo.queueFamilyIndex = device.family;
        VkCommandPool pool{};
        VK_CHECK(vkd.vkCreateCommandPool(device.device, &poolInfo, nullptr, &pool));
        VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo allocation{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO};
        allocation.commandPool = pool;
        allocation.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
        allocation.commandBufferCount = 1;
        VkCommandBuffer commands{};
        VK_CHECK(vkd.vkAllocateCommandBuffers(device.device, &allocation, &commands));
        *reinterpret_cast<void**>(commands) = *reinterpret_cast<void**>(device.device);
        // Profiling pools are consumed per read, so profiled frames are re-recorded; timed frames are not.
        auto record = [&] {
            if (profile) context.resetDescriptorPool();
            VkCommandBufferBeginInfo begin{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO};
            VK_CHECK(vkd.vkBeginCommandBuffer(commands, &begin));
            vkd.vkCmdResetQueryPool(commands, queries, 0, 2);
            vkd.vkCmdWriteTimestamp(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, queries, 0);
            if (profile) kernels.beginProfile(commands, 4096);
            graph.record(commands, *features);
            vkd.vkCmdWriteTimestamp(commands, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, queries, 1);
            VK_CHECK(vkd.vkEndCommandBuffer(commands));
        };
        record();
        std::printf("%s network (%u blocks), %ux%u (field %ux%u), %u launches, %s, %llu MiB of pooled activations\n",
            graph.layout().name, graph.layout().blockCount(), width, height, geometry.fullWidth, geometry.fullHeight,
            kernels.dispatchCount(), graph.chained() ? "counter chaining" : "barriers",
            (unsigned long long)(graph.pooledBytes() >> 20));

        VkQueue queue = context.queue();
        VkSubmitInfo submit{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO};
        submit.commandBufferCount = 1;
        submit.pCommandBuffers = &commands;
        auto run = [&] {
            VK_CHECK(vkd.vkQueueSubmit(queue, 1, &submit, VK_NULL_HANDLE));
            VK_CHECK(vkd.vkQueueWaitIdle(queue));
            const auto timeouts = kernels.chainTimeouts();
            require(timeouts.waits == 0, "chained wait timed out on " + timeouts.counter);
            const auto stamps = context.readTimestampsMs(queries, 2);
            return stamps[1] - stamps[0];
        };
        for (int warm = 0; warm < 3; ++warm) run();   // JIT, clocks
        std::vector<double> samples;
        std::vector<nr::Kernels::ProfileEntry> best;
        for (int frame = 0; frame < frames; ++frame) {
            if (profile && frame) record();
            samples.push_back(run());
            if (!profile) continue;
            auto entries = kernels.endProfile();
            if (best.empty()) best = entries;
            for (size_t index = 0; index < entries.size() && index < best.size(); ++index)
                best[index].milliseconds = std::min(best[index].milliseconds, entries[index].milliseconds);
        }
        std::vector<double> sorted = samples;
        std::sort(sorted.begin(), sorted.end());
        std::printf("GPU min %.3f ms, median %.3f ms over %zu frames\n", sorted.front(), sorted[sorted.size() / 2],
            sorted.size());

        if (profile) {
            std::map<std::string, double> byKernel, byStage;
            double total = 0;
            for (const auto& entry : best) {
                const size_t bar = entry.label.find(" | ");
                byStage[entry.label.substr(0, bar)] += entry.milliseconds;
                byKernel[entry.label.substr(bar + 3)] += entry.milliseconds;
                total += entry.milliseconds;
            }
            auto print = [&](const char* title, const std::map<std::string, double>& totals) {
                std::vector<std::pair<std::string, double>> rows(totals.begin(), totals.end());
                std::sort(rows.begin(), rows.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.second > b.second; });
                std::printf("\n%s:\n", title);
                for (const auto& [label, ms] : rows) std::printf("  %8.3f ms %5.1f%%  %s\n", ms, 100 * ms / total, label.c_str());
            };
            std::printf("sum of launch spans %.3f ms\n", total);
            print("by kernel", byKernel);
            print("by stage", byStage);
        }

        const nr::Activation& head = graph.head();
        const auto bytes = context.download(head.buffer, head.validBytes());
        const std::string dump = argument(argc, argv, "--dump");
        if (!dump.empty()) {
            std::ofstream(dump, std::ios::binary).write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(bytes.data()), bytes.size());
            std::printf("head written to %s\n", dump.c_str());
        }
        const std::string compare = argument(argc, argv, "--compare");
        int status = 0;
        if (!compare.empty()) {
            const auto expected = readFile(compare);
            require(expected.size() == bytes.size(), "head size differs from " + compare);
            size_t differing = 0;
            for (size_t index = 0; index < bytes.size(); index += 4)
                differing += std::memcmp(&bytes[index], &expected[index], 4) != 0;
            std::printf("head vs %s: %s (%zu of %zu values differ)\n", compare.c_str(),
                differing ? "MISMATCH" : "bit-exact", differing, bytes.size() / 4);
            status = differing ? 1 : 0;
        }
        if (!image.empty()) {
            const auto lanes = context.download(features->buffer, features->validBytes());
            const float* centred = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(lanes.data());
            const float* rgbw = reinterpret_cast<const float*>(bytes.data());
            std::vector<uint8_t> composed(source.size());
            for (uint32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
                for (uint32_t x = 0; x < width; ++x) {
                    const size_t pixel = static_cast<size_t>(y) * width + x;
                    const size_t padded = static_cast<size_t>(y) * geometry.fullWidth + x;
                    for (int c = 0; c < 3; ++c)
                        composed[pixel * 4 + c] = composeChannel(rgbw[padded * 4 + c], centred[padded * 16 + 4 + c]);
                    composed[pixel * 4 + 3] = source[pixel * 4 + 3];
                }
            const std::string output = argument(argc, argv, "--output");
            if (!output.empty()) {
                std::ofstream(output, std::ios::binary).write(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(composed.data()), composed.size());
                std::printf("output written to %s\n", output.c_str());
            }
            const std::string expect = argument(argc, argv, "--expect");
            if (!expect.empty()) compareImages(composed, readFile(expect), expect);
        }
        vkd.vkDestroyQueryPool(device.device, queries, nullptr);
        vkd.vkDestroyCommandPool(device.device, pool, nullptr);
        return status;
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "vkhook-dlss5-bench: %s\n", error.what());
        return 1;
    }
}

```

// Opt-in NVIDIA GPU regression: production optical flow + temporal shaders.
// No model weights required; the neural head is controlled to expose blending.
#define VK_NO_PROTOTYPES

void require(bool condition, const char* message)
{
    if (!condition) throw std::runtime_error(message);
}
// Resolve the host loader at runtime, rather than linking a cross-built test
// against a loader that may require newer glibc symbols than the target ABI.
#define VULKAN_ENTRYPOINTS(X) \
    X(vkGetInstanceProcAddr) X(vkGetDeviceProcAddr) \
    X(vkCreateInstance) X(vkDestroyInstance) X(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices) \
    X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties) \
    X(vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties) X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2) \
    X(vkCreateDevice) X(vkDestroyDevice) X(vkGetDeviceQueue) X(vkDeviceWaitIdle) \
    X(vkCreateCommandPool) X(vkDestroyCommandPool) X(vkAllocateCommandBuffers) \
    X(vkCreateFence) X(vkDestroyFence) X(vkWaitForFences) X(vkResetFences) \
    X(vkCreateImage) X(vkDestroyImage) X(vkGetImageMemoryRequirements) \
    X(vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties) X(vkAllocateMemory) X(vkFreeMemory) \
    X(vkBindImageMemory) X(vkCmdBindPipeline) X(vkCmdBindDescriptorSets) \
    X(vkCmdDispatch) X(vkCmdPipelineBarrier2) X(vkCmdCopyBufferToImage) \
    X(vkResetCommandBuffer) X(vkBeginCommandBuffer) X(vkEndCommandBuffer) \
    X(vkCmdFillBuffer) X(vkCmdCopyBuffer) X(vkQueueSubmit)
#define DECLARE_ENTRYPOINT(name) PFN_##name name{};
VULKAN_ENTRYPOINTS(DECLARE_ENTRYPOINT)
#undef DECLARE_ENTRYPOINT
struct Loader {
    std::unique_ptr<void, int (*)(void*)> library{dlopen("libvulkan.so.1", RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL), dlclose};
    Loader()
    {
        require(bool(library), "Vulkan loader unavailable");
#define LOAD_ENTRYPOINT(name) \
        name = reinterpret_cast<PFN_##name>(dlsym(library.get(), #name)); \
        require(name != nullptr, "Vulkan loader missing " #name);
        VULKAN_ENTRYPOINTS(LOAD_ENTRYPOINT)
#undef LOAD_ENTRYPOINT
    }
};
#undef VULKAN_ENTRYPOINTS
constexpr uint32_t width = 321, height = 241, pixels = width * height;
struct Image {
    VkImage image{};
    VkDeviceMemory memory{};
};
struct Runtime {
    VkInstance instance{};
    VkDevice device{};
    VkCommandPool pool{};
    VkFence fence{};
    Image source;
    ~Runtime()
    {
        if (device) {
            vkDeviceWaitIdle(device);
            if (fence) vkDestroyFence(device, fence, nullptr);
            if (pool) vkDestroyCommandPool(device, pool, nullptr);
            if (source.image) vkDestroyImage(device, source.image, nullptr);
            if (source.memory) vkFreeMemory(device, source.memory, nullptr);
            vkDestroyDevice(device, nullptr);
        }
        if (instance) vkDestroyInstance(instance, nullptr);
    }
};
uint32_t pixel(uint32_t x, uint32_t y)
{
    // Smooth, nonrepeating texture within a limited gamut. The scene cut's
    // blue/cyan values are deliberately outside this gamut.
    const float value = .5f + .18f * std::sin(x * .12f + y * .03f)
        + .16f * std::cos(y * .17f - x * .04f) + .1f * std::sin(x * .31f + y * .23f);
    const uint32_t r = static_cast<uint32_t>(70 + value * 110);
    const uint32_t g = static_cast<uint32_t>(35 + value * 100);
    const uint32_t b = static_cast<uint32_t>(20 + value * 65);
    return r | (g << 8) | (b << 16) | ((64 + x % 129) << 24);
}
template<typename T> std::vector<T> download(vk::Context& context, const vk::Buffer& buffer)
{
    const auto bytes = context.download(buffer, buffer.size);
    std::vector<T> result(bytes.size() / sizeof(T));
    std::memcpy(result.data(), bytes.data(), bytes.size());
    return result;
}
}

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
    if (!std::getenv("VKHOOK_TEST_DLSS5_GPU")) return 77;
    try {
        require(argc == 2, "pass the compiled DLSS5 shader directory");
        Loader loader;
        Runtime runtime;
        VkApplicationInfo application{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_APPLICATION_INFO};
        application.apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_3;
        VkInstanceCreateInfo instanceInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_INSTANCE_CREATE_INFO};
        instanceInfo.pApplicationInfo = &application;
        VK_CHECK(vkCreateInstance(&instanceInfo, nullptr, &runtime.instance));
        uint32_t count = 0;
        VK_CHECK(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(runtime.instance, &count, nullptr));
        std::vector<VkPhysicalDevice> devices(count);
        VK_CHECK(vkEnumeratePhysicalDevices(runtime.instance, &count, devices.data()));
        VkPhysicalDevice physical{};
        VkPhysicalDeviceProperties properties{};
        for (const auto candidate : devices) {
            vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties(candidate, &properties);
            if (properties.vendorID == 0x10de) { physical = candidate; break; }
        }
        require(physical != VK_NULL_HANDLE, "NVIDIA GPU required");
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(physical, &count, nullptr);
        std::vector<VkQueueFamilyProperties> families(count);
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceQueueFamilyProperties(physical, &count, families.data());
        uint32_t graphics = UINT32_MAX, optical = UINT32_MAX;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
            if ((families[i].queueFlags & (VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT | VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT))
                == (VK_QUEUE_GRAPHICS_BIT | VK_QUEUE_COMPUTE_BIT)) graphics = i;
            if (families[i].queueFlags & VK_QUEUE_OPTICAL_FLOW_BIT_NV) optical = i;
        }
        require(graphics != UINT32_MAX && optical != UINT32_MAX && optical != graphics, "separate graphics/optical queues required");
        VK_CHECK(vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(physical, nullptr, &count, nullptr));
        std::vector<VkExtensionProperties> extensions(count);
        VK_CHECK(vkEnumerateDeviceExtensionProperties(physical, nullptr, &count, extensions.data()));
        const float priority = 1;
        VkDeviceQueueCreateInfo queues[2]{};
        for (auto& queue : queues) {
            queue.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_QUEUE_CREATE_INFO;
            queue.queueCount = 1; queue.pQueuePriorities = &priority;
        }
        queues[0].queueFamilyIndex = graphics; queues[1].queueFamilyIndex = optical;
        VkDeviceCreateInfo deviceInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEVICE_CREATE_INFO};
        deviceInfo.queueCreateInfoCount = 2; deviceInfo.pQueueCreateInfos = queues;
        Dlss5DeviceFeatures features;
        std::vector<const char*> enabled;
        require(features.prepare(physical, VK_API_VERSION_1_3, vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2,
            properties, extensions, deviceInfo, enabled, true), features.error().c_str());
        require(features.opticalFlowEnabled(), "opticalFlow feature unavailable");
        VK_CHECK(vkCreateDevice(physical, &deviceInfo, nullptr, &runtime.device));
        VkQueue opticalQueue{};
        vkGetDeviceQueue(runtime.device, optical, 0, &opticalQueue);
        vk::Context context(runtime.instance, physical, runtime.device, graphics, 0,
                            vkGetInstanceProcAddr, vkGetDeviceProcAddr);
        VkCommandPoolCreateInfo poolInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO};
        poolInfo.queueFamilyIndex = graphics;
        poolInfo.flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
        VK_CHECK(vkCreateCommandPool(runtime.device, &poolInfo, nullptr, &runtime.pool));
        VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo commandInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO};
        commandInfo.commandPool = runtime.pool; commandInfo.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
        commandInfo.commandBufferCount = 1;
        VkCommandBuffer commands{};
        VK_CHECK(vkAllocateCommandBuffers(runtime.device, &commandInfo, &commands));
        VkFenceCreateInfo fenceInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO};
        VK_CHECK(vkCreateFence(runtime.device, &fenceInfo, nullptr, &runtime.fence));
        VkImageCreateInfo imageInfo{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO};
        imageInfo.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D; imageInfo.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        imageInfo.extent = {width, height, 1}; imageInfo.mipLevels = imageInfo.arrayLayers = 1;
        imageInfo.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT; imageInfo.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
        imageInfo.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
        VK_CHECK(vkCreateImage(runtime.device, &imageInfo, nullptr, &runtime.source.image));
        VkMemoryRequirements memory{};
        vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(runtime.device, runtime.source.image, &memory);
        VkPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties memoryProperties{};
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceMemoryProperties(physical, &memoryProperties);
        VkMemoryAllocateInfo allocation{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO};
        allocation.allocationSize = memory.size; allocation.memoryTypeIndex = UINT32_MAX;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < memoryProperties.memoryTypeCount; ++i)
            if ((memory.memoryTypeBits & (1u << i)) && (memoryProperties.memoryTypes[i].propertyFlags & VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT)) {
                allocation.memoryTypeIndex = i; break;
            }
        require(allocation.memoryTypeIndex != UINT32_MAX, "image memory unavailable");
        VK_CHECK(vkAllocateMemory(runtime.device, &allocation, nullptr, &runtime.source.memory));
        VK_CHECK(vkBindImageMemory(runtime.device, runtime.source.image, runtime.source.memory, 0));
        Dlss5OpticalFlow flow(context, optical, opticalQueue, {width, height}, imageInfo.format,
                             {runtime.source.image}, argv[1], vkGetInstanceProcAddr, vkGetDeviceProcAddr);
        auto input = context.createBuffer(pixels * 4, false, "test input");
        auto previous = context.createBuffer(pixels * 4, false, "test previous input");
        auto history = context.createBuffer(pixels * 16, false, "test neural history");
        auto reprojection = context.createBuffer(16 + pixels * 16, false, "test reprojection");
        auto packedOutput = context.createBuffer(pixels * 4, false, "test output");
        auto tensor = context.createBuffer(pixels * 64, false, "test features");
        auto head = context.createBuffer(pixels * 16, false, "test neural head");
        auto parameters = context.createBuffer(sizeof(Dlss5Parameters), true, "test parameters");
        Dlss5Parameters params{};
        params.width = params.fullWidth = width; params.height = params.fullHeight = height;
        params.intensity = params.localTone = params.localStructure = params.historyStrength = 1;
        params.skinStructure = -1; params.temporal = 1;
        params.flowWidth = flow.flowWidth(); params.flowHeight = flow.flowHeight();
        auto pipeline = [&](const char* name) {
            return context.createComputePipeline(context.loadShaderModule(std::string(argv[1]) + "/" + name + ".spv"), {}, name);
        };
        auto reprojectPipeline = pipeline("dlss5_reproject");
        auto preprocessPipeline = pipeline("dlss5_preprocess");
        auto compositePipeline = pipeline("dlss5_composite");
        const vk::Buffer* bindings[vk::kGenericBindings]{};
        bindings[0] = &input; bindings[1] = &parameters; bindings[2] = &previous;
        bindings[3] = &history; bindings[4] = &flow.forward(); bindings[5] = &flow.backward();
        bindings[6] = &flow.cost(); bindings[7] = &reprojection;
        const auto reprojectSet = context.allocateSet(bindings);
        std::fill(std::begin(bindings), std::end(bindings), nullptr);
        bindings[0] = &input; bindings[1] = &parameters; bindings[2] = &reprojection; bindings[7] = &tensor;
        const auto preprocessSet = context.allocateSet(bindings);
        bindings[2] = &head; bindings[3] = &tensor; bindings[4] = &reprojection;
        bindings[5] = &history; bindings[6] = &flow.forward(); bindings[7] = &packedOutput;
        const auto compositeSet = context.allocateSet(bindings);
        std::vector<uint32_t> source(pixels);
        std::vector<float> neuralHead(pixels * 4, 0);
        bool initialized = false;
        struct Drain {
            VkDevice device;
            ~Drain() { vkDeviceWaitIdle(device); }
        } drain{runtime.device};
        auto dispatch = [&](const vk::Pipeline& p, VkDescriptorSet set) {
            vkCmdBindPipeline(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, p.pipeline);
            vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(commands, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, context.pipelineLayout(), 0, 1, &set, 0, nullptr);
            vkCmdDispatch(commands, (width + 7) / 8, (height + 7) / 8, 1);
            context.transferBarrier(commands);
        };
        auto frame = [&]() {
            context.upload(input, source.data(), pixels * 4);
            context.upload(head, neuralHead.data(), pixels * 16);
            std::memcpy(parameters.mapped, &params, sizeof(params));
            auto upload = context.beginCommands();
            VkImageMemoryBarrier2 barrier{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER_2};
            barrier.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT;
            barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_WRITE_BIT;
            barrier.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT; barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
            barrier.oldLayout = initialized ? VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR : VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
            barrier.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
            barrier.srcQueueFamilyIndex = barrier.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
            barrier.image = runtime.source.image; barrier.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
            VkDependencyInfo dependency{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DEPENDENCY_INFO};
            dependency.imageMemoryBarrierCount = 1; dependency.pImageMemoryBarriers = &barrier;
            vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(upload, &dependency);
            context.transferBarrier(upload);
            VkBufferImageCopy copy{}; copy.imageSubresource = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1};
            copy.imageExtent = {width, height, 1};
            vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(upload, input.buffer, runtime.source.image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &copy);
            barrier.oldLayout = barrier.newLayout; barrier.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR;
            barrier.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_TRANSFER_BIT; barrier.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
            barrier.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_2_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT; barrier.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_2_MEMORY_READ_BIT;
            vkCmdPipelineBarrier2(upload, &dependency);
            context.endAndSubmit(upload); initialized = true;
            VkSubmitInfo submission{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO};
            if (params.temporal) VK_CHECK(flow.prepare(0, submission));
            VK_CHECK(vkResetCommandBuffer(commands, 0));
            VkCommandBufferBeginInfo begin{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO};
            VK_CHECK(vkBeginCommandBuffer(commands, &begin));

                flow.recordResults(commands);
                vkCmdFillBuffer(commands, reprojection.buffer, 0, 16, 0);
                context.transferBarrier(commands);
                dispatch(reprojectPipeline, reprojectSet);
            }
            dispatch(preprocessPipeline, preprocessSet);
            dispatch(compositePipeline, compositeSet);
            VkBufferCopy previousCopy{0, 0, pixels * 4};
            vkCmdCopyBuffer(commands, input.buffer, previous.buffer, 1, &previousCopy);
            context.transferBarrier(commands);
            VK_CHECK(vkEndCommandBuffer(commands));
            submission.commandBufferCount = 1; submission.pCommandBuffers = &commands;
            VK_CHECK(vkQueueSubmit(context.queue(), 1, &submission, runtime.fence));
            VK_CHECK(vkWaitForFences(runtime.device, 1, &runtime.fence, VK_TRUE, 30'000'000'000ull));
            VK_CHECK(vkResetFences(runtime.device, 1, &runtime.fence));
            const auto output = download<uint32_t>(context, packedOutput);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pixels; ++i) require((output[i] >> 24) == (source[i] >> 24), "alpha changed");
            return output;
        };
        auto requireNoHistory = [&]() {
            const auto features = download<float>(context, tensor);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pixels; ++i)
                for (uint32_t c = 0; c < 3; ++c)
                    require(features[i * 16 + 4 + c] == features[i * 16 + 7 + c], "invalid history reached model input");
        };
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < width; ++x) source[y * width + x] = pixel(x, y);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pixels; ++i) neuralHead[i * 4] = .5f;
        frame(); requireNoHistory();
        std::cout << "PASS first frame uses no history\n";
        params.historyValid = 1;
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
            for (uint32_t x = 0; x < width; ++x)
                source[y * width + x] = x >= 8 && y >= 4 ? pixel(x - 8, y - 4) : 0xffeeee05u;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pixels; ++i) neuralHead[i * 4] = -.5f;
        const auto translated = frame();

        std::vector<float> dx, dy;
        for (uint32_t y = 8; y + 8 < params.flowHeight; ++y)
            for (uint32_t x = 8; x + 8 < params.flowWidth; ++x) {
                const auto packed = forward[y * params.flowWidth + x];
                dx.push_back(static_cast<int16_t>(packed & 0xffffu) / 32.f);
                dy.push_back(static_cast<int16_t>(packed >> 16) / 32.f);
            }
        std::sort(dx.begin(), dx.end()); std::sort(dy.begin(), dy.end());
        std::cout << "Motion median: " << dx[dx.size()/2] << ", " << dy[dy.size()/2] << '\n';
        require(std::abs(dx[dx.size()/2] + 8) < 1.5f && std::abs(dy[dy.size()/2] + 4) < 1.5f, "optical motion direction/scale wrong");
        const auto repro = download<float>(context, reprojection);
        uint32_t accepted = 0; std::memcpy(&accepted, repro.data(), sizeof(accepted));
        std::cout << "Accepted history pixels: " << accepted << '/' << pixels << '\n';
        require(accepted > pixels / 2, "textured translation rejected globally");
        for (uint32_t y = 16; y + 16 < height; ++y)
            require(repro[4 + (y * width + 2) * 4 + 3] == 0, "newly uncovered region reused history");
        // Re-render the same temporal data: diagnostics must not poison feedback
        // or reset history, even at zero display intensity.
        const auto normalHistory = download<float>(context, history);
        auto debugComposite = [&](uint32_t mode) {
            params.debugView = mode;
            std::memcpy(parameters.mapped, &params, sizeof(params));
            auto cb = context.beginCommands();
            vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, compositePipeline.pipeline);
            vkCmdBindDescriptorSets(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_COMPUTE, context.pipelineLayout(), 0, 1, &compositeSet, 0, nullptr);
            vkCmdDispatch(cb, (width + 7) / 8, (height + 7) / 8, 1);
            context.transferBarrier(cb);
            context.endAndSubmit(cb);
            return download<uint32_t>(context, packedOutput);
        };
        const uint32_t center = (height / 2) * width + width / 2;
        require(repro[4 + center * 4 + 3] > .5f, "debug fixture center lacks reliable history");
        params.intensity = 0;
        for (uint32_t mode = 1; mode <= 4; ++mode) {
            const auto image = debugComposite(mode);
            require(download<float>(context, history) == normalHistory, "debug visualization poisoned neural feedback");
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pixels; ++i)
                require((image[i] >> 24) == (source[i] >> 24), "debug view changed alpha");
            require((image[0] & 0xffffffu) == 0x00ff00u, "accepted-frame status strip incorrect");
            const uint32_t color = image[center];
            if (mode == 1) {
                const auto r = color & 255u, g = (color >> 8) & 255u, b = (color >> 16) & 255u;
                require(r == 0 && g > 20 && b > g && b > 100, "debug flow hue/magnitude does not show current-to-previous motion");
            } else {
                for (uint32_t c = 0; c < 3; ++c) {
                    const float expected = mode == 2 ? (c == 1 ? repro[4 + center * 4 + 3] : 0.f)
                        : mode == 3 ? repro[4 + center * 4 + c] : .5f * repro[4 + center * 4 + 3];
                    require(std::abs(float((color >> (c * 8)) & 255u) - expected * 255.f) <= 1.f,
                        "debug view does not match accepted history/confidence/blend");
                }
                require((image[32 * width + 2] & 0xffffffu) == 0, "debug view displays rejected disocclusion as valid history");
            }
        }
        params.historyValid = 0;
        require((debugComposite(1)[0] & 0xffffffu) == 0x00a6ffu, "debug reset status incorrect");
        params.temporal = 0;
        require((debugComposite(1)[0] & 0xffffffu) == 0xff00ffu, "debug temporal-off status incorrect");
        params.historyValid = 1; params.intensity = 1; params.debugView = 0;
        std::cout << "PASS live debug motion/confidence/history/weight, reset/off status, alpha, and unmodified feedback\n";
        params.temporal = 0;
        const auto unblended = frame(); requireNoHistory();
        uint32_t blended = 0;
        for (uint32_t y = 32; y + 32 < height; ++y)
            for (uint32_t x = 32; x + 32 < width; ++x) {
                const auto i = y * width + x;
                if ((translated[i] & 255) > (unblended[i] & 255) + 5) ++blended;
            }
        require(blended > pixels / 4, "valid reprojected history did not affect neural composite");
        std::cout << "PASS translated history affects composite; disocclusion rejected; temporal off bypasses history\n";
        // A large untextured background must not invalidate a moving object's
        // reliable history simply because fewer than half the pixels have flow.
        auto objectScene = [&](uint32_t sx, uint32_t sy) {
            std::fill(source.begin(), source.end(), 0x80333333u);
            for (uint32_t y = height / 3; y < 2 * height / 3; ++y)
                for (uint32_t x = width / 4; x < 3 * width / 4; ++x)
                    source[(y + sy) * width + x + sx] = pixel(x, y);
        };
        params.temporal = 1; params.historyValid = 0;
        objectScene(0, 0);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pixels; ++i) neuralHead[i * 4] = .5f;
        frame();
        params.historyValid = 1;
        objectScene(8, 4);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < pixels; ++i) neuralHead[i * 4] = -.5f;
        const auto objectBlended = frame();
        params.temporal = 0;
        const auto objectUnblended = frame();
        uint32_t objectChanges = 0;
        for (uint32_t y = height / 3 + 16; y < 2 * height / 3 - 16; ++y)
            for (uint32_t x = width / 4 + 24; x < 3 * width / 4 - 16; ++x) {
                const auto i = y * width + x;
                if ((objectBlended[i] & 255) > (objectUnblended[i] & 255) + 5) ++objectChanges;
            }
        require(objectChanges > pixels / 100, "textureless background invalidated reliable object history");
        std::cout << "PASS moving object retains history against untextured background\n";
        params.temporal = params.historyValid = 1;
        std::fill(source.begin(), source.end(), 0x7fffed05u);
        const auto cut = frame(); requireNoHistory();
        params.temporal = 0;
        require(cut == frame(), "scene cut differs from no-history output");
        std::cout << "PASS scene cut rejects history globally\n";
        params.temporal = 1; params.historyValid = 0; params.intensity = 0;
        require(frame() == source, "zero intensity not byte-exact"); requireNoHistory();
        std::cout << "PASS explicit reset, byte-exact zero intensity, preserved alpha, odd dimensions\n";
        for (auto* p : {&reprojectPipeline, &preprocessPipeline, &compositePipeline}) context.destroyPipeline(*p);
        for (auto* b : {&input, &previous, &history, &reprojection, &packedOutput, &tensor, &head, &parameters}) context.destroyBuffer(*b);
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        std::cerr << "FAIL: " << error.what() << '\n';
        return 1;
    }
}

    ui_min = 0.0; ui_max = 1000.0;

float GetLinearizedDepth(float2 texcoord)
{
    if (!bUIUseLivePreview)
    {
        return ReShade::GetLinearizedDepth(texcoord);
    }
    else
    {
        if (iUIUpsideDown) // RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_UPSIDE_DOWN
            texcoord.y = 1.0 - texcoord.y;

        texcoord.x /= fUIScale.x; // RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_SCALE
        texcoord.y /= fUIScale.y; // RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_SCALE
        texcoord.x -= iUIOffset.x * BUFFER_RCP_WIDTH; // RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_PIXEL_OFFSET
        texcoord.y += iUIOffset.y * BUFFER_RCP_HEIGHT; // RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_PIXEL_OFFSET

        float depth = tex2Dlod(ReShade::DepthBuffer, float4(texcoord, 0, 0)).x * fUIDepthMultiplier;

        const float C = 0.01;
        if (iUILogarithmic) // RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_LOGARITHMIC
            depth = (exp(depth * log(C + 1.0)) - 1.0) / C;

        if (iUIReversed) // RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_REVERSED
            depth = 1.0 - depth;

        const float N = 1.0;
        depth /= fUIFarPlane - depth * (fUIFarPlane - N);

        return depth;
    }
}

float3 GetScreenSpaceNormal(float2 texcoord)
{
    float3 offset = float3(BUFFER_PIXEL_SIZE, 0.0);
    float2 posCenter = texcoord.xy;
    float2 posNorth  = posCenter - offset.zy;
    float2 posEast   = posCenter + offset.xz;

    float3 vertCenter = float3(posCenter - 0.5, 1) * GetLinearizedDepth(posCenter);
    float3 vertNorth  = float3(posNorth - 0.5,  1) * GetLinearizedDepth(posNorth);
    float3 vertEast   = float3(posEast - 0.5,   1) * GetLinearizedDepth(posEast);

    return normalize(cross(vertCenter - vertNorth, vertCenter - vertEast)) * 0.5 + 0.5;
}

void PS_DisplayDepth(in float4 position : SV_Position, in float2 texcoord : TEXCOORD, out float3 color : SV_Target)
{
    float3 depth = GetLinearizedDepth(texcoord).xxx;
    float3 normal = GetScreenSpaceNormal(texcoord);

    // Ordered dithering
#if 1
    const float dither_bit = 8.0; // Number of bits per channel. Should be 8 for most monitors.
    // Calculate grid position
    float grid_position = frac(dot(texcoord, (BUFFER_SCREEN_SIZE * float2(1.0 / 16.0, 10.0 / 36.0)) + 0.25));
    // Calculate how big the shift should be
    float dither_shift = 0.25 * (1.0 / (pow(2, dither_bit) - 1.0));
    // Shift the individual colors differently, thus making it even harder to see the dithering pattern
    float3 dither_shift_RGB = float3(dither_shift, -dither_shift, dither_shift); // Subpixel dithering
    // Modify shift acording to grid position.
    dither_shift_RGB = lerp(2.0 * dither_shift_RGB, -2.0 * dither_shift_RGB, grid_position);
    depth += dither_shift_RGB;
#endif

    color = depth;
    if (iUIPresentType == 1)
        color = normal;
    if (iUIPresentType == 2)
        color = lerp(normal, depth, step(BUFFER_WIDTH * 0.5, position.x));

    if (bUIShowOffset)
    {
        float3 color_orig = tex2D(ReShade::BackBuffer, texcoord).rgb;

        // Blend depth and back buffer color with 'overlay' so the offset is more noticeable
        color = lerp(2 * color * color_orig, 1.0 - 2.0 * (1.0 - color) * (1.0 - color_orig), max(color.r, max(color.g, color.b)) < 0.5 ? 0.0 : 1.0);
    }
}

technique DisplayDepth <
    ui_tooltip =
        "This shader helps you set the right preprocessor settings for depth input.\n"
        "To set the settings click on 'Edit global preprocessor definitions' and set them there - not in this shader.\n"
        "The settings will then take effect for all shaders, including this one.\n"  
        "\n"
        "By default calculated normals and depth are shown side by side.\n"
        "Normals (on the left) should look smooth and the ground should be greenish when looking at the horizon.\n"
        "Depth (on the right) should show close objects as dark and use gradually brighter shades the further away objects are.\n";
	UI_TECHNIQUE_L10N
>

{
    pass
    {
        VertexShader = PostProcessVS;
        PixelShader = PS_DisplayDepth;
    }
}

`src/tests/fixtures/OutParameterConversion.fx`:

```fx
#include "ReShade.fxh"

void WriteHit(out bool hit) { hit = true; }
void Increment(inout int value) { value += 1; }
void WritePair(out bool2 flags) { flags = bool2(true, false); }

float4 OutParameterConversion(float4 position : SV_Position, float2 uv : TEXCOORD) : SV_Target
{
    float hit;
    WriteHit(hit);
    float count = 2.75;
    Increment(count);
    float4 channels = 0;
    WritePair(channels.yx);
    uint values[2];
    WriteHit(values[int(uv.x > 0.5)]);
    return float4(hit, count / 3.0, channels.y, 1.0);
}

technique OutParameterConversion
{
    pass
    {
        VertexShader = PostProcessVS;
        PixelShader = OutParameterConversion;
    }
}

`src/tests/fixtures/README.md`:

```md
# test fixtures

Third-party shader files used by `src/tests/smoke_vkcube.sh`, which boots the
built layer under `vkcube` with one depth-consuming effect enabled so the run
exercises the depth capture and resolve path rather than the pass-through path.

These are vendored rather than generated. The smoke test previously used a
hand-written effect, which proved the path ran but asked nothing of the real
compile pipeline: a full, community-maintained shader with uniform
preprocessor definitions, a localisation include and a large UI parameter set
is a much better exercise of the same machinery.

| file | origin | licence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `ReShade.fxh` | ReShade | `CC0-1.0`, stated in its own header |
| `DisplayDepth.fx` | CeeJay.dk, with additions from the ReShade community | **none stated in the file** |
| `DisplayDepth_L10N.fxh` | ReShade community translations | **none stated in the file** |

copied verbatim from a local `EffectPackages.ini` install, so they are exactly
what a user's own shader directory contains.

## the licence gap

`ReShade.fxh` is explicitly CC0. The other two name an author and the
community but carry no licence identifier, and this repository is zlib. That is
an unresolved question rather than a settled one, and it is recorded here so it
is not discovered later by accident.

If it needs closing, the options are to obtain an explicit grant from the
authors, to replace these two with the hand-written effect the smoke test used
before, or to drop the effect-enabled path from the test and test the
pass-through path only. None of those are decisions to make silently in a test
fixture.

## updating them

These are copies, not mirrors. If the upstream shader gains a fix, nothing here
picks it up automatically, and the smoke test will keep testing whichever
version was copied in. Refresh deliberately:

```bash
cp ~/.config/VkHook/reshade/packages/Shaders/{DisplayDepth.fx,ReShade.fxh,DisplayDepth_L10N.fxh} src/tests/fixtures/
```

then confirm it still compiles and still reports depth usage:

```bash
build/src/vkhook-shader-check --include src/tests/fixtures src/tests/fixtures/DisplayDepth.fx
```

`success: true` and `usesDepth: true` are both required. A fixture that stops
using depth would silently turn the smoke test back into a pass-through run.

```

`src/tests/fixtures/ReShade.fxh`:

```fxh
/*
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0
 */

#pragma once

#if !defined(__RESHADE__) || __RESHADE__ < 30000
	#error "ReShade 3.0+ is required to use this header file"
#endif

#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_UPSIDE_DOWN
	#define RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_UPSIDE_DOWN 0
#endif
#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_REVERSED
	#define RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_REVERSED 1
#endif
#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_MIRRORED
        #define RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_MIRRORED 0
#endif
#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_LOGARITHMIC
	#define RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_LOGARITHMIC 0
#endif

#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_MULTIPLIER
	#define RESHADE_DEPTH_MULTIPLIER 1
#endif
#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_LINEARIZATION_FAR_PLANE
	#define RESHADE_DEPTH_LINEARIZATION_FAR_PLANE 1000.0
#endif

// Above 1 expands coordinates, below 1 contracts and 1 is equal to no scaling on any axis
#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_SCALE
	#define RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_SCALE 1
#endif
#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_SCALE
	#define RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_SCALE 1
#endif
// An offset to add to the Y coordinate, (+) = move up, (-) = move down
#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_OFFSET
	#define RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_OFFSET 0
#endif
#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_PIXEL_OFFSET
	#define RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_PIXEL_OFFSET 0
#endif
// An offset to add to the X coordinate, (+) = move right, (-) = move left
#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_OFFSET
	#define RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_OFFSET 0
#endif
#ifndef RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_PIXEL_OFFSET
	#define RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_PIXEL_OFFSET 0
#endif

#define BUFFER_PIXEL_SIZE float2(BUFFER_RCP_WIDTH, BUFFER_RCP_HEIGHT)
#define BUFFER_SCREEN_SIZE float2(BUFFER_WIDTH, BUFFER_HEIGHT)
#define BUFFER_ASPECT_RATIO (BUFFER_WIDTH * BUFFER_RCP_HEIGHT)

namespace ReShade
{
#if defined(__RESHADE_FXC__)
	float GetAspectRatio() { return BUFFER_WIDTH * BUFFER_RCP_HEIGHT; }
	float2 GetPixelSize() { return float2(BUFFER_RCP_WIDTH, BUFFER_RCP_HEIGHT); }
	float2 GetScreenSize() { return float2(BUFFER_WIDTH, BUFFER_HEIGHT); }
	#define AspectRatio GetAspectRatio()
	#define PixelSize GetPixelSize()
	#define ScreenSize GetScreenSize()
#else
	// These are deprecated and will be removed eventually.
	static const float AspectRatio = BUFFER_WIDTH * BUFFER_RCP_HEIGHT;
	static const float2 PixelSize = float2(BUFFER_RCP_WIDTH, BUFFER_RCP_HEIGHT);
	static const float2 ScreenSize = float2(BUFFER_WIDTH, BUFFER_HEIGHT);
#endif

	// Global textures and samplers
	texture BackBufferTex : COLOR;
	texture DepthBufferTex : DEPTH;

	sampler BackBuffer { Texture = BackBufferTex; };
	sampler DepthBuffer { Texture = DepthBufferTex; };

	// Helper functions
	float GetLinearizedDepth(float2 texcoord)
	{
#if RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_UPSIDE_DOWN
		texcoord.y = 1.0 - texcoord.y;
#endif
#if RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_MIRRORED
                texcoord.x = 1.0 - texcoord.x;
#endif
		texcoord.x /= RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_SCALE;
		texcoord.y /= RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_SCALE;
#if RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_PIXEL_OFFSET
		texcoord.x -= RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_PIXEL_OFFSET * BUFFER_RCP_WIDTH;
#else // Do not check RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_OFFSET, since it may be a decimal number, which the preprocessor cannot handle
		texcoord.x -= RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_X_OFFSET / 2.000000001;
#endif
#if RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_PIXEL_OFFSET
		texcoord.y += RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_PIXEL_OFFSET * BUFFER_RCP_HEIGHT;
#else
		texcoord.y += RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_Y_OFFSET / 2.000000001;
#endif
		float depth = tex2Dlod(DepthBuffer, float4(texcoord, 0, 0)).x * RESHADE_DEPTH_MULTIPLIER;

#if RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_LOGARITHMIC
		const float C = 0.01;
		depth = (exp(depth * log(C + 1.0)) - 1.0) / C;
#endif
#if RESHADE_DEPTH_INPUT_IS_REVERSED
		depth = 1.0 - depth;
#endif
		const float N = 1.0;
		depth /= RESHADE_DEPTH_LINEARIZATION_FAR_PLANE - depth * (RESHADE_DEPTH_LINEARIZATION_FAR_PLANE - N);

		return depth;
	}
}

// Vertex shader generating a triangle covering the entire screen
// See also https://www.reddit.com/r/gamedev/comments/2j17wk/a_slightly_faster_bufferless_vertex_shader_trick/
void PostProcessVS(in uint id : SV_VertexID, out float4 position : SV_Position, out float2 texcoord : TEXCOORD)
{
	texcoord.x = (id == 2) ? 2.0 : 0.0;
	texcoord.y = (id == 1) ? 2.0 : 0.0;
	position = float4(texcoord * float2(2.0, -2.0) + float2(-1.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0);
}

float4 ScalarTextureFetch(float4 position : SV_Position, float2 uv : TEXCOORD) : SV_Target

}

// Must read the producer's allocation, not a separately cleared black texture.
texture SharedTexture
{
    Width = BUFFER_WIDTH;
    Height = BUFFER_HEIGHT;
    Format = RGBA8;
    MipLevels = 1;
};
sampler SharedTextureSampler
{
    Texture = SharedTexture;
};

void SharedTextureVS(uint id : SV_VertexID, out float4 position : SV_Position,
                     out float2 texcoord : TEXCOORD)
{
    texcoord = float2(id == 2 ? 2.0 : 0.0, id == 1 ? 2.0 : 0.0);
    position = float4(texcoord * float2(2.0, -2.0) + float2(-1.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0);
}

float4 ConsumeSharedTexture(float4 position : SV_Position,
                            float2 texcoord : TEXCOORD) : SV_Target
{
    return tex2D(SharedTextureSampler, texcoord);
}

technique SharedTextureConsumer
{
    pass
    {
        VertexShader = SharedTextureVS;
        PixelShader = ConsumeSharedTexture;
    }
}

`src/tests/fixtures/SharedTextureProducer.fx`:

```fx
// Standalone fixture: write only the named offscreen texture, never the screen.
texture SharedTexture
{
    Width = BUFFER_WIDTH;
    Height = BUFFER_HEIGHT;
    Format = RGBA8;
    MipLevels = 1;
};

// Exercise the same sampled-backbuffer path as DH's motion producer.
texture SceneTexture : COLOR;
sampler SceneSampler { Texture = SceneTexture; };

void SharedTextureVS(uint id : SV_VertexID, out float4 position : SV_Position,
                     out float2 texcoord : TEXCOORD)
{
    texcoord = float2(id == 2 ? 2.0 : 0.0, id == 1 ? 2.0 : 0.0);
    position = float4(texcoord * float2(2.0, -2.0) + float2(-1.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0);
}

float4 ProduceSharedTexture(float4 position : SV_Position,
                            float2 texcoord : TEXCOORD) : SV_Target
{
    // The UNORM backbuffer is nonnegative, so this writes known green even
    // when the application's alpha channel is zero.
    return float4(0.0, saturate(tex2D(SceneSampler, texcoord).r + 1.0), 0.0, 1.0);
}

technique SharedTextureProducer
{
    pass
    {
        VertexShader = SharedTextureVS;
        PixelShader = ProduceSharedTexture;
        RenderTarget = SharedTexture;
    }
}
