`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/common.glsl`:

```glsl
// Shared numeric helpers: the half / E4M3 publication points of the network, implemented so that every kernel
// (and the CPU reference in src/reference.cpp) rounds identically.
#ifndef DLSS_COMMON_GLSL
#define DLSS_COMMON_GLSL

#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_16bit_storage : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_8bit_storage : require

// f32 -> RNE f16 -> f32, on the bit pattern.
// Don't write float(float16_t(x)): the NVIDIA compiler drops it as a no-op and the rounding
// goes with it. That was the first parity bug, inside the SiLU.
float roundF16(float value) {
  uint bits = floatBitsToUint(value);
  uint sign = bits & 0x80000000u;
  uint magnitude = bits & 0x7fffffffu;
  if (magnitude >= 0x7f800000u) return value;                                   // inf / nan
  if (magnitude >= 0x477ff000u) return uintBitsToFloat(sign | 0x7f800000u);     // >= 65520 overflows to inf
  if (magnitude < 0x38800000u) {                                                // below 2^-14: half subnormal grid 2^-24
    float scaled = roundEven(uintBitsToFloat(magnitude) * 16777216.0);
    return uintBitsToFloat(sign) + uintBitsToFloat(sign | floatBitsToUint(scaled * 0.000000059604644775390625));
  }
  uint lsb = (magnitude >> 13u) & 1u;
  uint rounded = (magnitude + 0xfffu + lsb) & ~0x1fffu;
  return uintBitsToFloat(sign | rounded);
}

uint f16Bits(float16_t value) { return uint(float16BitsToUint16(value)); }
float16_t f16FromBits(uint bits) { return uint16BitsToFloat16(uint16_t(bits & 0xffffu)); }

uint shiftRne(uint value, uint shift) {
  uint quotient = value >> shift;
  uint remainderMask = (1u << shift) - 1u;
  uint remainder = value & remainderMask;
  uint halfway = 1u << (shift - 1u);
  return quotient + ((remainder > halfway || (remainder == halfway && (quotient & 1u) != 0u)) ? 1u : 0u);
}

// An already half-rounded value to its E4M3FN code: RNE, finite saturation at 448, NaN -> +0.
// The sign of a zero survives (code 0x80), as the hardware conversion does. It makes no numeric
// difference; parity compares bytes.
uint e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(uint halfBits) {
  bool isNan = (halfBits & 0x7c00u) == 0x7c00u && (halfBits & 0x03ffu) != 0u;
  if (isNan) return 0u;
  if ((halfBits & 0x7fffu) == 0u) return (halfBits >> 8u) & 0x80u;
  uint negative = (halfBits & 0x8000u) != 0u ? 0x80u : 0u;
  uint exponent = (halfBits >> 10u) & 0x1fu;
  uint mantissa = halfBits & 0x03ffu;
  uint code;
  if (exponent == 31u) {
    code = 0x7eu;                     // inf saturates
  } else if (exponent <= 8u) {        // E4M3 subnormal
    uint significand = exponent == 0u ? mantissa : 1024u + mantissa;
    uint shift = exponent == 0u ? 15u : 16u - exponent;
    code = min(shiftRne(significand, shift), 8u);
  } else {
    uint e4Exponent = exponent - 8u;
    uint e4Mantissa = shiftRne(mantissa, 7u);
    if (e4Mantissa == 8u) { e4Mantissa = 0u; e4Exponent += 1u; }
    code = (e4Exponent > 15u || (e4Exponent == 15u && e4Mantissa > 6u)) ? 0x7eu : ((e4Exponent << 3u) | e4Mantissa);
  }
  return negative | code;
}

uint e4m3CodeFromF32(float value) { return e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(float16_t(value))); }

#ifdef DLSS_E4M3_HW
// Hardware cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3, equal to e4m3CodeFromF16Bits for every non-NaN half.
// The guard is the whole difference: the instruction turns a NaN into the E4M3 NaN code, and a NaN gets
// here every time a zero row is cosine normalized (0 * inf). +0 keeps that code out of every tensor.
uint8_t e4m3Hw(float16_t value) {
  if (isnan(value)) return uint8_t(0u);
  floate4m3_t converted;
  saturatedConvertEXT(converted, value);
  return floate4m3BitsToUintEXT(converted);
}

// Two halves -> two E4M3 codes packed little-endian, same rules as e4m3Hw.
uint16_t e4m3HwPair(f16vec2 value) {
  f16vec2 clean = mix(value, f16vec2(0.0), isnan(value));
  fe4m3vec2 converted;
  saturatedConvertEXT(converted, clean);
  u8vec2 codes = floate4m3BitsToUintEXT(converted);
  return uint16_t(uint(codes.x) | (uint(codes.y) << 8u));
}

// Hardware decode. NaN codes read back as 0, as in the reference.
float e4m3HwToF32(uint code) {
  float value = float(uintBitsToFloate4m3EXT(uint8_t(code & 0xffu)));
  return isnan(value) ? 0.0 : value;
}
#endif

// The network's cubic SiLU in half FMAs: identical to the f32 formulation (mpCubicSilu below) for all
// 65536 half inputs.
float16_t siluHalf(float16_t value) {
  float16_t bounded = clamp(value, float16_t(-4.0), float16_t(4.0));
  precise float16_t inner = fma(float16_t(-0.055908203125), abs(bounded), float16_t(0.447265625));
  precise float16_t polynomial = fma(bounded, inner, float16_t(0.89453125));
  precise float16_t result = value * polynomial;
  return result;
}

f16vec2 siluPair(f16vec2 value) {
  f16vec2 bounded = clamp(value, f16vec2(-4.0), f16vec2(4.0));
  precise f16vec2 inner = fma(f16vec2(-0.055908203125), abs(bounded), f16vec2(0.447265625));
  precise f16vec2 polynomial = fma(bounded, inner, f16vec2(0.89453125));
  precise f16vec2 result = value * polynomial;
  return result;
}

float e4m3ToF32(uint bits) {
  bool negative = (bits & 0x80u) != 0u;
  uint exponent = (bits >> 3u) & 0x0fu;
  uint mantissa = bits & 0x07u;
  float value;
  if (exponent == 0u) value = float(mantissa) * 0.001953125;
  else if (exponent == 15u && mantissa == 7u) value = 0.0;
  else value = (1.0 + float(mantissa) * 0.125) * uintBitsToFloat((exponent + 120u) << 23u);
  return negative ? -value : value;
}

// The f32 spelling of siluHalf: each step is one f32 operation rounded once to half.
// The explicit fma is not decoration. Without it the compiler splits the multiply-add and
// double-rounds, which was the second thing to break parity.
float mpCubicSilu(float value) {
  precise float bounded = roundF16(clamp(value, -4.0, 4.0));
  precise float absolute = roundF16(abs(bounded));
  precise float inner = roundF16(fma(-0.055908203125, absolute, 0.447265625));
  precise float polynomial = roundF16(fma(bounded, inner, 0.89453125));
  return roundF16(value * polynomial);
}

#endif

```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/fused_block32.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Fused Swin block for the 32-channel stages (blocks 0-4, 66-70): one window
// slot per four subgroups, everything between the block input and the block
// output stays on chip.
//
//   FFN   : x(E4) -> W1 (K32->128) -> SiLU -> E4 -> W2 (K128->32) + skip*scale
//   QKV   : E4(ffn) -> (K32->96) raw half
//   attn  : cosine normalize -> S = QK^T + prior -> exp -> softmax -> E4 P -> PV
//   proj  : E4(attended) -> (K32->32) + ffn*scale -> E4 output (+ raw half)
//
// v5 (fragment level, VK_NV_cooperative_matrix2): the window's token rows are one
// tensor load with constant clamping (zero outside the image); every multiply is
// a flexible-dimension coopMatMulAdd; SiLU, residual scaling and the E4M3
// publications are per-element operations and Use conversions in registers.
// The two exact reductions run on the accumulator elements directly: in the
// accumulator layout (lane g = l>>2, t = l&3 holds rows g and g+8, columns
// 8*tile + 2t, 2t+1) the specified pairings (k, k+8) and (c, c+16), (c, c+8) are
// lane-local and the remaining tree levels are shuffles, in the reference
// association order. Shared memory holds only the block's weights and prior and
// the physical-tiled K/V rows of the two windows in flight.
//
// Every arithmetic boundary is the one verified by the unfused kernels; only the
// data movement changed. The parity gates are the proof.
#extension GL_EXT_float_e4m3 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_KHR_memory_scope_semantics : require
#extension GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix : require
#extension GL_NV_cooperative_matrix2 : require

#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_shuffle : require
#extension GL_EXT_control_flow_attributes : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require

#define PRIOR_SHARED 1
#endif

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;  // two windows per workgroup, four subgroups (16-token row tiles) each

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint FLAGS = 0;
const uint F_SKIP_F16 = 1u;    // FFN residual is the f16 skip buffer (else the E4 state)
const uint F_PRE = 8u;         // block 0: f32 input features x f16 adapter (binding 11) -> E4 state and f16 skip in registers
const uint F_POST = 16u;       // block 70: learned_post_blend of the 2x-upsampled half-res E4 (binding 1) and block-0 E4 (binding 0)
const uint F_HEAD = 32u;       // block 70: f16 head GEMM (binding 11, [32][16]) -> f32 RGBA (binding 9)
const uint F_POOL = 64u;       // 2x2 box pool of the raw f16 output -> E4 half-resolution rows (binding 9)
const uint F_UPRES = 128u;     // block 66: round_f16(2x-upsampled f16 projection (binding 1) + E4 skip (binding 0) * scale) -> state / skip
const uint F_OUT_E4 = 2u;      // write the E4 block output
const uint F_OUT_F16 = 4u;     // write the raw half block output

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint width;
  uint height;
  uint shiftX;
  uint shiftY;
  uint windowsX;
  uint windowCount;
  uint groupCount;          // persistent workgroups: each walks window pairs gl_WorkGroupID.x, += groupCount
  uint auxFfnHalfOffset;    // FFN skip scale vector (half units in binding 6)
  uint auxAttnHalfOffset;   // attention skip scale vector
  uint scaleWordOffset;     // learned attention scale (f32 word in binding 6)
  uint auxInputScaleHalf;   // F_POST: upsampled input scale vector
  uint auxAdapterScaleHalf; // F_POST: block-0 (adapter) scale vector
  uint lowWidth;            // F_POST: half-resolution width
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer State { uvec4 state4[]; };           // E4 [tokens][32] as 16-byte words (F_POST: block-0 output)
layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer Features { vec4 feat4[]; };          // F_PRE: f32 [tokens][16]
layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer Skip { uvec4 skip4[]; };             // f16 [tokens][32] as 16-byte words
layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer LowRes { uvec4 lowres4[]; };         // F_POST: E4 [lowTokens][32]; F_UPRES: f16 [lowTokens][32] (4 words)
layout(std430, binding = 11) readonly buffer WeightsF16 { float16_t wf16[]; };   // F_PRE: [16 k][32 n]; F_HEAD: [32 k][16 n]
layout(std430, binding = 2) readonly buffer W1 { uvec4 w1v[]; };                 // E4 [128 n][32 k]
layout(std430, binding = 3) readonly buffer W2 { uvec4 w2v[]; };                 // E4 [32 n][128 k]
layout(std430, binding = 4) readonly buffer Wqkv { uvec4 wqkvv[]; };             // E4 [96 n][32 k]
layout(std430, binding = 5) readonly buffer Wproj { uvec4 wprojv[]; };           // E4 [32 n][32 k]
layout(std430, binding = 6) readonly buffer Aux { uint16_t aux16[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 7) readonly buffer Prior { float16_t prior[]; };        // [64][64] f16
layout(std430, binding = 8) writeonly buffer OutE4 { uvec4 out8x16[]; };         // E4 [tokens][32] as 16-byte words
layout(std430, binding = 9) writeonly buffer OutF16 { uvec4 out16x8[]; };        // f16 [tokens][32] as 16-byte words
layout(std430, binding = 9) writeonly buffer OutHead { vec2 head2[]; };          // F_HEAD: f32 [tokens][4] as pairs
layout(std430, binding = 9) writeonly buffer OutPooled { uint pooled32[]; };     // F_POOL: E4 [lowTokens][32] as 4-byte words


// Shared memory (41.5 KB of 48): wts (uvec4 words) W1 [128][32] @0, W2 [32][128] @256 at 9 words per row
// (bank-conflict-free fragment loads), Wqkv [96][32] @544, Wproj [32][32] @736; kv16 (16-bit units) per
// window slot: Kp [64][32] E4 then Vp [64][32] E4; scratch: 1 KB per subgroup for layout changes through
// shared memory (accumulator -> A operand, staged loads and stores).
shared uvec4 wts[800];
shared uint16_t kv16[2 * 64 * 24];       // Kp per slot: [64 physical][32 k] E4 at 24 halfword slots per row (48 B)
shared uint8_t vt8[2 * 32 * 80];         // Vt per slot: [32 n][64 physical k] E4 at 80-byte rows
shared uint scratch32[8 * 256];          // per subgroup 1 KB of 32-bit words: staged inputs, then the output row tile
shared float16_t wf16s[512];             // F_PRE adapter [16][32] / F_HEAD head [32][16] f16 weights
#define tile32 scratch32
#if PRIOR_SHARED
shared float16_t priorS[64 * 72];        // the block's attention prior, staged once per workgroup, 72-half rows
#endif

const uint W1T = 0u, W2T = 256u, WQKV = 544u, WPROJ = 736u;

#define ACC16x32 coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 32, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>
#define ACC16x16H coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>
#define A16x16H coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseA>
#define B16x32H coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 32, gl_MatrixUseB>
#define B16x16H coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseB>
#define ACC16x64 coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 64, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>
#define ACC16x128 coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 128, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>
#define A16x32 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 32, gl_MatrixUseA>
#define A16x64 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 64, gl_MatrixUseA>
#define A16x128 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 128, gl_MatrixUseA>
#define B32x32 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 32, 32, gl_MatrixUseB>
#define B32x64 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 32, 64, gl_MatrixUseB>
#define B32x128 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 32, 128, gl_MatrixUseB>
#define B64x32 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 64, 32, gl_MatrixUseB>
#define B128x32 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 128, 32, gl_MatrixUseB>

uint tiledToken(uint token) {  // natural -> physical
  uint x = token & 7u, y = token >> 3u;
  return (y >> 2u) * 32u + (x >> 2u) * 16u + (y & 3u) * 4u + (x & 3u);
}

// the exponential approximation on a packed pair: f32 affine, half clamp, per half (bits << 5) + 0x8000 == (bits << 5) ^ 0x8000.
uint expWeightPair(uint scoreBits) {
  precise vec2 affine32 = fma(vec2(unpackFloat2x16(scoreBits)), vec2(0.044921875), vec2(1.30078125));
  f16vec2 affine = clamp(f16vec2(affine32), f16vec2(1.03125), f16vec2(1.5693359375));
  return ((packFloat2x16(affine) << 5u) & 0xffe0ffe0u) ^ 0x80008000u;
}

// SiLU on the accumulator pairs (elements 2i, 2i+1 share a row): packed half FMAs, same per-half arithmetic.
void siluPairs32(inout ACC16x32 m) {
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) {
    f16vec2 v = siluPair(f16vec2(m[2u * i], m[2u * i + 1u]));
    m[2u * i] = v.x; m[2u * i + 1u] = v.y;
  }
}

// round_f16(value * aux[column]) on packed pairs: the half product of two halves is exact in f32 and rounds
// once, so the half multiply is the same publication as the f32 formulation.
void scalePairs(inout ACC16x32 m, const in f16vec2 aux[4]) {
  [[unroll]] for (uint h = 0u; h < 2u; ++h) {
    [[unroll]] for (uint j = 0u; j < 4u; ++j) {
      precise f16vec2 v = f16vec2(m[8u * h + 2u * j], m[8u * h + 2u * j + 1u]) * aux[j];
      m[8u * h + 2u * j] = v.x; m[8u * h + 2u * j + 1u] = v.y;
    }
  }
}

// Per-element callbacks (elementwise, order-free; the half rounding is a real conversion).
float16_t siluElement(const in uint row, const in uint col, const in float16_t value) { return siluHalf(value); }
float16_t nanToZero(const in uint row, const in uint col, const in float16_t value) { return isnan(value) ? float16_t(0.0) : value; }
// round_f16(residual * aux[col]): exact product in f32, one rounding.
float16_t scaleByAux(const in uint row, const in uint col, const in float16_t value, const in uint auxOffset) {
  precise float product = float(value) * float(uint16BitsToFloat16(aux16[auxOffset + col]));
  return float16_t(product);
}

// Cosine normalization of a 16x32 accumulator in registers. Lane (g, t) holds for row half h the
// eight elements [8h + 0..7] = columns (2t, 2t+1), (8+2t, 9+2t), (16+2t, 17+2t), (24+2t, 25+2t).
// r[c] = fma(v[c], v[c], f16(v[c+16]^2)) for c < 16, then s8 = r[c] + r[c+8], s4 = s8[c] + s8[c+4]
// (lane xor 2), s2 = s4[c] + s4[c+2] (lane xor 1), s1 = s2[0] + s2[1]: the reference association order.
// Returns the normalized (and optionally learned-scaled) values in place; zero rows give 0*inf -> 0.
void normalizeInPlace(inout ACC16x32 m, const in float16_t scale, const in bool applyScale) {
  [[unroll]] for (uint h = 0u; h < 2u; ++h) {
    const uint b = 8u * h;
    f16vec2 p0 = f16vec2(m[b + 0u], m[b + 1u]), p1 = f16vec2(m[b + 2u], m[b + 3u]);
    f16vec2 p2 = f16vec2(m[b + 4u], m[b + 5u]), p3 = f16vec2(m[b + 6u], m[b + 7u]);
    precise f16vec2 hs0 = p2 * p2;
    precise f16vec2 r0 = fma(p0, p0, hs0);
    precise f16vec2 hs1 = p3 * p3;
    precise f16vec2 r1 = fma(p1, p1, hs1);
    precise f16vec2 s8 = r0 + r1;
    f16vec2 s8o = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffleXor(packFloat2x16(s8), 2u));
    precise f16vec2 s4 = s8 + s8o;
    f16vec2 s4o = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffleXor(packFloat2x16(s4), 1u));
    precise f16vec2 s2 = s4 + s4o;
    precise float16_t s1 = s2.x + s2.y;
    float16_t norm = float16_t(inversesqrt(float(s1)));
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) {
      precise float16_t n = m[b + i] * norm;
      float16_t value = n;
      if (applyScale) { precise float16_t ns = n * scale; value = ns; }
      m[b + i] = isnan(value) ? float16_t(0.0) : value;
    }
  }
}

// E4 codes of a 16x32 accumulator into physical-tiled K/V rows (32 bytes = 16 halfword slots per row).
void publishRows(const in ACC16x32 m, const in uint slotBase, const in uint rowBase, const in uint t, const in uint g,
                 const in int windowX, const in int windowY, const in bool slotActive) {
  [[unroll]] for (uint h = 0u; h < 2u; ++h) {
    uint token = rowBase + g + 8u * h;
    int x = windowX + int(token & 7u), y = windowY + int(token >> 3u);
    bool valid = slotActive && x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < int(pc.width) && y < int(pc.height);
    uint row = slotBase + tiledToken(token) * 24u;
    [[unroll]] for (uint j = 0u; j < 4u; ++j) {   // column pair (8j + 2t, 8j + 2t + 1) -> halfword slot 4j + t
      uint16_t codes = e4m3PairFast(f16vec2(m[8u * h + 2u * j], m[8u * h + 2u * j + 1u]));
      kv16[row + 4u * j + t] = valid ? codes : uint16_t(0u);
    }
  }
}

// Transposed E4 rows: element (token, column) -> vt8[base + column * 80 + physical(token)].
void publishTransposed(const in ACC16x32 m, const in uint base, const in uint rowBase, const in uint t, const in uint g,
                       const in int windowX, const in int windowY, const in bool slotActive) {
  [[unroll]] for (uint h = 0u; h < 2u; ++h) {
    uint token = rowBase + g + 8u * h;
    int x = windowX + int(token & 7u), y = windowY + int(token >> 3u);
    bool valid = slotActive && x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < int(pc.width) && y < int(pc.height);
    uint column = base + tiledToken(token);
    [[unroll]] for (uint j = 0u; j < 4u; ++j) {
      f16vec2 v = f16vec2(m[8u * h + 2u * j], m[8u * h + 2u * j + 1u]);
      uint codes = valid ? uint(e4m3PairFast(mix(v, f16vec2(0.0), isnan(v)))) : 0u;
      vt8[column + (8u * j + 2u * t) * 80u] = uint8_t(codes & 0xffu);
      vt8[column + (8u * j + 2u * t + 1u) * 80u] = uint8_t(codes >> 8u);
    }
  }
}

void main() {
  const uint slot = gl_SubgroupID >> 2u;    // window slot within the workgroup
  const uint q = gl_SubgroupID & 3u;        // row tile: tokens 16q .. 16q+15 (window rows 2q, 2q+1)
  const uint lane = gl_SubgroupInvocationID;
  const uint g = lane >> 2u, t = lane & 3u;
  // Stage the block weights (768 words, three per thread), then the whole workgroup syncs once.
  for (uint i = gl_LocalInvocationID.x; i < 768u; i += 256u) {
    uvec4 word;
    uint dst = i;
    if (i < 256u) word = w1v[i];
    else if (i < 512u) { word = w2v[i - 256u]; dst = W2T + ((i - 256u) >> 3u) * 9u + ((i - 256u) & 7u); }
    else if (i < 704u) { word = wqkvv[i - 512u]; dst = WQKV + (i - 512u); }
    else { word = wprojv[i - 704u]; dst = WPROJ + (i - 704u); }
    wts[dst] = word;
  }
#if PRIOR_SHARED
  for (uint i = gl_LocalInvocationID.x; i < 4096u; i += 256u) priorS[(i >> 6u) * 72u + (i & 63u)] = prior[i];
#endif
  if ((FLAGS & (F_PRE | F_HEAD)) != 0u) for (uint i = gl_LocalInvocationID.x; i < 512u; i += 256u) wf16s[i] = wf16[i];
  barrier();
  const uint SCR = gl_SubgroupID * 256u;  // this subgroup's scratch words (32-bit)
  const uint KP = slot * 64u * 24u;          // halfword offset of this slot's Kp
  const uint VT = slot * 32u * 80u;          // byte offset of this slot's Vt
  const uint rowBase = q * 16u;
  // Per-lane skip scale pairs: accumulator elements (2j, 2j+1) of either row half are columns (8j + 2t, +1).
  f16vec2 auxFfn[4], auxAttn[4];
  [[unroll]] for (uint j = 0u; j < 4u; ++j) {
    uint column = 8u * j + 2u * t;
    auxFfn[j] = f16vec2(uint16BitsToFloat16(aux16[pc.auxFfnHalfOffset + column]), uint16BitsToFloat16(aux16[pc.auxFfnHalfOffset + column + 1u]));
    auxAttn[j] = f16vec2(uint16BitsToFloat16(aux16[pc.auxAttnHalfOffset + column]), uint16BitsToFloat16(aux16[pc.auxAttnHalfOffset + column + 1u]));
  }
  uint scaleBits = uint(aux16[pc.scaleWordOffset * 2u]) | (uint(aux16[pc.scaleWordOffset * 2u + 1u]) << 16u);
  const float16_t scale = float16_t(uintBitsToFloat(scaleBits));
  // F_POST: this lane's 16 channels (16 * ldWord ..) of the blend scales, as packed half pairs.
  const uint ldRow = lane >> 1u, ldWord = lane & 1u;
  uint blendA[8], blendB[8];
  if ((FLAGS & (F_POST | F_UPRES)) != 0u) {
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) {
      uint c = 16u * ldWord + 2u * i;
      blendA[i] = uint(aux16[pc.auxInputScaleHalf + c]) | (uint(aux16[pc.auxInputScaleHalf + c + 1u]) << 16u);
      blendB[i] = (FLAGS & F_POST) != 0u ? uint(aux16[pc.auxAdapterScaleHalf + c]) | (uint(aux16[pc.auxAdapterScaleHalf + c + 1u]) << 16u) : 0u;
    }
  }

  // Input words of this lane: row r = lane >> 1 of the subgroup's 16 tokens, word w = lane & 1 of the E4 row
  // (32 bytes) and words 2w, 2w + 1 of the f16 skip row (64 bytes). Loaded one pair ahead into registers.
  // F_PRE: instead the lane's eight f32 features (two vec4) - the adapter runs at the loop top.
  // F_POST: instead the block-0 E4 word (xw) and the half-resolution E4 word (sk0) - blended at the loop top.
  uvec4 xw = uvec4(0u), sk0 = uvec4(0u), sk1 = uvec4(0u);
  {
    const uint window0 = gl_WorkGroupID.x * 2u + slot;
    if (window0 < pc.windowCount) {
      const uint token = rowBase + ldRow;
      const int x0 = int((window0 % pc.windowsX) * 8u) - int(pc.shiftX) + int(token & 7u);
      const int y0 = int((window0 / pc.windowsX) * 8u) - int(pc.shiftY) + int(token >> 3u);
      if (x0 >= 0 && y0 >= 0 && x0 < int(pc.width) && y0 < int(pc.height)) {
        const uint pixel = uint(y0) * pc.width + uint(x0);
        if ((FLAGS & F_PRE) != 0u) {
          xw = floatBitsToUint(feat4[pixel * 4u + ldWord * 2u]); sk0 = floatBitsToUint(feat4[pixel * 4u + ldWord * 2u + 1u]);
        } else if ((FLAGS & F_POST) != 0u) {
          xw = state4[pixel * 2u + ldWord];
          sk0 = lowres4[((uint(y0) >> 1u) * pc.lowWidth + (uint(x0) >> 1u)) * 2u + ldWord];
        } else if ((FLAGS & F_UPRES) != 0u) {
          xw = state4[pixel * 2u + ldWord];
          const uint low = ((uint(y0) >> 1u) * pc.lowWidth + (uint(x0) >> 1u)) * 4u + ldWord * 2u;
          sk0 = lowres4[low]; sk1 = lowres4[low + 1u];
        } else {
          xw = state4[pixel * 2u + ldWord];
          if ((FLAGS & F_SKIP_F16) != 0u) { sk0 = skip4[pixel * 4u + ldWord * 2u]; sk1 = skip4[pixel * 4u + ldWord * 2u + 1u]; }
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Persistent loop over window pairs: the staged weights serve every pair this workgroup visits.
  for (uint pair = gl_WorkGroupID.x; pair * 2u < pc.windowCount; pair += pc.groupCount) {
  const uint window = pair * 2u + slot;
  const bool slotActive = window < pc.windowCount;   // inactive slots still take part in the barrier
  const uint clampedWindow = slotActive ? window : 0u;
  const int windowX = int((clampedWindow % pc.windowsX) * 8u) - int(pc.shiftX);
  const int windowY = int((clampedWindow / pc.windowsX) * 8u) - int(pc.shiftY);

  // Image tensors [height][width][32] with constant (zero) clamping: this subgroup's 16 tokens are the slice
  // (windowY + 2q, 2 rows) x (windowX, 8 pixels) x 32 channels; out-of-image tokens read zero / store nothing.
  tensorLayoutNV<3, gl_CooperativeMatrixClampModeConstantNV> image = createTensorLayoutNV(3, gl_CooperativeMatrixClampModeConstantNV);
  image = setTensorLayoutDimensionNV(image, pc.height, pc.width, 32);
  image = setTensorLayoutStrideNV(image, pc.width * 32u, 32, 1);
  tensorLayoutNV<3, gl_CooperativeMatrixClampModeConstantNV> tile =
      sliceTensorLayoutNV(image, uint(windowY + int(q * 2u)), 2, uint(windowX), 8, 0, 32);

  // ==== Phase F: FFN in registers. Operands come from the prefetched words through this subgroup's scratch.
  A16x32 x;
  ACC16x32 cInit;   // the scaled skip seeds the W2 accumulator: the MMA's C operand carries it for free, and it
                    // rounds once instead of twice as a separate add afterwards would
  if ((FLAGS & F_PRE) != 0u) {
    // Input adapter: A = f16(features) [16 tokens][16], B = [16][32] f16, one k16 step (the F24 arithmetic of
    // gemm_f16); the f16 result is the FFN skip, its E4M3 codes (NaN -> 0) the block state.
    {
      const uint w = SCR + (ldRow * 2u + ldWord) * 4u;
      scratch32[w] = packFloat2x16(f16vec2(uintBitsToFloat(xw.xy)));
      scratch32[w + 1u] = packFloat2x16(f16vec2(uintBitsToFloat(xw.zw)));
      scratch32[w + 2u] = packFloat2x16(f16vec2(uintBitsToFloat(sk0.xy)));
      scratch32[w + 3u] = packFloat2x16(f16vec2(uintBitsToFloat(sk0.zw)));
    }
    subgroupBarrier();
    A16x16H fa; coopMatLoad(fa, scratch32, SCR, 8u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
    subgroupBarrier();
    B16x32H fb; coopMatLoad(fb, wf16s, 0u, 32u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
    ACC16x32 adapted = ACC16x32(0.0);
    adapted = coopMatMulAdd(fa, fb, adapted);
    cInit = adapted;
    ACC16x32 adaptedClean;
    coopMatPerElementNV(adaptedClean, adapted, nanToZero);
    x = A16x32(adaptedClean);
  } else if ((FLAGS & (F_POST | F_UPRES)) != 0u) {
    // learned_post_blend per channel: raw = round_f16(round_f16(up * sA) + adapter * sB) (products exact in f32);
    // the f16 raw values are the FFN skip, their E4M3 codes the block state.
    // In half arithmetic: the product of two halves rounds once (HMUL2) and the fused multiply-add rounds
    // once (HFMA2) - the same two roundings as the f32 formulation with exact products.
    // F_UPRES (residualAfterMatmul + scaleResidual): raw = round_f16(projection + skip * scale), one HFMA2.
    uint rawWords[8];
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) {
      uint adPair = (xw[i >> 1u] >> ((i & 1u) * 16u)) & 0xffffu;
      f16vec2 sA = unpackFloat2x16(blendA[i]);
      f16vec2 ad = f16vec2(uintBitsToFloate4m3EXT(u8vec2(adPair & 0xffu, adPair >> 8u)));
      ad = mix(ad, f16vec2(0.0), isnan(ad));   // decode_e4m3: NaN codes read as 0
      if ((FLAGS & F_UPRES) != 0u) {
        f16vec2 projected = unpackFloat2x16(i < 4u ? sk0[i] : sk1[i - 4u]);
        precise f16vec2 value = fma(ad, sA, projected);
        rawWords[i] = packFloat2x16(value);
      } else {
        uint upPair = (sk0[i >> 1u] >> ((i & 1u) * 16u)) & 0xffffu;
        f16vec2 sB = unpackFloat2x16(blendB[i]);
        f16vec2 up = f16vec2(uintBitsToFloate4m3EXT(u8vec2(upPair & 0xffu, upPair >> 8u)));
        up = mix(up, f16vec2(0.0), isnan(up));
        precise f16vec2 inputValue = up * sA;
        precise f16vec2 value = fma(ad, sB, inputValue);
        rawWords[i] = packFloat2x16(value);
      }
    }
    {
      const uint w = SCR + (ldRow * 4u + ldWord * 2u) * 4u;
      [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) scratch32[w + i] = rawWords[i];
    }
    subgroupBarrier();
    coopMatLoad(cInit, scratch32, SCR, 16u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
    subgroupBarrier();
    {
      const uint w = SCR + (ldRow * 2u + ldWord) * 4u;
      [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i)
        scratch32[w + i] = uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(rawWords[2u * i]))) | (uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(rawWords[2u * i + 1u]))) << 16u);
    }
    subgroupBarrier();
    coopMatLoad(x, scratch32, SCR, 8u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
    subgroupBarrier();
  } else {
    {
      const uint w = SCR + (ldRow * 2u + ldWord) * 4u;
      scratch32[w] = xw.x; scratch32[w + 1u] = xw.y; scratch32[w + 2u] = xw.z; scratch32[w + 3u] = xw.w;
    }
    subgroupBarrier();
    coopMatLoad(x, scratch32, SCR, 8u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
    subgroupBarrier();
    {
      // the FFN skip as an f16 accumulator: the f16 skip, or the state's codes widened to halves (exact). An E4M3
      // accumulator matrix would widen in one conversion, but no implementation advertises that matrix type.
      uvec4 lo = sk0, hi = sk1;
      if ((FLAGS & F_SKIP_F16) == 0u) {
        uint halves[8];
        [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) {
          uint codes = (xw[i >> 1u] >> ((i & 1u) * 16u)) & 0xffffu;
          halves[i] = packFloat2x16(f16vec2(uintBitsToFloate4m3EXT(u8vec2(codes & 0xffu, codes >> 8u))));
        }
        lo = uvec4(halves[0], halves[1], halves[2], halves[3]); hi = uvec4(halves[4], halves[5], halves[6], halves[7]);
      }
      const uint w = SCR + (ldRow * 4u + ldWord * 2u) * 4u;
      scratch32[w] = lo.x; scratch32[w + 1u] = lo.y; scratch32[w + 2u] = lo.z; scratch32[w + 3u] = lo.w;
      scratch32[w + 4u] = hi.x; scratch32[w + 5u] = hi.y; scratch32[w + 6u] = hi.z; scratch32[w + 7u] = hi.w;
      subgroupBarrier();
      coopMatLoad(cInit, scratch32, SCR, 16u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      subgroupBarrier();
    }
  }
  scalePairs(cInit, auxFfn);
  {  // prefetch the next pair's words
    const uint windowN = (pair + pc.groupCount) * 2u + slot;
    xw = uvec4(0u); sk0 = uvec4(0u); sk1 = uvec4(0u);
    if (windowN < pc.windowCount) {
      const uint token = rowBase + ldRow;
      const int xN = int((windowN % pc.windowsX) * 8u) - int(pc.shiftX) + int(token & 7u);
      const int yN = int((windowN / pc.windowsX) * 8u) - int(pc.shiftY) + int(token >> 3u);
      if (xN >= 0 && yN >= 0 && xN < int(pc.width) && yN < int(pc.height)) {
        const uint pixel = uint(yN) * pc.width + uint(xN);
        if ((FLAGS & F_PRE) != 0u) {
          xw = floatBitsToUint(feat4[pixel * 4u + ldWord * 2u]); sk0 = floatBitsToUint(feat4[pixel * 4u + ldWord * 2u + 1u]);
        } else if ((FLAGS & F_POST) != 0u) {
          xw = state4[pixel * 2u + ldWord];
          sk0 = lowres4[((uint(yN) >> 1u) * pc.lowWidth + (uint(xN) >> 1u)) * 2u + ldWord];
        } else if ((FLAGS & F_UPRES) != 0u) {
          xw = state4[pixel * 2u + ldWord];
          const uint low = ((uint(yN) >> 1u) * pc.lowWidth + (uint(xN) >> 1u)) * 4u + ldWord * 2u;
          sk0 = lowres4[low]; sk1 = lowres4[low + 1u];
        } else {
          xw = state4[pixel * 2u + ldWord];
          if ((FLAGS & F_SKIP_F16) != 0u) { sk0 = skip4[pixel * 4u + ldWord * 2u]; sk1 = skip4[pixel * 4u + ldWord * 2u + 1u]; }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  ACC16x32 ffnAcc = cInit;
  [[unroll]] for (uint qq = 0u; qq < 4u; ++qq) {   // hidden columns 32qq..: the k32 steps of W2 in K order
    B32x32 w1;
    coopMatLoad(w1, wts, W1T + qq * 32u * 2u, 2u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);   // n rows 32qq..
    ACC16x32 hidden = ACC16x32(0.0);
    hidden = coopMatMulAdd(x, w1, hidden);
    siluPairs32(hidden);
    A16x32 hiddenE4 = A16x32(hidden);
    B32x32 w2;   // [32 n][128 k] at 9 words per n row: k 32qq.. is word offset 2qq
    coopMatLoad(w2, wts, W2T + qq * 2u, 9u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);
    ffnAcc = coopMatMulAdd(hiddenE4, w2, ffnAcc);
  }
  ACC16x32 ffnClean;
  coopMatPerElementNV(ffnClean, ffnAcc, nanToZero);
  A16x32 ffnQ = A16x32(ffnClean);

  // ==== Phase Q: q, k, v in registers; normalize in the accumulator layout; K/V rows to shared.
  B32x32 wq; coopMatLoad(wq, wts, WQKV, 2u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);
  B32x32 wk; coopMatLoad(wk, wts, WQKV + 32u * 2u, 2u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);
  B32x32 wv; coopMatLoad(wv, wts, WQKV + 64u * 2u, 2u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);
  ACC16x32 qa = ACC16x32(0.0), ka = ACC16x32(0.0), va = ACC16x32(0.0);
  qa = coopMatMulAdd(ffnQ, wq, qa);
  ka = coopMatMulAdd(ffnQ, wk, ka);
  va = coopMatMulAdd(ffnQ, wv, va);
  normalizeInPlace(qa, scale, true);
  normalizeInPlace(ka, scale, false);
  A16x32 mq = A16x32(qa);
  publishRows(ka, KP, rowBase, t, g, windowX, windowY, slotActive);
  publishTransposed(va, VT, rowBase, t, g, windowX, windowY, slotActive);
  barrier();  // all K / V rows visible

  // ==== Phase A: attention and projection in registers.
  B32x64 kp; coopMatLoad(kp, kv16, KP, 24u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);   // [64 physical][32 k]
  ACC16x64 s;   // attention prior for these 16 query rows (staged in shared)
#if PRIOR_SHARED
  coopMatLoad(s, priorS, rowBase * 72u, 72u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
#else
  coopMatLoad(s, prior, rowBase * 64u, 64u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);   // L2-resident 8 KB per block
#endif
  s = coopMatMulAdd(mq, kp, s);
  // Softmax in the accumulator layout. Row half h: elements [16h + 2m, 16h + 2m + 1] are keys (8m + 2t, +1).
  // the specified softmax reduction: b[g'][j] = e[g' + 16j] + e[g' + 16j + 8] for g' in {2t, 2t+1} -> pair(2j) + pair(2j+1);
  // t[g'] = ((b0 + b1) + b2) + b3; even = ((t0 + t2) + t4) + t6 over lanes t = 0..3 (g' = 2t), odd likewise;
  // total = even + odd; weights = e * f16(1 / f32(total)) -> E4M3 (positive, finite).
  ACC16x64 wAcc = ACC16x64(0.0);
  [[unroll]] for (uint h = 0u; h < 2u; ++h) {
    uint e[8];
    [[unroll]] for (uint m = 0u; m < 8u; ++m) e[m] = expWeightPair(packFloat2x16(f16vec2(s[16u * h + 2u * m], s[16u * h + 2u * m + 1u])));
    f16vec2 bp[4];
    [[unroll]] for (uint j = 0u; j < 4u; ++j) { precise f16vec2 bsum = unpackFloat2x16(e[2u * j]) + unpackFloat2x16(e[2u * j + 1u]); bp[j] = bsum; }
    precise f16vec2 t01 = bp[0] + bp[1];
    precise f16vec2 t012 = t01 + bp[2];
    precise f16vec2 tp = t012 + bp[3];                          // (t[2t], t[2t+1])
    uint tpBits = packFloat2x16(tp);
    uint quad = lane & ~3u;
    f16vec2 t0 = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffle(tpBits, quad)), t1 = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffle(tpBits, quad + 1u));
    f16vec2 t2 = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffle(tpBits, quad + 2u)), t3 = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffle(tpBits, quad + 3u));
    precise float16_t e01 = t0.x + t1.x;
    precise float16_t e012 = e01 + t2.x;
    precise float16_t even = e012 + t3.x;
    precise float16_t o01 = t0.y + t1.y;
    precise float16_t o012 = o01 + t2.y;
    precise float16_t odd = o012 + t3.y;
    precise float16_t total = even + odd;
    float16_t reciprocal = float16_t(1.0 / float(total));
    [[unroll]] for (uint m = 0u; m < 8u; ++m) {
      precise f16vec2 w = unpackFloat2x16(e[m]) * reciprocal;
      wAcc[16u * h + 2u * m] = w.x;
      wAcc[16u * h + 2u * m + 1u] = w.y;
    }
  }
  A16x64 p = A16x64(wAcc);
  B64x32 vp; coopMatLoad(vp, vt8, VT, 80u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);   // [32 n][64 physical k]
  ACC16x32 o = ACC16x32(0.0);
  o = coopMatMulAdd(p, vp, o);
  ACC16x32 oClean;
  coopMatPerElementNV(oClean, o, nanToZero);
  A16x32 attended = A16x32(oClean);
  ACC16x32 projC = ffnAcc;
  scalePairs(projC, auxAttn);
  B32x32 wproj;
  coopMatLoad(wproj, wts, WPROJ, 2u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);
  ACC16x32 result = coopMatMulAdd(attended, wproj, projC);
  {
    // Output rows: the tile is assembled in shared memory as 32-bit words, then each lane stores whole
    // 16-byte words of the valid tokens (row r = word / wordsPerRow of this subgroup's 16 tokens).
    const uint tileBase = SCR;
    if ((FLAGS & F_OUT_F16) != 0u) {
      PUBLISH_F16_TILE(result, 32u, tile32, tileBase, g, t)
      subgroupBarrier();
      [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 2u; ++i) {
        const uint w = lane + 32u * i, r = w >> 2u, cw = w & 3u;
        const uint tok = rowBase + r;
        const int x = windowX + int(tok & 7u), y = windowY + int(tok >> 3u);
        const uint base = tileBase + r * 16u + cw * 4u;
        if (slotActive && x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < int(pc.width) && y < int(pc.height))
          out16x8[(uint(y) * pc.width + uint(x)) * 4u + cw] = uvec4(tile32[base], tile32[base + 1u], tile32[base + 2u], tile32[base + 3u]);
      }
      subgroupBarrier();
    }
    if ((FLAGS & F_POOL) != 0u) {
      // ds_fp8: this subgroup's two window rows pool to one half-resolution row of four pixels: ((a + b) + (c + d))
      // * 0.25 in halves, then E4M3. Lane l: output pixel i = l >> 3, channels 4 (l & 7) .. + 3 (one 4-byte word).
      PUBLISH_F16_TILE(result, 32u, tile32, tileBase, g, t)
      subgroupBarrier();
      {
        const uint i = lane >> 3u, pair0 = (lane & 7u) * 2u;
        const int sx = windowX + int(2u * i), sy = windowY + int(q * 2u);
        uint codes = 0u;
        [[unroll]] for (uint p = 0u; p < 2u; ++p) {
          const uint word = pair0 + p;   // channel pair within the row (16 words of f16 pairs per token)
          precise f16vec2 top = unpackFloat2x16(tile32[tileBase + (2u * i) * 16u + word]) + unpackFloat2x16(tile32[tileBase + (2u * i + 1u) * 16u + word]);
          precise f16vec2 bottom = unpackFloat2x16(tile32[tileBase + (8u + 2u * i) * 16u + word]) + unpackFloat2x16(tile32[tileBase + (9u + 2u * i) * 16u + word]);
          precise f16vec2 sum = top + bottom;
          precise f16vec2 value = sum * float16_t(0.25);
          codes |= uint(e4m3HwPair(value)) << (16u * p);
        }
        if (slotActive && sx >= 0 && sy >= 0 && sx + 1 < int(pc.width) && sy + 1 < int(pc.height))
          pooled32[((uint(sy) >> 1u) * pc.lowWidth + (uint(sx) >> 1u)) * 8u + (lane & 7u)] = codes;
      }
      subgroupBarrier();
    }
    if ((FLAGS & F_HEAD) != 0u) {
      // RGBA head: [16 tokens][32] f16 x [32][16] f16 in two k16 steps (gemm_f16 order), columns 0..3 as f32.
      PUBLISH_F16_TILE(result, 32u, tile32, tileBase, g, t)
      subgroupBarrier();
      A16x16H h0; coopMatLoad(h0, tile32, tileBase, 16u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      A16x16H h1; coopMatLoad(h1, tile32, tileBase + 8u, 16u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      subgroupBarrier();
      B16x16H hb0; coopMatLoad(hb0, wf16s, 0u, 16u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      B16x16H hb1; coopMatLoad(hb1, wf16s, 256u, 16u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      ACC16x16H head = ACC16x16H(0.0);
      head = coopMatMulAdd(h0, hb0, head);
      head = coopMatMulAdd(h1, hb1, head);
      if (t < 2u) {   // columns 2t, 2t+1 of rows g and g+8: elements (0, 1) and (4, 5)
        [[unroll]] for (uint h = 0u; h < 2u; ++h) {
          const uint tok = rowBase + g + 8u * h;
          const int x = windowX + int(tok & 7u), y = windowY + int(tok >> 3u);
          if (slotActive && x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < int(pc.width) && y < int(pc.height))
            head2[(uint(y) * pc.width + uint(x)) * 2u + t] = vec2(float(head[4u * h]), float(head[4u * h + 1u]));
        }
      }
      subgroupBarrier();
    }
    if ((FLAGS & F_OUT_E4) != 0u) {
      PUBLISH_E4_TILE(result, 32u, tile32, tileBase, g, t)
      subgroupBarrier();
      {
        const uint r = lane >> 1u, cw = lane & 1u;
        const uint tok = rowBase + r;
        const int x = windowX + int(tok & 7u), y = windowY + int(tok >> 3u);
        const uint base = tileBase + r * 8u + cw * 4u;
        if (slotActive && x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < int(pc.width) && y < int(pc.height))
          out8x16[(uint(y) * pc.width + uint(x)) * 2u + cw] = uvec4(tile32[base], tile32[base + 1u], tile32[base + 2u], tile32[base + 3u]);
      }
    }
  }
  barrier();   // K / V rows and scratch are reused by the next pair
  }
}

```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/gemm_f16.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// FP16 GEMM on cooperative matrices for the network's two m16n8k16 boundaries:
// the 16 -> 32 input adapter of the fused pre block and the 32 -> 4 RGBA
// post head. A and B are f16, accumulation is f16 (two eight-product F24
// reductions per k16 step on Ada). C starts at zero.
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_KHR_memory_scope_semantics : require
#extension GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix : require
#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_basic : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 128) in;

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint K = 16;
layout(constant_id = 1) const uint TILE_N = 32;   // padded N (multiple of 16)
layout(constant_id = 2) const uint FLAGS = 0;

const uint F_QUANTIZE = 16u;   // main output E4M3 bytes (binding 5)
const uint F_DUAL = 32u;       // f16 to binding 2 and E4M3 to binding 5
const uint F_OUT_F32 = 256u;   // f32 output to binding 7

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint rows;
  uint N;             // valid output columns
  uint inputStride;   // A row stride (elements)
  uint outputStride;  // output row stride (elements)
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer InputA { float16_t a[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer InputB { float16_t b[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 2) writeonly buffer OutputHalf { float16_t out16[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer OutputE4 { uint8_t out8[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 7) writeonly buffer OutputFloat { float out32[]; };

const uint TILES = TILE_N / 16u;
shared float16_t tileC[4u * 16u * TILE_N];

void main() {
  const uint subgroup = gl_SubgroupID;
  const uint lane = gl_SubgroupInvocationID;
  const uint rowBase = (gl_WorkGroupID.y + gl_WorkGroupID.z * 65535u) * 64u + subgroup * 16u;
  const uint tileBase = subgroup * 16u * TILE_N;

  coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator> acc[TILES];
  for (uint t = 0; t < TILES; ++t) acc[t] = coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>(0.0);
  for (uint kb = 0u; kb < K; kb += 16u) {
    coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseA> ma;
    coopMatLoad(ma, a, rowBase * pc.inputStride + kb, pc.inputStride, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
    for (uint t = 0; t < TILES; ++t) {
      coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseB> mb;
      coopMatLoad(mb, b, kb * TILE_N + t * 16u, TILE_N, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      acc[t] = coopMatMulAdd(ma, mb, acc[t]);
    }
  }
  for (uint t = 0; t < TILES; ++t) {
    coopMatStore(acc[t], tileC, tileBase + t * 16u, TILE_N, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
  }
  barrier();

  for (uint i = lane; i < 16u * TILE_N; i += 32u) {
    uint r = i / TILE_N, c = i % TILE_N;
    uint row = rowBase + r;
    if (row >= pc.rows || c >= pc.N) continue;
    uint index = row * pc.outputStride + c;
    float16_t value = tileC[tileBase + i];
    if ((FLAGS & F_OUT_F32) != 0u) out32[index] = float(value);
    else if ((FLAGS & F_QUANTIZE) != 0u) out8[index] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(value)));
    else out16[index] = value;
    if ((FLAGS & F_DUAL) != 0u) out8[index] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(value)));
  }
}

```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/gemm_fp8.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Exact Ada FP8 GEMM on cooperative matrices (v4: shared-memory staged operands,
// tile-major weights, 64- or 128-row blocks, single-pass packed epilogue).
//
// D = A(E4M3, rows x K) * B(E4M3, K x N) accumulated in FP16 as a chain of
// 16x16x32 MMAs in K order (the m16n8k32 two-group F13 arithmetic of the tensor
// cores). The prologue seeds the accumulator with the residual/skip vector as
// the C fragment; the epilogue applies the publication order (residual-after,
// cubic SiLU, E4M3 quantization) element by element with the hardware half
// conversions.
//
// Data movement (measured): coopMatLoad straight from
// global memory costs 10-40 ns per tile while the MMA itself costs 3.5 ns, but
// coopMatLoad from shared memory is free and plain coalesced 16-byte loads
// move 1 KB in 12 ns (6 ns when the 512 bytes of a warp load are contiguous).
// So every k32 step stages A[BM][32] and B[BN][32] into shared memory with
// one uvec4 per thread per row half, DEPTH steps ahead through registers, and
// the MMAs read shared only. Weights are stored k32-tile-major
// ([batch][K/32][N][32]) so a B tile is one contiguous block.
//
// Work decomposition: a workgroup owns BM = 16*SUBGROUPS rows and
// BN = 16*TILES columns; the host picks both so the GPU stays occupied.
#extension GL_EXT_float_e4m3 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_KHR_memory_scope_semantics : require
#extension GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix : require
#extension GL_NV_cooperative_matrix2 : require
#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_basic : require
#extension GL_EXT_control_flow_attributes : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#define DLSS_E4M3_HW 1
#include "common.glsl"

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint K = 32;
layout(constant_id = 1) const uint TILES = 4;      // 16-column tiles per subgroup; BN = 16 * TILES
layout(constant_id = 2) const uint FLAGS = 0;
layout(constant_id = 3) const uint PARTITION = 0;
layout(constant_id = 4) const uint DEPTH = 4;      // global -> register prefetch depth in k32 steps (1..4)
layout(constant_id = 5) const uint PADV4 = 1;      // shared row padding in uvec4 units (bank spread)
layout(constant_id = 7) const uint SUBGROUPS = 4;  // 16-row tiles per workgroup; BM = 16 * SUBGROUPS
layout(local_size_x_id = 8) in;                    // = 32 * SUBGROUPS
layout(constant_id = 9) const uint SPLITK = 1;     // K partitions computed by separate workgroups (partials to binding 2)
layout(constant_id = 10) const uint KSTEP = 32;    // K per staged step and barrier: 32 or 64 (two k32 tiles, one flexible multiply)
const uint KW = KSTEP / 16u;                        // uvec4 words of K per staged row

const uint F_RESIDUAL = 1u;
const uint F_SCALE_RESIDUAL = 2u;
const uint F_SILU = 8u;
const uint F_QUANTIZE = 16u;
const uint F_DUAL = 32u;
const uint F_RESIDUAL_E4 = 64u;
const uint F_BROADCAST_INPUT = 128u;

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint rows;
  uint N;
  uint Nmatrix;
  uint weightColumnOffset;
  uint inputStride;
  uint inputColumnBase;
  uint outputStride;
  uint outputColumnOffset;
  uint auxHalfOffset;   // per-column f16 scale vector, in half units within binding 4 (16-byte aligned)
  uint batches;
  uint columnGroups;
  uint splitStride;     // SPLITK > 1: f16 elements per partition slice of the partial buffer
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer InputA { uvec4 a4[]; };            // E4M3 [rows][inputStride]
layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer InputB { uvec4 b4[]; };            // E4M3 [batch][K/32][Nmatrix][32]
layout(std430, binding = 2) writeonly buffer OutputHalf { uvec4 out16x8[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 3) readonly buffer ResidualHalf { uvec4 residual16x8[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 3) readonly buffer ResidualHalfFlat { float16_t residual16[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 3) readonly buffer ResidualHalfPairs { f16vec2 residual16x2[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 4) readonly buffer Aux { uvec4 aux16x8[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 4) readonly buffer AuxPairs { f16vec2 aux16x2[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer OutputE4 { uvec4 out8x16[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 6) readonly buffer ResidualE4 { uvec4 residual8x16[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 6) readonly buffer ResidualE4Pairs { uint16_t residual8x2[]; };

const uint THREADS = 32u * SUBGROUPS;
const uint BM = 16u * SUBGROUPS;
const uint BN = TILES * 16u;
const uint ROWV4 = KW + PADV4;                        // uvec4 per staged row: KSTEP bytes of K plus padding
const uint A_PER_THREAD = (BM * KW + THREADS - 1u) / THREADS;
const uint B_PER_THREAD = (KW * BN + THREADS - 1u) / THREADS;
const uint STAGE_WORDS = 2u * (BM + BN) * ROWV4;      // two operand buffers
// Epilogue staging: per subgroup [16][64] f16 at a 9-word stride (bank-conflict free), reusing the operand buffers.
const uint EPI_WORDS = SUBGROUPS * 16u * 9u;
const uint SHARED_WORDS = STAGE_WORDS > EPI_WORDS ? STAGE_WORDS : EPI_WORDS;
shared uvec4 stage[SHARED_WORDS];
shared float16_t tileStage[SUBGROUPS * 256u];         // per-subgroup 16x16 accumulator staging (residual prologue)

#define ACC coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>
#define MAT_A coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, KSTEP, gl_MatrixUseA>
#define MAT_B coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, KSTEP, 16, gl_MatrixUseB>

void subgroupSync() { subgroupMemoryBarrierShared(); subgroupBarrier(); }

// Two consecutive columns of one row: residual pair as f32 (prologue path).
vec2 loadResidualPair(uint pairIndex) {
  if ((FLAGS & F_RESIDUAL_E4) != 0u) {
    uint packed = uint(residual8x2[pairIndex]);
    return vec2(e4m3ToF32(packed & 0xffu), e4m3ToF32(packed >> 8u));
  }
  return vec2(residual16x2[pairIndex]);
}

vec2 auxPair(uint column) { return vec2(aux16x2[(pc.auxHalfOffset + column) >> 1u]); }

// Sixteen residual values (16 columns) as eight f32 pairs.
void loadResidual16(uint elementIndex, out vec2 r[8]) {
  if ((FLAGS & F_RESIDUAL_E4) != 0u) {
    uvec4 codes = residual8x16[elementIndex >> 4u];
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) {
      uint pair = (codes[i >> 1u] >> ((i & 1u) * 16u)) & 0xffffu;
      r[i] = vec2(e4m3HwToF32(pair & 0xffu), e4m3HwToF32(pair >> 8u));
    }
  } else {
    uvec4 w0 = residual16x8[elementIndex >> 3u], w1 = residual16x8[(elementIndex >> 3u) + 1u];
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) { r[i] = vec2(unpackFloat2x16(w0[i])); r[4u + i] = vec2(unpackFloat2x16(w1[i])); }
  }
}

// Publication of sixteen accumulator halves (two words): output element index `index`
// (row * stride + batch column base + column, 16-aligned), scale vector column `column`.
void publish16(uvec4 v0, uvec4 v1, uint index, uint column) {
  if ((FLAGS & F_SILU) != 0u) {
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) {
      v0[i] = packFloat2x16(siluPair(unpackFloat2x16(v0[i])));
      v1[i] = packFloat2x16(siluPair(unpackFloat2x16(v1[i])));
    }
  }
  if ((FLAGS & (F_QUANTIZE | F_DUAL)) != 0u) {
    uvec4 codes;
    codes.x = uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(v0[0]))) | (uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(v0[1]))) << 16u);
    codes.y = uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(v0[2]))) | (uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(v0[3]))) << 16u);
    codes.z = uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(v1[0]))) | (uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(v1[1]))) << 16u);
    codes.w = uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(v1[2]))) | (uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(v1[3]))) << 16u);
    out8x16[index >> 4u] = codes;
  }
  if ((FLAGS & F_QUANTIZE) == 0u) { out16x8[index >> 3u] = v0; out16x8[(index >> 3u) + 1u] = v1; }
}

void main() {
  const uint thread = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
  const uint subgroup = gl_SubgroupID;
  const uint lane = gl_SubgroupInvocationID;
  const uint split = gl_WorkGroupID.x % SPLITK;
  const uint columnLinear = gl_WorkGroupID.x / SPLITK;
  const uint batch = columnLinear / pc.columnGroups;
  const uint columnGroup = columnLinear % pc.columnGroups;
  const uint blockRow = (gl_WorkGroupID.y + gl_WorkGroupID.z * 65535u) * BM;
  const uint rowBase = blockRow + subgroup * 16u;
  const uint colBase = columnGroup * BN;
  const uint stageBase = subgroup * 256u;
  const uint outColumn = pc.outputColumnOffset + batch * pc.N;
  const bool rowsValid = rowBase < pc.rows;   // whole 16-row tile beyond the end: no MMAs, no stores

  ACC acc[TILES];
  ACC total[TILES];
  // Native mma.sync starts from FP16 accumulators holding the scaled skip.
  const bool seedResidual = (FLAGS & F_RESIDUAL) != 0u && split == 0u;
  [[unroll]] for (uint t = 0u; t < TILES; ++t) {
    if (seedResidual) {
      if ((FLAGS & (F_SCALE_RESIDUAL | F_RESIDUAL_E4)) == 0u) {
        // Plain half residual: load the C tile directly (rows past the end read padding rows).
        uint row = min(rowBase, pc.rows - 1u);
        coopMatLoad(acc[t], residual16, row * pc.outputStride + outColumn + colBase + t * 16u, pc.outputStride,
                    gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      } else {
        acc[t] = ACC(0.0);   // filled below from the staged, scaled residual
      }
    } else {
      acc[t] = ACC(0.0);
    }
  }
  const uint epiBase = subgroup * 16u * 9u;   // per-subgroup f16 [16][64] staging, 9-word rows
  // Epilogue/prologue lane mapping: a pass covers up to 4 tiles (64 columns); LPR lanes share a row,
  // each handling 16 columns (two words) with 16-byte accesses; RPI rows per instruction.
  const uint LPR4 = 4u, RPI4 = 8u;   // 4-tile passes
  if (seedResidual && (FLAGS & (F_SCALE_RESIDUAL | F_RESIDUAL_E4)) != 0u && rowsValid) {
    // Scaled and/or E4 residual: round_f16(residual * scale) staged as f16 with 16-byte loads, in passes of
    // up to four tiles (all loads of a pass in flight together), then loaded as the C fragments.
    [[unroll]] for (uint pass = 0u; pass < TILES; pass += 4u) {
      const uint passTiles = (TILES - pass) < 4u ? (TILES - pass) : 4u;
      const uint lpr = passTiles == 1u ? 1u : (passTiles == 2u ? 2u : 4u);
      const uint rpi = 32u / lpr;
      const uint quarter = lane % lpr;
      [[unroll]] for (uint it = 0u; it < (16u + rpi - 1u) / rpi; ++it) {
        uint r = it * rpi + lane / lpr;
        uint row = rowBase + r;
        if (r < 16u && quarter < passTiles && row < pc.rows) {
          uint column = colBase + pass * 16u + quarter * 16u;
          vec2 res[8];
          loadResidual16(row * pc.outputStride + outColumn + column, res);
          if ((FLAGS & F_SCALE_RESIDUAL) != 0u) {
            uvec4 s0 = aux16x8[(pc.auxHalfOffset + column) >> 3u], s1 = aux16x8[((pc.auxHalfOffset + column) >> 3u) + 1u];
            [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) { res[i] *= vec2(unpackFloat2x16(s0[i])); res[4u + i] *= vec2(unpackFloat2x16(s1[i])); }
          }
          uvec4 w0, w1;
          [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) { w0[i] = packFloat2x16(f16vec2(res[i])); w1[i] = packFloat2x16(f16vec2(res[4u + i])); }
          stage[epiBase + r * 9u + quarter * 2u] = w0;
          stage[epiBase + r * 9u + quarter * 2u + 1u] = w1;
        }
      }
      subgroupSync();
      [[unroll]] for (uint t = 0u; t < passTiles; ++t)
        coopMatLoad(acc[pass + t], stage, epiBase + t * 2u, 9u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      subgroupSync();
    }
  }
  barrier();   // the prologue staging aliases the operand buffers

  // Per-thread staging assignment: A words idx = thread + THREADS * i -> row idx / KW, word idx % KW of the
  // row's KSTEP-byte slice; B words idx -> n row idx / KW, word idx % KW (k32 tile 2s + (word >> 1), half word & 1).
  const uint aColumnBase = pc.inputColumnBase + (((FLAGS & F_BROADCAST_INPUT) != 0u) ? 0u : batch * K);
  const uint steps = K / KSTEP / SPLITK;        // steps of this workgroup's partition
  const uint kBegin = split * steps;
  // B k32 tile j: words (((batch * K/32 + j) * Nmatrix + weightColumnOffset + colBase) + n) * 2 + half.
  const uint bTile0 = ((batch * (K / 32u)) * pc.Nmatrix + pc.weightColumnOffset + colBase) * 2u;
  const uint bTileStride = pc.Nmatrix * 2u;
  const uint A_WORDS = BM * ROWV4;   // per buffer
  const uint B_WORDS = BN * ROWV4;
  uint aIndex[A_PER_THREAD];
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < A_PER_THREAD; ++i) {
    uint idx = thread + THREADS * i;
    uint row = min(idx / KW, BM - 1u);
    aIndex[i] = (min(blockRow + row, pc.rows - 1u) * pc.inputStride + aColumnBase) / 16u + (idx % KW);
  }
  uvec4 ra[4 * A_PER_THREAD];
  uvec4 rb[4 * B_PER_THREAD];

#define LOAD_STEP(d, step) \
  { \
    uint kv = (kBegin + (step)) * KW; \
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < A_PER_THREAD; ++i) \
      ra[(d) * A_PER_THREAD + i] = a4[aIndex[i] + kv]; \
    uint tileBase = bTile0 + (kBegin + (step)) * (KW / 2u) * bTileStride; \
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < B_PER_THREAD; ++i) { \
      uint idx = min(thread + THREADS * i, KW * BN - 1u); \
      uint n = idx / KW, w = idx % KW; \
      rb[(d) * B_PER_THREAD + i] = b4[tileBase + (w >> 1u) * bTileStride + n * 2u + (w & 1u)]; \
    } \
  }
#define STORE_STEP(d, buf) \
  { \
    uint aOff = (buf) * (A_WORDS + B_WORDS); \
    uint bOff = aOff + A_WORDS; \
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < A_PER_THREAD; ++i) { \
      uint idx = thread + THREADS * i; \
      if (idx < BM * KW) stage[aOff + (idx / KW) * ROWV4 + (idx % KW)] = ra[(d) * A_PER_THREAD + i]; \
    } \
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < B_PER_THREAD; ++i) { \
      uint idx = thread + THREADS * i; \
      if (idx < KW * BN) stage[bOff + (idx / KW) * ROWV4 + (idx % KW)] = rb[(d) * B_PER_THREAD + i]; \
    } \
  }
#define MMA_STEP(step, buf)                                                                    \
  {                                                                                            \
    if (rowsValid) {                                                                           \
      uint aOff = (buf) * (A_WORDS + B_WORDS);                                                 \
      uint bOff = aOff + A_WORDS;                                                              \
      MAT_A ma;                                                                                \
      coopMatLoad(ma, stage, aOff + subgroup * 16u * ROWV4, ROWV4, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor); \
      [[unroll]] for (uint t = 0u; t < TILES; ++t) {                                           \
        MAT_B mb;                                                                              \
        coopMatLoad(mb, stage, bOff + t * 16u * ROWV4, ROWV4, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor); \
        acc[t] = coopMatMulAdd(ma, mb, acc[t]);                   \
      }                                                                                        \
      uint kb = (step) * KSTEP;                                                                  \
      if (PARTITION != 0u && (((kb + KSTEP) % PARTITION) == 0u || kb + KSTEP >= K)) {              \
        [[unroll]] for (uint t = 0u; t < TILES; ++t) {                                         \
          if (kb < PARTITION) total[t] = acc[t];                                               \
          else total[t] = total[t] + acc[t];                                                   \
          acc[t] = ACC(0.0);                                                                   \
        }                                                                                      \
      }                                                                                        \
    }                                                                                          \
  }
#define RUN_STEP(d)                                                                            \
  if ((d) < DEPTH && base + (d) < steps) {                                                     \
    uint step = base + (d);                                                                    \
    uint buf = step & 1u;                                                                      \
    STORE_STEP(d, buf)                                                                         \
    if (step + DEPTH < steps) LOAD_STEP(d, step + DEPTH)                                       \
    barrier();                                                    \
    MMA_STEP(step, buf)                                                                        \
  }

  // Prologue: the first DEPTH steps in flight.
  if (0u < steps) LOAD_STEP(0, 0u)
  if (1u < DEPTH && 1u < steps) LOAD_STEP(1, 1u)
  if (2u < DEPTH && 2u < steps) LOAD_STEP(2, 2u)
  if (3u < DEPTH && 3u < steps) LOAD_STEP(3, 3u)
  for (uint base = 0u; base < steps; base += DEPTH) {
    RUN_STEP(0)
    RUN_STEP(1)
    RUN_STEP(2)
    RUN_STEP(3)
  }
  if (PARTITION != 0u) {
    [[unroll]] for (uint t = 0u; t < TILES; ++t) acc[t] = total[t];
  }
  barrier();   // operand buffers are dead: the epilogue staging reuses them
  if (!rowsValid) return;

  if (SPLITK > 1u) {
    // Partial accumulators of this partition as raw f16 [rows][N] at split * splitStride.
    [[unroll]] for (uint pass = 0u; pass < TILES; pass += 4u) {
      const uint passTiles = (TILES - pass) < 4u ? (TILES - pass) : 4u;
      [[unroll]] for (uint t = 0u; t < passTiles; ++t)
        coopMatStore(acc[pass + t], stage, epiBase + t * 2u, 9u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      subgroupSync();
      const uint lpr = passTiles == 1u ? 1u : (passTiles == 2u ? 2u : 4u);
      const uint rpi = 32u / lpr;
      const uint quarter = lane % lpr;
      [[unroll]] for (uint it = 0u; it < (16u + rpi - 1u) / rpi; ++it) {
        uint r = it * rpi + lane / lpr;
        uint row = rowBase + r;
        if (r < 16u && quarter < passTiles && row < pc.rows) {
          uint column = colBase + pass * 16u + quarter * 16u;
          uint index = split * pc.splitStride + row * pc.N + batch * pc.N * pc.rows + column;
          out16x8[index >> 3u] = stage[epiBase + r * 9u + quarter * 2u];
          out16x8[(index >> 3u) + 1u] = stage[epiBase + r * 9u + quarter * 2u + 1u];
        }
      }
      subgroupSync();
    }
    return;
  }
  // Epilogue in passes of up to four tiles (64 columns): stage the tiles as f16 [16][64] per subgroup
  // (9-word row stride), then lanes publish 16 columns each with 16-byte accesses (full sectors).
  [[unroll]] for (uint pass = 0u; pass < TILES; pass += 4u) {
    const uint passTiles = (TILES - pass) < 4u ? (TILES - pass) : 4u;
    [[unroll]] for (uint t = 0u; t < passTiles; ++t)
      coopMatStore(acc[pass + t], stage, epiBase + t * 2u, 9u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
    subgroupSync();
    const uint lpr = passTiles == 1u ? 1u : (passTiles == 2u ? 2u : 4u);
    const uint rpi = 32u / lpr;
    const uint quarter = lane % lpr;
    [[unroll]] for (uint it = 0u; it < (16u + rpi - 1u) / rpi; ++it) {
      uint r = it * rpi + lane / lpr;
      uint row = rowBase + r;
      if (r < 16u && quarter < passTiles && row < pc.rows) {
        uint column = colBase + pass * 16u + quarter * 16u;
        uvec4 v0 = stage[epiBase + r * 9u + quarter * 2u], v1 = stage[epiBase + r * 9u + quarter * 2u + 1u];
        publish16(v0, v1, row * pc.outputStride + outColumn + column, column);
      }
    }
    subgroupSync();
  }
}

```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/gemm_mlp.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Fused two-layer FP8 MLP: D = E4( E4(SiLU(A * W1)) * W2 ), the expert FFN paths
// (C -> 128 -> 32 per expert) and the split-512 branches (64 -> 256 -> 64).
//
// v2 (fragment level, VK_NV_cooperative_matrix2): the hidden activation is a 16x128
// accumulator fragment per subgroup (one flexible multiply per k32 step), SiLU is a
// per-element operation and the E4M3 publication a Use conversion in registers; W2 is
// applied as one multiply per 128-wide hidden chunk from a staged [NOUT][128] tile. The
// K order (W1 steps, then hidden chunks in order) is the same accumulation chain as the
// separate GEMMs. Shared memory: the double-buffered W1 operands only (12 KB).
//
// Weights: W1 k32-tile-major per batch [batch][K/32][HIDDEN][32]; W2 N-major per batch
// [batch][NOUT][HIDDEN] (K contiguous).
#extension GL_EXT_float_e4m3 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_KHR_memory_scope_semantics : require
#extension GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix : require
#extension GL_NV_cooperative_matrix2 : require
#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_basic : require
#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_shuffle : require
#extension GL_EXT_control_flow_attributes : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#define DLSS_E4M3_HW 1
#include "common.glsl"
#include "publish.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 128) in;   // four subgroups, 16 rows each

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint K = 64;         // input channels per batch
layout(constant_id = 1) const uint HIDDEN = 128;   // W1 output columns per batch (multiple of 128)
layout(constant_id = 2) const uint NOUT = 32;      // W2 output columns per batch (32 or 64)
layout(constant_id = 3) const uint FLAGS = 0;
layout(constant_id = 5) const uint DEPTH = 2;      // global -> register prefetch depth in k32 steps
const uint F_BROADCAST_INPUT = 1u;   // every batch reads the same input columns

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint rows;
  uint inputStride;        // input row length in elements
  uint inputColumnBase;
  uint outputStride;
  uint outputColumnOffset;
  uint batches;
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer InputA { uvec4 a4[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer WeightsOne { uvec4 w1v[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 2) readonly buffer WeightsTwo { uvec4 w2v[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer OutputE4 { uvec4 out8x16[]; };

const uint A_WORDS = 64u * 3u;          // A tile [64][32] as 2 words per row + 1 pad
const uint B1_WORDS = 128u * 3u;        // W1 tile [128 n][32 k] + pad
const uint BUF_WORDS = A_WORDS + B1_WORDS;
const uint BUFFERS = 2u;   // double-buffered operands
shared uvec4 stage[BUFFERS * BUF_WORDS];     // double-buffered W1 operands; then the W2 chunk tile [NOUT][128 k] (9-word rows)
shared uint stage32[4u * 16u * 16u];          // output row tiles as 32-bit words: [subgroup][16 rows][NOUT/4 words]

#define ACC16x128 coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 128, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>
#define ACCOUT coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, NOUT, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>
#define A16x32 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 32, gl_MatrixUseA>
#define A16x128 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 128, gl_MatrixUseA>
#define B32x128 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 32, 128, gl_MatrixUseB>
#define B128xOUT coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 128, NOUT, gl_MatrixUseB>

float16_t siluElement(const in uint row, const in uint col, const in float16_t value) { return siluHalf(value); }

void main() {
  const uint thread = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
  const uint subgroup = gl_SubgroupID;
  const uint batch = gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  const uint blockRow = (gl_WorkGroupID.y + gl_WorkGroupID.z * 65535u) * 64u;
  const uint rowBase = blockRow + subgroup * 16u;
  const bool rowsValid = rowBase < pc.rows;

  // Staging assignment: A row half (thread >> 1, thread & 1); W1 tile words thread and thread + 128.
  const uint aRow = thread >> 1u, aHalf = thread & 1u;
  const uint aColumnBase = pc.inputColumnBase + (((FLAGS & F_BROADCAST_INPUT) != 0u) ? 0u : batch * K);
  const uint aIndex = (min(blockRow + aRow, pc.rows - 1u) * pc.inputStride + aColumnBase) / 16u + aHalf;
  const uint kSteps = K / 32u;
  const uint w1Batch = batch * kSteps * HIDDEN * 2u;          // words
  const uint w2Batch = batch * NOUT * HIDDEN / 16u;           // words: [NOUT][HIDDEN] bytes

  ACCOUT acc2 = ACCOUT(0.0);
  for (uint chunk = 0u; chunk < HIDDEN / 128u; ++chunk) {
    // ---- W1 for this 128-wide hidden chunk: one flexible multiply per k32 step.
    ACC16x128 hidden = ACC16x128(0.0);
    const uint chunkWord = chunk * 128u * 2u;
    // Register prefetch DEPTH steps ahead: slot d holds step s with s % DEPTH == d.
    uvec4 ra[DEPTH], rb0[DEPTH], rb1[DEPTH];
    [[unroll]] for (uint d = 0u; d < DEPTH; ++d) {
      if (d < kSteps) {
        uint tile = w1Batch + d * HIDDEN * 2u + chunkWord;
        ra[d] = a4[aIndex + d * 2u];
        rb0[d] = w1v[tile + thread];
        rb1[d] = w1v[tile + 128u + thread];
      }
    }
    // W2 chunk tile words for this thread, issued before the K loop so the loads complete during it.
    uvec4 rw2[NOUT * 8u / 128u];
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < NOUT * 8u / 128u; ++i) {
      uint idx = thread + 128u * i;
      rw2[i] = w2v[w2Batch + ((idx >> 3u) * HIDDEN + chunk * 128u) / 16u + (idx & 7u)];
    }
    for (uint base = 0u; base < kSteps; base += DEPTH) {
      [[unroll]] for (uint d = 0u; d < DEPTH; ++d) {
        const uint s = base + d;
        if (s < kSteps) {
          const uint buf = (BUFFERS == 1u) ? 0u : (s & 1u) * BUF_WORDS;
          if (BUFFERS == 1u && s != 0u) barrier();   // previous step's fragment loads done
          stage[buf + aRow * 3u + aHalf] = ra[d];
          stage[buf + A_WORDS + (thread >> 1u) * 3u + (thread & 1u)] = rb0[d];              // n rows 0..63
          stage[buf + A_WORDS + (64u + (thread >> 1u)) * 3u + (thread & 1u)] = rb1[d];      // n rows 64..127
          if (s + DEPTH < kSteps) {
            uint tile = w1Batch + (s + DEPTH) * HIDDEN * 2u + chunkWord;
            ra[d] = a4[aIndex + (s + DEPTH) * 2u];
            rb0[d] = w1v[tile + thread];
            rb1[d] = w1v[tile + 128u + thread];
          }
          barrier();
          if (rowsValid) {
            A16x32 ma; coopMatLoad(ma, stage, buf + subgroup * 16u * 3u, 3u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
            B32x128 mb; coopMatLoad(mb, stage, buf + A_WORDS, 3u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);
            hidden = coopMatMulAdd(ma, mb, hidden);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    barrier();   // last step's operand reads done before the staging area is reused
    // ---- SiLU + E4 in registers; W2 chunk tile [NOUT n][128 k] staged (9-word rows), one multiply.
    coopMatPerElementNV(hidden, hidden, siluElement);
    A16x128 hiddenE4 = A16x128(hidden);
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < NOUT * 8u / 128u; ++i) {
      uint idx = thread + 128u * i;
      stage[(idx >> 3u) * 9u + (idx & 7u)] = rw2[i];
    }
    barrier();
    if (rowsValid) {
      B128xOUT w2; coopMatLoad(w2, stage, 0u, 9u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);
      acc2 = coopMatMulAdd(hiddenE4, w2, acc2);
    }
    barrier();   // W2 tile reads done before the next chunk stages W1 operands
  }

  // ---- Output: E4 of the W2 accumulators, NOUT columns per row at outputColumnOffset + batch * NOUT.
  if (!rowsValid) return;
  // Publication: lane (g, t) holds rows g, g+8 and columns 8j + 2t, +1 (j < NOUT/8) of the accumulator. Lanes t
  // and t^1 exchange one pair so that the even lane assembles the 32-bit word (columns 8j + 4(t>>1) .. +3) of row g
  // and the odd lane that of row g+8; the words form this subgroup's [16][NOUT] E4 row tile in shared memory,
  // from which each lane stores one 16-byte word per 32 columns (rows are allocated in whole 64-row groups).
  const uint lane = gl_SubgroupInvocationID;
  const uint g = lane >> 2u, t = lane & 3u;
  const uint rowWords = NOUT / 4u;                                    // 32-bit words per row
  const uint tileBase = subgroup * 16u * rowWords;
  PUBLISH_E4_TILE(acc2, NOUT, stage32, tileBase, g, t)
  subgroupBarrier();
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < NOUT / 32u; ++i) {
    uint w = lane + 32u * i;                          // 16-byte word: row w / (NOUT/16), column word w % (NOUT/16)
    uint r = w / (NOUT / 16u), cw = w % (NOUT / 16u);
    uint base = tileBase + r * rowWords + cw * 4u;
    out8x16[((rowBase + r) * pc.outputStride + pc.outputColumnOffset + batch * NOUT) / 16u + cw] =
        uvec4(stage32[base], stage32[base + 1u], stage32[base + 2u], stage32[base + 3u]);
  }
}
```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/gemm_reduce.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Split-K reduction + publication for gemm_fp8 (SPLITK > 1): the partial FP16
// accumulators of the K partitions are summed in partition order
// (((p0 + p1) + p2) + p3 ...), exactly the `total = total + acc` chain of the
// single-workgroup kernel, then published (SiLU, E4M3 quantization, f16).
#extension GL_EXT_float_e4m3 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_EXT_control_flow_attributes : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#define DLSS_E4M3_HW 1
#include "common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint SPLITK = 2;
layout(constant_id = 1) const uint FLAGS = 0;
const uint F_SILU = 8u;
const uint F_QUANTIZE = 16u;
const uint F_DUAL = 32u;

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint rows;
  uint N;
  uint splitStride;        // elements per partition slice in the partial buffer
  uint outputStride;
  uint outputColumnOffset;
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer Partials { uvec4 partial16x8[]; };   // f16 [SPLITK][rows][N]
layout(std430, binding = 2) writeonly buffer OutputHalf { uvec4 out16x8[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer OutputE4 { uvec2 out8x8[]; };

void main() {
  uint group = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x + gl_GlobalInvocationID.y * 65535u * 256u;   // 8 columns
  uint groupsPerRow = pc.N / 8u;
  uint row = group / groupsPerRow, column = (group % groupsPerRow) * 8u;
  if (row >= pc.rows) return;
  uvec4 total = partial16x8[(row * pc.N + column) >> 3u];
  [[unroll]] for (uint s = 1u; s < SPLITK; ++s) {
    uvec4 part = partial16x8[(s * pc.splitStride + row * pc.N + column) >> 3u];
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) {
      precise f16vec2 sum = unpackFloat2x16(total[i]) + unpackFloat2x16(part[i]);
      total[i] = packFloat2x16(sum);
    }
  }
  if ((FLAGS & F_SILU) != 0u) {
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) total[i] = packFloat2x16(siluPair(unpackFloat2x16(total[i])));
  }
  uint index = row * pc.outputStride + pc.outputColumnOffset + column;
  if ((FLAGS & (F_QUANTIZE | F_DUAL)) != 0u) {
    uvec2 codes;
    codes.x = uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(total[0]))) | (uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(total[1]))) << 16u);
    codes.y = uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(total[2]))) | (uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(total[3]))) << 16u);
    out8x8[index >> 3u] = codes;
  }
  if ((FLAGS & F_QUANTIZE) == 0u) out16x8[index >> 3u] = total;
}
```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/global_attend.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Global ViT cosine attention (exact Ada FP8 MMA).
// One subgroup per (head, 16-query tile). Keys run over the 64-padded token
// count in natural order. Padding keys have zero K/V, so they add nothing to the
// numerator, but their score is still 0 and still exponentiates: the denominator
// therefore carries padding * exp(0), which is subtracted once at the end.
// Dropping them from the sum instead is a different function, not an optimization.
// Unlike the window kernel, the E4M3 weights are unnormalized and the
// reciprocal is applied to the value accumulator afterwards.
#extension GL_EXT_float_e4m3 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_KHR_memory_scope_semantics : require
#extension GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix : require
#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_basic : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 32) in;

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint PADDED_TOKENS = 192;

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint tokens;
  uint heads;
  uint channels;
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer Normalized { uint8_t qkv[]; };   // E4M3 [paddedTokens][channels*3]
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer Attended { uint8_t attended[]; }; // E4M3 [tokens][channels]

shared float16_t scores[16u * PADDED_TOKENS];
shared uint8_t weights[16u * PADDED_TOKENS];
shared float16_t outputs[16u * 32u];
shared float16_t reciprocals[16];

float16_t vitExpWeight(float16_t score) {
  // Global-ViT approximation constants (f32 literals converted to half by PTX).
  precise float16_t affine = fma(score, float16_t(0.08953946828842163), float16_t(1.7093614339828491));
  affine = clamp(affine, float16_t(1.439453125), float16_t(1.9775390625));
  uint bits = f16Bits(affine);
  uint exponentialBits = ((bits << 4u) + 0x4000u) & 0xffffu;
  return f16FromBits(exponentialBits);
}

float16_t softmaxPair(uint row, uint base, uint pair, uint parity) {
  uint key = row * PADDED_TOKENS + base + pair * 2u + parity;
  precise float16_t a = scores[key] + scores[key + 8u];
  precise float16_t b = scores[key + 16u] + scores[key + 24u];
  precise float16_t c = scores[key + 32u] + scores[key + 40u];
  precise float16_t d = scores[key + 48u] + scores[key + 56u];
  precise float16_t ab = a + b;
  precise float16_t abc = ab + c;
  return abc + d;
}

float16_t softmax64(uint row, uint base) {
  precise float16_t e0 = softmaxPair(row, base, 0u, 0u) + softmaxPair(row, base, 1u, 0u);
  precise float16_t e1 = e0 + softmaxPair(row, base, 2u, 0u);
  precise float16_t even = e1 + softmaxPair(row, base, 3u, 0u);
  precise float16_t o0 = softmaxPair(row, base, 0u, 1u) + softmaxPair(row, base, 1u, 1u);
  precise float16_t o1 = o0 + softmaxPair(row, base, 2u, 1u);
  precise float16_t odd = o1 + softmaxPair(row, base, 3u, 1u);
  return even + odd;
}

void main() {
  const uint lane = gl_SubgroupInvocationID;
  const uint head = gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  const uint qTile = gl_WorkGroupID.y;
  const uint stride3 = pc.channels * 3u;
  const uint headBase = head * 96u;
  const uint qBase = qTile * 16u * stride3 + headBase;

  coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 32, gl_MatrixUseA> mq;
  coopMatLoad(mq, qkv, qBase, stride3, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
  for (uint kTile = 0u; kTile < PADDED_TOKENS / 16u; ++kTile) {
    coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 32, 16, gl_MatrixUseB> mk;
    coopMatLoad(mk, qkv, kTile * 16u * stride3 + headBase + 32u, stride3, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);
    coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator> mc =
        coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>(0.0);
    mc = coopMatMulAdd(mq, mk, mc);
    coopMatStore(mc, scores, kTile * 16u, PADDED_TOKENS, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
  }
  barrier();
  for (uint i = lane; i < 16u * PADDED_TOKENS; i += 32u) scores[i] = vitExpWeight(scores[i]);
  barrier();

  if (lane < 16u) {
    precise float16_t total = float16_t(0.0);
    for (uint base = 0u; base < PADDED_TOKENS; base += 64u) total = total + softmax64(lane, base);
    uint padding = PADDED_TOKENS - pc.tokens;
    if (padding > 0u) {
      precise float16_t correction = float16_t(float(vitExpWeight(float16_t(0.0))) * float(padding));
      total = total - correction;
    }
    reciprocals[lane] = float16_t(1.0 / float(total));
  }
  for (uint i = lane; i < 16u * PADDED_TOKENS; i += 32u) {
    weights[i] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(scores[i])));
  }
  barrier();

  for (uint cTile = 0u; cTile < 2u; ++cTile) {
    coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator> mc =
        coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>(0.0);
    for (uint kb = 0u; kb < PADDED_TOKENS; kb += 32u) {
      coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 32, gl_MatrixUseA> mp;
      coopMatLoad(mp, weights, kb, PADDED_TOKENS, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 32, 16, gl_MatrixUseB> mv;
      coopMatLoad(mv, qkv, kb * stride3 + headBase + 64u + cTile * 16u, stride3, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      mc = coopMatMulAdd(mp, mv, mc);
    }
    coopMatStore(mc, outputs, cTile * 16u, 32u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
  }
  barrier();

  for (uint i = lane; i < 16u * 32u; i += 32u) {
    uint row = i >> 5u, component = i & 31u;
    uint token = qTile * 16u + row;
    if (token >= pc.tokens) continue;
    precise float value = roundF16(float(outputs[i]) * float(reciprocals[row]));
    attended[token * pc.channels + head * 32u + component] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF32(value));
  }
}
```
