`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/global_attention.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Fused global ViT cosine attention (normalize + attend) for one
// (head, 64-query block): replaces global_normalize.comp + global_attend.comp.
// Every workgroup normalizes the head's K/V rows of all padded tokens into
// shared memory (natural token order, zero rows for padding), its four
// subgroups normalize their 16 query rows each, then per 64-key block:
// S = Q K^T (no prior), the ViT exponential, the specified block sum, unnormalized
// E4M3 weights and P·V accumulated over the blocks in K order. The row total is
// ((b0 + b1) + b2 ...) minus the padding correction; the half reciprocal is
// applied to the value accumulator afterwards.
//
// Arithmetic identical to the verified unfused kernels; the lane layouts are the
// attention_common.glsl ones (one lane per token for the norms, one lane pair
// per S row for the softmax with the exponentials kept in registers).
#extension GL_EXT_float_e4m3 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_KHR_memory_scope_semantics : require
#extension GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix : require
#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_basic : require
#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_shuffle : require
#extension GL_EXT_control_flow_attributes : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#define DLSS_E4M3_HW 1
#include "common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 128) in;

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint PADDED_TOKENS = 192;   // multiple of 64
layout(constant_id = 1) const uint CHUNK_TOKENS = 192;    // keys staged in shared memory at a time (multiple of 64, <= PADDED)
layout(constant_id = 2) const uint PRENORMALIZED = 0;     // 1: binding 0 holds the E4 normalized q/k/v of global_normalize

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint tokens;
  uint heads;
  uint channels;        // heads * 32
  uint scaleWordOffset; // per-head f32 learned scale, in words within binding 4
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer Qkv { uvec4 qkv4[]; };          // f16 [paddedTokens][heads*96] as words
layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer NormalizedQkv { uvec4 norm4[]; };  // PRENORMALIZED: E4 [tokens][heads*96] as words
layout(std430, binding = 4) readonly buffer Aux { uint aux32[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer Attended { uvec4 attended16[]; };  // E4 [tokens][channels] as words
layout(std430, binding = 7) readonly buffer Prior { float16_t prior[]; };   // unused (attention_common contract)

const uint BLOCKS = PADDED_TOKENS / 64u;
const uint CHUNK_BLOCKS = CHUNK_TOKENS / 64u;
// kv4: K E4 rows [CHUNK_TOKENS][32] then V rows, 2 words each. priv4: attention_common layout.
shared uvec4 kv4[2u * CHUNK_TOKENS * 2u];
shared uvec4 priv4[4 * 176];

#include "attention_common.glsl"

// ViT exponential on a packed pair: half fma(score, 0.0895, 1.7094), clamp, per half (bits << 4) + 0x4000.
uint expWeightPairVit(uint scoreBits) {
  precise f16vec2 affine = fma(unpackFloat2x16(scoreBits), f16vec2(0.08953946828842163), f16vec2(1.7093614339828491));
  affine = clamp(affine, f16vec2(1.439453125), f16vec2(1.9775390625));
  uint bits = packFloat2x16(affine);
  uint lo = (((bits & 0xffffu) << 4u) + 0x4000u) & 0xffffu;
  uint hi = (((bits >> 16u) << 4u) + 0x4000u) & 0xffffu;
  return lo | (hi << 16u);
}

// ViT square sum: r[c] = f16(f32(v[c])^2 + f32(f16(v[c+16]^2))), then the stride 8/4/2/1 tree in half.
float16_t inverseNormVit(uvec4 w0, uvec4 w1, uvec4 w2, uvec4 w3) {
  f16vec2 p[16];
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) {
    p[i] = unpackFloat2x16(w0[i]); p[4u + i] = unpackFloat2x16(w1[i]);
    p[8u + i] = unpackFloat2x16(w2[i]); p[12u + i] = unpackFloat2x16(w3[i]);
  }
  f16vec2 r[8];
  [[unroll]] for (uint m = 0u; m < 8u; ++m) {
    precise f16vec2 highSquare = p[m + 8u] * p[m + 8u];
    precise vec2 square = vec2(p[m]) * vec2(p[m]);
    vec2 squareRounded = uintBitsToFloat(floatBitsToUint(square));   // no contraction into an fma
    precise vec2 sum = squareRounded + vec2(highSquare);
    r[m] = f16vec2(sum);
  }
  f16vec2 s8[4];
  [[unroll]] for (uint m = 0u; m < 4u; ++m) { precise f16vec2 s = r[m] + r[m + 4u]; s8[m] = s; }
  precise f16vec2 s4a = s8[0] + s8[2];
  precise f16vec2 s4b = s8[1] + s8[3];
  precise f16vec2 s2 = s4a + s4b;
  precise float16_t s1 = s2.x + s2.y;
  return float16_t(inversesqrt(float(s1)));
}

// 32 halves times norm (and for Q: times f16(sqrt 32) then the learned scale, three half multiplies), E4 codes.
void scaleQuantizeVit(uvec4 w0, uvec4 w1, uvec4 w2, uvec4 w3, float16_t norm, bool isQuery, float16_t learned,
                      out uvec4 e0, out uvec4 e1) {
  uvec4 words[4] = uvec4[4](w0, w1, w2, w3);
  const float16_t headScale = float16_t(sqrt(32.0));
  uint codes[8];
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) {
    f16vec2 a = unpackFloat2x16(words[i >> 1u][(i & 1u) * 2u]), b = unpackFloat2x16(words[i >> 1u][(i & 1u) * 2u + 1u]);
    precise f16vec2 na = a * norm;
    precise f16vec2 nb = b * norm;
    if (isQuery) {
      precise f16vec2 ha = na * headScale;
      precise f16vec2 hb = nb * headScale;
      precise f16vec2 la = ha * learned;
      precise f16vec2 lb = hb * learned;
      na = la; nb = lb;
    }
    codes[i] = e4x4(na, nb);
  }
  e0 = uvec4(codes[0], codes[1], codes[2], codes[3]);
  e1 = uvec4(codes[4], codes[5], codes[6], codes[7]);
}

void main() {
  const uint thread = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
  const uint q = gl_SubgroupID;
  const uint lane = gl_SubgroupInvocationID;
  const uint head = gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  const uint queryBlock = gl_WorkGroupID.y;
  const uint base = q * PRIV;
  const uint rowBase = q * 16u;
  const uint stride3Words = pc.channels * 3u / 8u;
  const uint headWord = head * 12u;
  const uint KP = 0u, VP = CHUNK_TOKENS * 2u;
  const float16_t learned = float16_t(uintBitsToFloat(aux32[pc.scaleWordOffset + head]));
  const uint strideE4Words = pc.channels * 3u / 16u;   // PRENORMALIZED rows: 16 E4 codes per word
  const uint headE4Word = head * 6u;

  // ---- Q of this subgroup's 16 tokens: one lane per token (lanes 16..31 idle).
  const uint queryToken = queryBlock * 64u + rowBase + (lane & 15u);
  if (lane < 16u) {
    bool valid = queryToken < pc.tokens;
    uvec4 e0, e1;
    if (PRENORMALIZED != 0u) {
      uint src = queryToken * strideE4Words + headE4Word;
      e0 = valid ? norm4[src] : uvec4(0u); e1 = valid ? norm4[src + 1u] : uvec4(0u);
    } else {
      uint src = queryToken * stride3Words + headWord;
      uvec4 q0 = valid ? qkv4[src] : uvec4(0u), q1 = valid ? qkv4[src + 1u] : uvec4(0u);
      uvec4 q2 = valid ? qkv4[src + 2u] : uvec4(0u), q3 = valid ? qkv4[src + 3u] : uvec4(0u);
      scaleQuantizeVit(q0, q1, q2, q3, inverseNormVit(q0, q1, q2, q3), true, learned, e0, e1);
    }
    priv4[base + (lane & 15u) * 2u] = valid ? e0 : uvec4(0u);
    priv4[base + (lane & 15u) * 2u + 1u] = valid ? e1 : uvec4(0u);
  }

  // ---- Attention over the key blocks. Lane pair per S row: row = lane >> 1, half hh = lane & 1.
  const uint lr = lane >> 1u, hh = lane & 1u;
  const uint sBase = base + F64;
  ACC mo[2];
  mo[0] = ACC(0.0); mo[1] = ACC(0.0);
  precise float16_t total = float16_t(0.0);
  MAT_A mq;
  for (uint chunk = 0u; chunk < PADDED_TOKENS; chunk += CHUNK_TOKENS) {
  // The last chunk is short when CHUNK_TOKENS does not divide PADDED_TOKENS; running the full four blocks
  // anyway would add whole blocks of padding keys to the softmax denominator that the correction below does
  // not know about.
  const uint chunkBlocks = min(CHUNK_BLOCKS, (PADDED_TOKENS - chunk) / 64u);
  // ---- K/V of this chunk's tokens (zero rows for padding): thread t handles tokens t, t + 128, ...
  barrier();   // the previous chunk's rows are dead (and the Q rows are visible before the first fragment load)
  for (uint local = thread; local < CHUNK_TOKENS; local += 128u) {
    const uint token = chunk + local;
    bool valid = token < pc.tokens;
    if (PRENORMALIZED != 0u) {
      uint src = token * strideE4Words + headE4Word;
      kv4[KP + local * 2u] = valid ? norm4[src + 2u] : uvec4(0u);
      kv4[KP + local * 2u + 1u] = valid ? norm4[src + 3u] : uvec4(0u);
      kv4[VP + local * 2u] = valid ? norm4[src + 4u] : uvec4(0u);
      kv4[VP + local * 2u + 1u] = valid ? norm4[src + 5u] : uvec4(0u);
    } else {
      uint src = token * stride3Words + headWord;
      uvec4 k0 = valid ? qkv4[src + 4u] : uvec4(0u), k1 = valid ? qkv4[src + 5u] : uvec4(0u);
      uvec4 k2 = valid ? qkv4[src + 6u] : uvec4(0u), k3 = valid ? qkv4[src + 7u] : uvec4(0u);
      uvec4 v0 = valid ? qkv4[src + 8u] : uvec4(0u), v1 = valid ? qkv4[src + 9u] : uvec4(0u);
      uvec4 v2 = valid ? qkv4[src + 10u] : uvec4(0u), v3 = valid ? qkv4[src + 11u] : uvec4(0u);
      uvec4 e0, e1;
      scaleQuantizeVit(k0, k1, k2, k3, inverseNormVit(k0, k1, k2, k3), false, learned, e0, e1);
      kv4[KP + local * 2u] = valid ? e0 : uvec4(0u);
      kv4[KP + local * 2u + 1u] = valid ? e1 : uvec4(0u);
      kv4[VP + local * 2u] = valid ? quantize16(v0, v1) : uvec4(0u);
      kv4[VP + local * 2u + 1u] = valid ? quantize16(v2, v3) : uvec4(0u);
    }
  }
  barrier();
  if (chunk == 0u) coopMatLoad(mq, priv4, base, 2u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
  for (uint block = 0u; block < chunkBlocks; ++block) {
    [[unroll]] for (uint kTile = 0u; kTile < 4u; ++kTile) {
      MAT_B mb; coopMatLoad(mb, kv4, KP + (block * 64u + kTile * 16u) * 2u, 2u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);
      ACC mc = ACC(0.0);
      mc = coopMatMulAdd(mq, mb, mc);
      coopMatStore(mc, priv4, sBase + kTile * 2u, 9u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
    }
    subgroupSync();
    {
      uint src = sBase + lr * 9u + hh * 4u;
      uvec4 s0 = priv4[src], s1 = priv4[src + 1u], s2 = priv4[src + 2u], s3 = priv4[src + 3u];
      uint e[16];
      [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) {
        e[i] = expWeightPairVit(s0[i]); e[4u + i] = expWeightPairVit(s1[i]);
        e[8u + i] = expWeightPairVit(s2[i]); e[12u + i] = expWeightPairVit(s3[i]);
      }
      // the specified block sum: b[g][j] = e[g+16j] + e[g+16j+8]; t[g] = ((b0+b1)+b2)+b3;
      // block = (((t0+t2)+t4)+t6) + (((t1+t3)+t5)+t7); running total = (total + block) per block in order.
      uint bOwn[8];
      [[unroll]] for (uint jl = 0u; jl < 2u; ++jl) {
        [[unroll]] for (uint m = 0u; m < 4u; ++m) {
          precise f16vec2 b = unpackFloat2x16(e[8u * jl + m]) + unpackFloat2x16(e[8u * jl + 4u + m]);
          bOwn[jl * 4u + m] = packFloat2x16(b);
        }
      }
      uint bOther[8];
      [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) bOther[i] = subgroupShuffleXor(bOwn[i], 1u);
      f16vec2 t[4];
      [[unroll]] for (uint m = 0u; m < 4u; ++m) {
        f16vec2 b0 = unpackFloat2x16(hh == 0u ? bOwn[m] : bOther[m]);
        f16vec2 b1 = unpackFloat2x16(hh == 0u ? bOwn[4u + m] : bOther[4u + m]);
        f16vec2 b2 = unpackFloat2x16(hh == 0u ? bOther[m] : bOwn[m]);
        f16vec2 b3 = unpackFloat2x16(hh == 0u ? bOther[4u + m] : bOwn[4u + m]);
        precise f16vec2 t01 = b0 + b1;
        precise f16vec2 t012 = t01 + b2;
        precise f16vec2 tm = t012 + b3;
        t[m] = tm;
      }
      precise float16_t e01 = t[0].x + t[1].x;
      precise float16_t e012 = e01 + t[2].x;
      precise float16_t even = e012 + t[3].x;
      precise float16_t o01 = t[0].y + t[1].y;
      precise float16_t o012 = o01 + t[2].y;
      precise float16_t odd = o012 + t[3].y;
      precise float16_t blockSum = even + odd;
      precise float16_t next = total + blockSum;
      total = next;
      // Unnormalized E4 weights of this block's keys -> P rows (words 0..3 of the S rows).
      uint codes[8];
      [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) codes[i] = e4x4Bits(e[2u * i], e[2u * i + 1u]);
      subgroupSync();
      priv4[sBase + lr * 9u + hh * 2u] = uvec4(codes[0], codes[1], codes[2], codes[3]);
      priv4[sBase + lr * 9u + hh * 2u + 1u] = uvec4(codes[4], codes[5], codes[6], codes[7]);
    }
    subgroupSync();
    [[unroll]] for (uint cTile = 0u; cTile < 2u; ++cTile) {
      [[unroll]] for (uint kb = 0u; kb < 64u; kb += 32u) {
        MAT_A mp; coopMatLoad(mp, priv4, sBase + (kb >> 4u), 9u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
        MAT_B mv; coopMatLoad(mv, kv4, VP + (block * 64u + kb) * 2u + cTile, 2u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
        mo[cTile] = coopMatMulAdd(mp, mv, mo[cTile]);
      }
    }
    subgroupSync();   // P rows dead before the next block's S tiles land
  }
  }
  // Padding correction and the half reciprocal (per row; both lanes of the pair hold the total).
  const uint padding = PADDED_TOKENS - pc.tokens;
  if (padding > 0u) {
    float16_t expZero = unpackFloat2x16(expWeightPairVit(0u)).x;
    precise float16_t correction = float16_t(float(expZero) * float(padding));
    precise float16_t corrected = total - correction;
    total = corrected;
  }
  const float reciprocal = roundF16(1.0 / float(total));   // bit-level: float(float16_t(x)) is elided by the compiler
  // Output: value accumulators staged in words 4..7, times the reciprocal in f32, rounded to half, E4.
  [[unroll]] for (uint cTile = 0u; cTile < 2u; ++cTile)
    coopMatStore(mo[cTile], priv4, sBase + 4u + cTile * 2u, 9u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
  subgroupSync();
  const uint outToken = queryBlock * 64u + rowBase + lr;
  if (outToken < pc.tokens) {
    uint src = sBase + lr * 9u + 4u + hh * 2u;
    uvec4 w0 = priv4[src], w1 = priv4[src + 1u];
    uvec4 r0, r1;
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) {
      precise vec2 p0 = vec2(unpackFloat2x16(w0[i])) * reciprocal;
      precise vec2 p1 = vec2(unpackFloat2x16(w1[i])) * reciprocal;
      r0[i] = packFloat2x16(f16vec2(p0));
      r1[i] = packFloat2x16(f16vec2(p1));
    }
    attended16[(outToken * pc.channels + head * 32u) / 16u + hh] = quantize16(r0, r1);
  }
}

```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/global_normalize.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Global ViT cosine-attention Q/K normalization.
// One thread per (token, head). Differs from the fused-Swin variant: the pair
// squares are summed in f32 then rounded, and Q carries the sqrt(head_dim)
// and learned per-head scales as three separate half multiplies.
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint tokens;
  uint heads;
  uint channels;        // heads * 32
  uint scaleWordOffset; // per-head f32 learned scale, in words within binding 4
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer Qkv { float16_t qkv[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 4) readonly buffer Aux { uint aux32[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer Normalized { uint8_t normalized[]; };

float16_t treeSum16(float16_t r[16]) {
  precise float16_t s8[8];
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 8u; ++c) s8[c] = r[c] + r[c + 8u];
  precise float16_t s4[4];
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 4u; ++c) s4[c] = s8[c] + s8[c + 4u];
  precise float16_t s2[2];
  s2[0] = s4[0] + s4[2];
  s2[1] = s4[1] + s4[3];
  return s2[0] + s2[1];
}

void main() {
  uint id = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x + gl_GlobalInvocationID.y * 65535u * 256u;
  if (id >= pc.tokens * pc.heads) return;
  uint token = id / pc.heads;
  uint head = id % pc.heads;
  uint base = token * pc.channels * 3u + head * 96u;

  float16_t q[32];
  float16_t k[32];
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 32u; ++c) {
    q[c] = qkv[base + c];
    k[c] = qkv[base + 32u + c];
  }
  float16_t r[16];
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 16u; ++c) {
    precise float16_t highSquare = q[c + 16u] * q[c + 16u];
    precise float sum = float(q[c]) * float(q[c]) + float(highSquare);
    r[c] = float16_t(sum);
  }
  float16_t qSum = treeSum16(r);
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 16u; ++c) {
    precise float16_t highSquare = k[c + 16u] * k[c + 16u];
    precise float sum = float(k[c]) * float(k[c]) + float(highSquare);
    r[c] = float16_t(sum);
  }
  float16_t kSum = treeSum16(r);
  float16_t qNorm = float16_t(inversesqrt(float(qSum)));
  float16_t kNorm = float16_t(inversesqrt(float(kSum)));
  float16_t learnedScale = float16_t(uintBitsToFloat(aux32[pc.scaleWordOffset + head]));
  float16_t headScale = float16_t(sqrt(32.0));
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 32u; ++c) {
    precise float16_t nq0 = q[c] * qNorm;
    precise float16_t nq1 = nq0 * headScale;
    precise float16_t nq2 = nq1 * learnedScale;
    precise float16_t nk = k[c] * kNorm;
    normalized[base + c] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(nq2)));
    normalized[base + 32u + c] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(nk)));
    normalized[base + 64u + c] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(qkv[base + 64u + c])));
  }
}
```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/ops.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Elementwise tensor operations of the NR graph, selected by MODE.
// v2: one thread per eight consecutive channels of one pixel (16-byte f16 and
// 8-byte E4M3 accesses, packed hardware conversions); every half rounding is
// the bit-level roundF16 or a packed 16-bit conversion, never float(float16_t()).
#extension GL_EXT_float_e4m3 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_EXT_control_flow_attributes : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#define DLSS_E4M3_HW 1
#include "common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint MODE = 0;
const uint MODE_F32_TO_F16 = 0u;        // input features -> f16 A operand
const uint MODE_QUANTIZE = 1u;          // f16 -> E4M3
const uint MODE_DOWNSAMPLE_FP8 = 2u;    // raw f16 2x box pool -> E4M3
const uint MODE_POST_BLEND = 3u;        // 2x upsample E4 * scale + adapter E4 * scale -> f16 raw + E4M3
const uint MODE_UPSAMPLE_RESIDUAL = 4u; // f16 projection (low res) + E4 skip * scale -> E4M3 (+ f16 raw)

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint count;        // output elements (multiple of 8)
  uint channels;     // multiple of 8
  uint inWidth;
  uint inHeight;
  uint outWidth;
  uint outHeight;
  uint auxOffsetA;   // half units in binding 4
  uint auxOffsetB;
  uint dual;         // also publish f16 raw output (binding 6)
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer In32 { vec4 in32x4[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer In16 { uvec4 in16x8[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 2) readonly buffer In8 { uvec2 in8x8[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 3) readonly buffer Skip8 { uvec2 skip8x8[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 4) readonly buffer Aux { uint16_t aux16[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer Out8 { uvec2 out8x8[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 6) writeonly buffer Out16 { uvec4 out16x8[]; };

// Eight scale halves as f32 (aux offsets are not 16-byte aligned in general).
void auxScales(uint offset, uint channel, out float s[8]) {
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) s[i] = float(uint16BitsToFloat16(aux16[offset + channel + i]));
}

void unpack8(uvec4 words, out float v[8]) {
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) { vec2 p = vec2(unpackFloat2x16(words[i])); v[2u * i] = p.x; v[2u * i + 1u] = p.y; }
}

void unpackE4x8(uvec2 codes, out float v[8]) {
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) v[i] = e4m3HwToF32((codes[i >> 2u] >> ((i & 3u) * 8u)) & 0xffu);
}

// f32 values already rounded to half -> packed halves (exact) and E4M3 codes.
uvec4 packHalves8(float v[8]) {
  uvec4 w;
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) w[i] = packFloat2x16(f16vec2(v[2u * i], v[2u * i + 1u]));
  return w;
}
uvec2 quantize8(uvec4 halves) {
  return uvec2(uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(halves.x))) | (uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(halves.y))) << 16u),
               uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(halves.z))) | (uint(e4m3HwPair(unpackFloat2x16(halves.w))) << 16u));
}

void main() {
  uint group = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x + gl_GlobalInvocationID.y * 65535u * 256u;   // 8-channel group
  if (group * 8u >= pc.count) return;
  const uint groupsPerPixel = pc.channels / 8u;
  const uint c = (group % groupsPerPixel) * 8u;
  const uint pixel = group / groupsPerPixel;
  if (MODE == MODE_F32_TO_F16) {
    vec4 a = in32x4[group * 2u], b = in32x4[group * 2u + 1u];
    out16x8[group] = uvec4(packFloat2x16(f16vec2(a.xy)), packFloat2x16(f16vec2(a.zw)), packFloat2x16(f16vec2(b.xy)),
                           packFloat2x16(f16vec2(b.zw)));
  } else if (MODE == MODE_QUANTIZE) {
    out8x8[group] = quantize8(in16x8[group]);
  } else if (MODE == MODE_DOWNSAMPLE_FP8) {
    uint ox = pixel % pc.outWidth, oy = pixel / pc.outWidth;
    uint sx = ox * 2u, sy = oy * 2u;
    uvec4 result = uvec4(0u);
    if (sx + 1u < pc.inWidth && sy + 1u < pc.inHeight) {
      // The 2x2 pool: three add.f16x2 as (a+b)+(c+d), one mul.f16x2 by
      // 0.25, then cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3. Every intermediate is a half.
      uint i00 = ((sy * pc.inWidth + sx) * pc.channels + c) / 8u;
      uint i10 = ((sy * pc.inWidth + sx + 1u) * pc.channels + c) / 8u;
      uint i01 = (((sy + 1u) * pc.inWidth + sx) * pc.channels + c) / 8u;
      uint i11 = (((sy + 1u) * pc.inWidth + sx + 1u) * pc.channels + c) / 8u;
      uvec4 w00 = in16x8[i00], w10 = in16x8[i10], w01 = in16x8[i01], w11 = in16x8[i11];
      [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; ++i) {
        precise f16vec2 top = unpackFloat2x16(w00[i]) + unpackFloat2x16(w10[i]);
        precise f16vec2 bottom = unpackFloat2x16(w01[i]) + unpackFloat2x16(w11[i]);
        precise f16vec2 sum = top + bottom;
        precise f16vec2 value = sum * float16_t(0.25);
        result[i] = packFloat2x16(value);
      }
    }
    out8x8[group] = quantize8(result);
  } else if (MODE == MODE_POST_BLEND) {
    uint ox = pixel % pc.outWidth, oy = pixel / pc.outWidth;
    uint source = ((oy >> 1u) * pc.inWidth + (ox >> 1u)) * pc.channels + c;
    float up[8], adapter[8], scaleA[8], scaleB[8], raw[8];
    unpackE4x8(in8x8[source / 8u], up);
    unpackE4x8(skip8x8[group], adapter);
    auxScales(pc.auxOffsetA, c, scaleA);
    auxScales(pc.auxOffsetB, c, scaleB);
    // learned_post_blend: mul.f16x2, mul.f16x2, add.f16x2 with the adapter
    // product contracted into the final add before its half rounding.
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) {
      precise float inputValue = roundF16(up[i] * scaleA[i]);
      precise float value = inputValue + adapter[i] * scaleB[i];
      raw[i] = roundF16(value);
    }
    uvec4 halves = packHalves8(raw);
    out16x8[group] = halves;
    out8x8[group] = quantize8(halves);
  } else if (MODE == MODE_UPSAMPLE_RESIDUAL) {
    uint ox = pixel % pc.outWidth, oy = pixel / pc.outWidth;
    uint source = ((oy >> 1u) * pc.inWidth + (ox >> 1u)) * pc.channels + c;
    float projected[8], skip[8], scale[8], value[8];
    unpack8(in16x8[source / 8u], projected);
    unpackE4x8(skip8x8[group], skip);
    auxScales(pc.auxOffsetA, c, scale);
    // residualAfterMatmul + scaleResidual: round_f16(value + residual * scale).
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) {
      precise float sum = projected[i] + skip[i] * scale[i];
      value[i] = roundF16(sum);
    }
    uvec4 halves = packHalves8(value);
    out8x8[group] = quantize8(halves);
    if (pc.dual != 0u) out16x8[group] = halves;
  }
}

```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/preprocess.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Input feature generation. Sixteen f32 lanes per padded pixel:
// three Box-Muller Gaussian lanes evaluated with the GPU's approximate f32
// transcendentals, constant 1, the centered proxy
// color twice (the second copy is the history when temporal input is valid),
// and the five conditioning lanes.
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 8, local_size_y = 8) in;

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint fullWidth;
  uint fullHeight;
  uint validWidth;
  uint validHeight;
  uint sourceWidth;
  uint sourceHeight;
  uint seed;
  float autoMask;        // > 0 enables the auto-mask lane pair
  float localTone;
  float localStructure;
  float skinStructure;
  float style;
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer Source { vec4 proxy[]; };   // RGBA f32 proxy code values
layout(std430, binding = 7) writeonly buffer Features { float features[]; };

float hashUniform(uint value) {
  uint mixed = value;
  mixed = (mixed >> ((mixed >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ mixed;
  mixed *= 0x108ef2d9u;
  uint integer = ((mixed >> 30u) ^ (mixed >> 8u)) + 1u;
  return float(integer) * uintBitsToFloat(0x33800000u);
}

// Scalar form of the network's Box-Muller sequence (instruction order preserved:
// the approximate transcendentals make it order dependent).
vec3 gaussian3(uint x, uint y, uint seed) {
  uint base = (x * 0x8da6b343u) ^ (seed * 0x9e3779b9u) ^ (y * 0xd8163841u) ^ 0x243f6a88u;
  base = (base >> ((base >> 28u) + 4u)) ^ base;
  base *= 0x108ef2d9u;
  base = (base >> 22u) ^ base;
  float u0 = hashUniform(base * 0x2c9277b5u + 0xac564b05u);
  float u1 = hashUniform(base * 0xfa6dc5f9u + 0x4712a88eu);
  float u2 = hashUniform(base * 0xcaa5b80du + 0x21dd796bu);
  float u3 = hashUniform(base * 0x83232c31u + 0x3463e0acu);
  float radius0 = sqrt(log2(u0) * uintBitsToFloat(0x3f317218u) * -2.0);
  float radius1 = sqrt(log2(u2) * uintBitsToFloat(0x3f317218u) * -2.0);
  float angle0 = u1 * uintBitsToFloat(0x40c90fdbu);
  float angle1 = u3 * uintBitsToFloat(0x40c90fdbu);
  return vec3(roundF16(radius0 * cos(angle0)), roundF16(radius0 * sin(angle0)), roundF16(radius1 * cos(angle1)));
}

void main() {
  uvec2 id = gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy;
  if (id.x >= pc.fullWidth || id.y >= pc.fullHeight) return;
  // Coordinates outside the valid image are mirrored, while the noise channels still hash the original
  // padded coordinate.
  uint sourceX = id.x < pc.validWidth ? id.x : 2u * pc.validWidth - id.x - 2u;
  uint sourceY = id.y < pc.validHeight ? id.y : 2u * pc.validHeight - id.y - 2u;
  uint imageX = ((2u * sourceX + 1u) * pc.sourceWidth) / (2u * pc.validWidth);
  uint imageY = ((2u * sourceY + 1u) * pc.sourceHeight) / (2u * pc.validHeight);
  vec4 rgba = proxy[imageY * pc.sourceWidth + imageX];
  // Native: texture sample -> cvt.rn.f16, sub.f16(0.5), mul.f16(0.125).
  float r = roundF16(roundF16(roundF16(rgba.r) - 0.5) * 0.125);
  float g = roundF16(roundF16(roundF16(rgba.g) - 0.5) * 0.125);
  float b = roundF16(roundF16(roundF16(rgba.b) - 0.5) * 0.125);
  vec3 noise = gaussian3(id.x, id.y, pc.seed);
  uint base = (id.y * pc.fullWidth + id.x) * 16u;
  features[base + 0u] = noise.x;
  features[base + 1u] = noise.y;
  features[base + 2u] = noise.z;
  features[base + 3u] = 1.0;
  features[base + 4u] = r;
  features[base + 5u] = g;
  features[base + 6u] = b;
  features[base + 7u] = r;
  features[base + 8u] = g;
  features[base + 9u] = b;
  features[base + 10u] = pc.style / 128.0;
  features[base + 11u] = roundF16(pc.localTone);
  features[base + 12u] = roundF16(pc.autoMask > 0.0 ? 1.0 : pc.localStructure);
  features[base + 13u] = roundF16(pc.autoMask > 0.0 ? (pc.skinStructure < 0.0 ? pc.localStructure : pc.skinStructure) : -1.0);
  features[base + 14u] = roundF16(pc.autoMask > 0.0 ? pc.localStructure : -1.0);
  features[base + 15u] = 0.0;
}
```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/publish.glsl`:

```glsl
// Accumulator publication helpers (fragment level). The coopmat2 tensor stores and the plain
// coopMatStore of 8-bit accumulators to global memory compile to scattered narrow stores that
// cost ~8000 SM cycles per 16x32 tile (measured in gemm_mlp); these macros assemble the row tile in
// shared memory as 32-bit words and store whole 16-byte words.
//
// Accumulator layout (verified on Ada): lane (g = l>>2, t = l&3) holds rows g and
// g+8; element j of a row half is column 8*(j>>1) + 2t + (j&1). Requires GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_shuffle.
#ifndef DLSS_PUBLISH_GLSL
#define DLSS_PUBLISH_GLSL

// E4 codes of a NaN-free pair: the saturating hardware conversion (= common.glsl e4m3HwPair without the NaN
// guard, for accumulators whose NaNs the caller has already removed).
uint16_t e4m3PairFast(f16vec2 value) {
  fe4m3vec2 converted;
  saturatedConvertEXT(converted, value);
  u8vec2 codes = floate4m3BitsToUintEXT(converted);
  return uint16_t(uint(codes.x) | (uint(codes.y) << 8u));
}

// 16 x N f16 accumulator `acc` -> E4 row tile of N/4 32-bit words per row in `words32` at `base`
// (NaN -> 0). Lanes t, t^1 exchange one pair per column group so the even lane assembles the word of
// row g and the odd lane that of row g+8. Follow with subgroupBarrier() before reading the tile.
#define PUBLISH_E4_TILE(acc, N, words32, base, g, t)                                                   \
  {                                                                                                    \
    [[unroll]] for (uint j = 0u; j < (N) / 8u; ++j) {                                                  \
      f16vec2 v0 = f16vec2(acc[2u * j], acc[2u * j + 1u]);                                             \
      f16vec2 v1 = f16vec2(acc[(N) / 4u + 2u * j], acc[(N) / 4u + 2u * j + 1u]);                       \
      uint c0 = uint(e4m3PairFast(mix(v0, f16vec2(0.0), isnan(v0))));                                  \
      uint c1 = uint(e4m3PairFast(mix(v1, f16vec2(0.0), isnan(v1))));                                  \
      bool odd = ((t) & 1u) != 0u;                                                                     \
      uint recv = subgroupShuffleXor(odd ? c0 : c1, 1u);                                               \
      uint word = odd ? (recv | (c1 << 16u)) : (c0 | (recv << 16u));                                   \
      uint row = odd ? (g) + 8u : (g);                                                                 \
      words32[(base) + row * ((N) / 4u) + 2u * j + ((t) >> 1u)] = word;                                \
    }                                                                                                  \
  }

// 16 x N f16 accumulator -> f16 row tile of N/2 32-bit words per row (pairs are already words).
#define PUBLISH_F16_TILE(acc, N, words32, base, g, t)                                                  \
  {                                                                                                    \
    [[unroll]] for (uint h = 0u; h < 2u; ++h) {                                                        \
      [[unroll]] for (uint j = 0u; j < (N) / 8u; ++j) {                                                \
        words32[(base) + ((g) + 8u * h) * ((N) / 2u) + 4u * j + (t)] =                                 \
            packFloat2x16(f16vec2(acc[(N) / 4u * h + 2u * j], acc[(N) / 4u * h + 2u * j + 1u]));       \
      }                                                                                                \
    }                                                                                                  \
  }

#endif

```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/qkv_attention.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Fused QKV projection + cosine normalization + 8x8 window attention for one
// (window, head): replaces the raw-half QKV GEMM (whose f16 output round trip
// through memory was the largest activation traffic of the multi-head stages)
// and window_attention_fused.comp.
//
// (fragment level, VK_NV_cooperative_matrix2): the window's token rows of the
// E4 FFN publication come straight from the image tensor per k32 step (constant
// clamping zeroes tokens outside the image); the head's 96 weight columns are
// staged in shared memory once per step (double buffered, one barrier); q, k, v
// accumulate as three 16x32 fragments; normalization and the specified softmax run
// on the accumulator elements (see fused_block32.comp for the layout argument);
// K/V rows are the only per-window shared data.
#extension GL_EXT_float_e4m3 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_KHR_memory_scope_semantics : require
#extension GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix : require
#extension GL_NV_cooperative_matrix2 : require
#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_basic : require
#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_shuffle : require
#extension GL_EXT_control_flow_attributes : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#define DLSS_E4M3_HW 1
#include "common.glsl"
#include "publish.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 128) in;   // four subgroups, one 16-token row tile of the window each
const uint THREADS = 128u;

layout(constant_id = 0) const uint K = 64;   // channels = heads * 32

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint width;
  uint height;
  uint channels;      // heads * 32 (= K)
  uint heads;
  uint shiftX;
  uint shiftY;
  uint windowsX;
  uint windowCount;
  uint scaleWordOffset;  // per-head f32 learned scales (words in binding 4)
  uint Nmatrix;          // 3 * channels: weight columns per k32 tile
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer Input { uvec4 in4[]; };          // E4 [tokens][channels] as 16-byte words
layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer Weights { uvec4 w4[]; };         // E4 [K/32][Nmatrix][32], head-major columns
layout(std430, binding = 2) readonly buffer Prior { float16_t prior[]; };    // [heads][64][64] f16
layout(std430, binding = 4) readonly buffer Aux { uint aux32[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer Attended { uvec4 attended16[]; };  // E4 [tokens][channels] as 16-byte words


// Shared (18.5 KB): one K=64 chunk of operands - A [64 tokens][64 k] E4 (256 words) and the head's 96 weight
// columns re-laid out n-major [96 n][64 k] (384 words); kv16: Kp [64][32] then Vp [64][32] E4.
shared uvec4 stage[64 * 5 + 96 * 5];   // 5-word (80-byte) rows: bank-conflict-free fragment loads
shared uint16_t kv16[2048];
shared uint tile32[4 * 16 * 8];          // per subgroup: the attended row tile as 32-bit words [16 rows][8]

#define ACC16x32 coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 32, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>
#define ACC16x64 coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 64, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>
#define A16x32 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 32, gl_MatrixUseA>
#define A16x64 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 64, gl_MatrixUseA>
#define B32x32 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 32, 32, gl_MatrixUseB>
#define B64x32k coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 64, 32, gl_MatrixUseB>
#define B32x64 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 32, 64, gl_MatrixUseB>
#define B64x32 coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 64, 32, gl_MatrixUseB>

uint tiledToken(uint token) {  // natural -> physical
  uint x = token & 7u, y = token >> 3u;
  return (y >> 2u) * 32u + (x >> 2u) * 16u + (y & 3u) * 4u + (x & 3u);
}

uint expWeightPair(uint scoreBits) {
  precise vec2 affine32 = fma(vec2(unpackFloat2x16(scoreBits)), vec2(0.044921875), vec2(1.30078125));
  f16vec2 affine = clamp(f16vec2(affine32), f16vec2(1.03125), f16vec2(1.5693359375));
  return ((packFloat2x16(affine) << 5u) & 0xffe0ffe0u) ^ 0x80008000u;
}

float16_t nanToZero(const in uint row, const in uint col, const in float16_t value) { return isnan(value) ? float16_t(0.0) : value; }

// Cosine normalization in the accumulator layout (reference association order; see fused_block32.comp).
void normalizeInPlace(inout ACC16x32 m, const in float16_t scale, const in bool applyScale) {
  [[unroll]] for (uint h = 0u; h < 2u; ++h) {
    const uint b = 8u * h;
    f16vec2 p0 = f16vec2(m[b + 0u], m[b + 1u]), p1 = f16vec2(m[b + 2u], m[b + 3u]);
    f16vec2 p2 = f16vec2(m[b + 4u], m[b + 5u]), p3 = f16vec2(m[b + 6u], m[b + 7u]);
    precise f16vec2 hs0 = p2 * p2;
    precise f16vec2 r0 = fma(p0, p0, hs0);
    precise f16vec2 hs1 = p3 * p3;
    precise f16vec2 r1 = fma(p1, p1, hs1);
    precise f16vec2 s8 = r0 + r1;
    f16vec2 s8o = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffleXor(packFloat2x16(s8), 2u));
    precise f16vec2 s4 = s8 + s8o;
    f16vec2 s4o = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffleXor(packFloat2x16(s4), 1u));
    precise f16vec2 s2 = s4 + s4o;
    precise float16_t s1 = s2.x + s2.y;
    float16_t norm = float16_t(inversesqrt(float(s1)));
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < 8u; ++i) {
      precise float16_t n = m[b + i] * norm;
      float16_t value = n;
      if (applyScale) { precise float16_t ns = n * scale; value = ns; }
      m[b + i] = isnan(value) ? float16_t(0.0) : value;
    }
  }
}

void publishRows(const in ACC16x32 m, const in uint slotBase, const in uint rowBase, const in uint t, const in uint g,
                 const in int windowX, const in int windowY) {
  [[unroll]] for (uint h = 0u; h < 2u; ++h) {
    uint token = rowBase + g + 8u * h;
    int x = windowX + int(token & 7u), y = windowY + int(token >> 3u);
    bool valid = x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < int(pc.width) && y < int(pc.height);
    uint row = slotBase + tiledToken(token) * 16u;
    [[unroll]] for (uint j = 0u; j < 4u; ++j) {
      uint16_t codes = e4m3HwPair(f16vec2(m[8u * h + 2u * j], m[8u * h + 2u * j + 1u]));
      kv16[row + 4u * j + t] = valid ? codes : uint16_t(0u);
    }
  }
}

void main() {
  const uint thread = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
  const uint q = gl_SubgroupID;                   // row tile: tokens 16q .. 16q + 15
  const uint lane = gl_SubgroupInvocationID;
  const uint g = lane >> 2u, t = lane & 3u;
  const uint head = gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  const uint window = gl_WorkGroupID.y + gl_WorkGroupID.z * 65535u;
  if (window >= pc.windowCount) return;
  const int windowX = int((window % pc.windowsX) * 8u) - int(pc.shiftX);
  const int windowY = int((window / pc.windowsX) * 8u) - int(pc.shiftY);
  const uint rowBase = q * 16u;
  const uint KP = 0u, VP = 1024u;

  // Image tensor [height][width][channels] E4; this subgroup's 16 tokens are rows windowY + 2q.. (+2), pixels windowX.. (+8).
  tensorLayoutNV<3, gl_CooperativeMatrixClampModeConstantNV> image = createTensorLayoutNV(3, gl_CooperativeMatrixClampModeConstantNV);
  image = setTensorLayoutDimensionNV(image, pc.height, pc.width, pc.channels);
  image = setTensorLayoutStrideNV(image, pc.width * pc.channels, pc.channels, 1);

  // The attention prior (learned 64x64 bias per head) and the head scale: independent loads issued first.
  ACC16x64 s;
  coopMatLoad(s, prior, head * 4096u + rowBase * 64u, 64u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
  const float16_t scale = float16_t(uintBitsToFloat(aux32[pc.scaleWordOffset + head]));

  // ---- q, k, v projections in K = 64 chunks; A rows gathered by token (zero outside the image) and the
  // head's 96 weight columns (re-laid out n-major) staged per chunk with plain 16-byte loads.
  ACC16x32 qa = ACC16x32(0.0), ka = ACC16x32(0.0), va = ACC16x32(0.0);
  const uint bColumnBase = head * 96u;
  const uint chunks = K / 64u;
  const uint rowWords = K / 16u;
  // Staging words per thread: A word idx < 256 -> token idx >> 2, word idx & 3 of the 64-byte chunk row (zero
  // outside the image); B word idx < 384 -> n = idx >> 2, word w = idx & 3: source word (chunk * 2 + (w >> 1)) *
  // Nmatrix * 2 + (bColumnBase + n) * 2 + (w & 1), destination 320 + n * 5 + w.
  const uint A_PER = (256u + THREADS - 1u) / THREADS, B_PER = (384u + THREADS - 1u) / THREADS;
  uint aSrc[A_PER], aDst[A_PER]; bool aValid[A_PER];
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < A_PER; ++i) {
    uint idx = thread + THREADS * i;
    uint token = (idx >> 2u) & 63u, w = idx & 3u;
    int xA = windowX + int(token & 7u), yA = windowY + int(token >> 3u);
    aValid[i] = idx < 256u && xA >= 0 && yA >= 0 && xA < int(pc.width) && yA < int(pc.height);
    aSrc[i] = aValid[i] ? (uint(yA) * pc.width + uint(xA)) * rowWords + w : 0u;
    aDst[i] = token * 5u + w;
  }
  uint bSrc[B_PER], bDst[B_PER];
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < B_PER; ++i) {
    uint idx = min(thread + THREADS * i, 383u);
    uint n = idx >> 2u, w = idx & 3u;
    bSrc[i] = (w >> 1u) * pc.Nmatrix * 2u + (bColumnBase + n) * 2u + (w & 1u);
    bDst[i] = 320u + n * 5u + w;
  }
  // One chunk of operands prefetched into registers: the next chunk's loads are issued before this chunk's
  // barrier and multiplies, so the L2 latency overlaps them.
  uvec4 ra[A_PER], rb[B_PER];
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < A_PER; ++i) ra[i] = aValid[i] ? in4[aSrc[i]] : uvec4(0u);
  [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < B_PER; ++i) rb[i] = w4[bSrc[i]];
  for (uint c = 0u; c < chunks; ++c) {
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < A_PER; ++i) if (thread + THREADS * i < 256u) stage[aDst[i]] = ra[i];
    [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < B_PER; ++i) if (thread + THREADS * i < 384u) stage[bDst[i]] = rb[i];
    if (c + 1u < chunks) {
      [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < A_PER; ++i) ra[i] = aValid[i] ? in4[aSrc[i] + (c + 1u) * 4u] : uvec4(0u);
      [[unroll]] for (uint i = 0u; i < B_PER; ++i) rb[i] = w4[bSrc[i] + (c + 1u) * 2u * pc.Nmatrix * 2u];
    }
    barrier();
    A16x64 a; coopMatLoad(a, stage, rowBase * 5u, 5u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
    B64x32k wq; coopMatLoad(wq, stage, 320u, 5u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);             // n 0..31 (q)
    B64x32k wk; coopMatLoad(wk, stage, 320u + 32u * 5u, 5u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);  // n 32..63 (k)
    B64x32k wv; coopMatLoad(wv, stage, 320u + 64u * 5u, 5u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);  // n 64..95 (v)
    qa = coopMatMulAdd(a, wq, qa);
    ka = coopMatMulAdd(a, wk, ka);
    va = coopMatMulAdd(a, wv, va);
    barrier();   // fragment loads done before the next chunk overwrites the stage
  }
  normalizeInPlace(qa, scale, true);
  normalizeInPlace(ka, scale, false);
  A16x32 mq = A16x32(qa);
  publishRows(ka, KP, rowBase, t, g, windowX, windowY);
  publishRows(va, VP, rowBase, t, g, windowX, windowY);
  barrier();

  // ---- Attention in registers.
  B32x64 kp; coopMatLoad(kp, kv16, KP, 16u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);
  s = coopMatMulAdd(mq, kp, s);
  ACC16x64 wAcc = ACC16x64(0.0);
  [[unroll]] for (uint h = 0u; h < 2u; ++h) {
    uint e[8];
    [[unroll]] for (uint m = 0u; m < 8u; ++m) e[m] = expWeightPair(packFloat2x16(f16vec2(s[16u * h + 2u * m], s[16u * h + 2u * m + 1u])));
    f16vec2 bp[4];
    [[unroll]] for (uint j = 0u; j < 4u; ++j) { precise f16vec2 bsum = unpackFloat2x16(e[2u * j]) + unpackFloat2x16(e[2u * j + 1u]); bp[j] = bsum; }
    precise f16vec2 t01 = bp[0] + bp[1];
    precise f16vec2 t012 = t01 + bp[2];
    precise f16vec2 tp = t012 + bp[3];
    uint tpBits = packFloat2x16(tp);
    uint quad = lane & ~3u;
    f16vec2 t0 = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffle(tpBits, quad)), t1 = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffle(tpBits, quad + 1u));
    f16vec2 t2 = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffle(tpBits, quad + 2u)), t3 = unpackFloat2x16(subgroupShuffle(tpBits, quad + 3u));
    precise float16_t e01 = t0.x + t1.x;
    precise float16_t e012 = e01 + t2.x;
    precise float16_t even = e012 + t3.x;
    precise float16_t o01 = t0.y + t1.y;
    precise float16_t o012 = o01 + t2.y;
    precise float16_t odd = o012 + t3.y;
    precise float16_t total = even + odd;
    float16_t reciprocal = float16_t(1.0 / float(total));
    [[unroll]] for (uint m = 0u; m < 8u; ++m) {
      precise f16vec2 w = unpackFloat2x16(e[m]) * reciprocal;
      wAcc[16u * h + 2u * m] = w.x;
      wAcc[16u * h + 2u * m + 1u] = w.y;
    }
  }
  A16x64 p = A16x64(wAcc);
  B64x32 vp; coopMatLoad(vp, kv16, VP, 16u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
  ACC16x32 o = ACC16x32(0.0);
  o = coopMatMulAdd(p, vp, o);
  {
    // 16 tokens x 32 E4: the tile as 32-bit words in shared memory, then one 16-byte word per lane.
    const uint tileBase = q * 128u;
    PUBLISH_E4_TILE(o, 32u, tile32, tileBase, g, t)
    subgroupBarrier();
    const uint r = lane >> 1u, part = lane & 1u;
    const uint tok = rowBase + r;
    const int x = windowX + int(tok & 7u), y = windowY + int(tok >> 3u);
    const uint base = tileBase + r * 8u + part * 4u;
    if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < int(pc.width) && y < int(pc.height))
      attended16[(uint(y) * pc.width + uint(x)) * (pc.channels / 16u) + head * 2u + part] =
          uvec4(tile32[base], tile32[base + 1u], tile32[base + 2u], tile32[base + 3u]);
  }
}

```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/window_attend.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Fused 8x8 window cosine attention (exact Ada FP8 MMA, tiled 4x4 token order for the
// learned prior and the value MMA, the network's softmax reduction order).
//
// One workgroup = one (window, head). Four subgroups.
//   S = Q K^T + prior          16 MMAs (16x16x32, C = learned prior tile)
//   w = expWeight(S)          per element, FP16 bit approximation
//   p = fp8(w * f16(1/sum))    the specified softmax order, E4M3 weights
//   O = p V                    16 MMAs (16x16x32, two k32 steps over 64 keys)
// Keys are kept in physical (tiled) order p = tile*16 + within so the
// prior, the softmax tree and the value K dimension all index the same way.
#extension GL_EXT_float_e4m3 : require
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_KHR_memory_scope_semantics : require
#extension GL_KHR_cooperative_matrix : require
#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_basic : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 128) in;

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint width;
  uint height;
  uint channels;   // heads * 32
  uint heads;
  uint shiftX;     // window origin offset (0 or 4)
  uint shiftY;
  uint windowsX;   // ceil((width + shiftX) / 8)
  uint windowCount;
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 0) readonly buffer Normalized { uint8_t qkv[]; };  // E4M3 [tokens][channels*3]
layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer Prior { float16_t prior[]; };   // [heads][64 query][64 physical key]
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer Attended { uint8_t attended[]; }; // E4M3 [tokens][channels]

shared uint8_t qs[64 * 32];      // [query][component]
shared uint8_t ks[64 * 32];      // [physical key][component]
shared uint8_t vs[64 * 32];      // [physical key][component]
shared float16_t priors[64 * 64];
shared float16_t scores[64 * 64]; // [query][physical key]
shared uint8_t weights[64 * 64];  // E4M3 [query][physical key]
shared float16_t outputs[64 * 32];

uint inverseTiledToken(uint token) {
  uint tile = token >> 4u, within = token & 15u;
  uint x = (tile & 1u) * 4u + (within & 3u);
  uint y = (tile >> 1u) * 4u + (within >> 2u);
  return y * 8u + x;
}

// the exponential approximation: packed FP16 affine + exponent-field remap (the network's exponential approximation).
float16_t expWeight(float16_t score) {
  precise float affine32 = fma(float(score), 0.044921875, 1.30078125);
  float16_t affine = clamp(float16_t(affine32), float16_t(1.03125), float16_t(1.5693359375));
  uint bits = f16Bits(affine);
  uint exponentialBits = ((bits << 5u) + 0x8000u) & 0xffffu;
  return f16FromBits(exponentialBits);
}

// the specified softmax reduction (keys in physical order): eight 8-key fragments reduced
// per lane pair, then the four column pairs, then even/odd halves.
float16_t softmaxPair(uint row, uint pair, uint parity) {
  uint key = pair * 2u + parity;
  precise float16_t blocks01 = scores[row * 64u + key] + scores[row * 64u + key + 8u];
  precise float16_t blocks23 = scores[row * 64u + key + 16u] + scores[row * 64u + key + 24u];
  precise float16_t blocks45 = scores[row * 64u + key + 32u] + scores[row * 64u + key + 40u];
  precise float16_t blocks67 = scores[row * 64u + key + 48u] + scores[row * 64u + key + 56u];
  precise float16_t a = blocks01 + blocks23;
  precise float16_t b = a + blocks45;
  return b + blocks67;
}

float16_t softmaxSum(uint row) {
  precise float16_t e0 = softmaxPair(row, 0u, 0u) + softmaxPair(row, 1u, 0u);
  precise float16_t e1 = e0 + softmaxPair(row, 2u, 0u);
  precise float16_t even = e1 + softmaxPair(row, 3u, 0u);
  precise float16_t o0 = softmaxPair(row, 0u, 1u) + softmaxPair(row, 1u, 1u);
  precise float16_t o1 = o0 + softmaxPair(row, 2u, 1u);
  precise float16_t odd = o1 + softmaxPair(row, 3u, 1u);
  return even + odd;
}

void main() {
  const uint thread = gl_LocalInvocationID.x;
  const uint subgroup = gl_SubgroupID;
  const uint head = gl_WorkGroupID.x;
  const uint window = gl_WorkGroupID.y + gl_WorkGroupID.z * 65535u;
  if (window >= pc.windowCount) return;
  const int windowX = int((window % pc.windowsX) * 8u) - int(pc.shiftX);
  const int windowY = int((window / pc.windowsX) * 8u) - int(pc.shiftY);
  const uint stride3 = pc.channels * 3u;
  const uint headBase = head * 96u;

  // Stage Q (query order), K/V (physical key order) and the prior.
  for (uint i = thread; i < 64u * 32u; i += 128u) {
    uint token = i >> 5u, component = i & 31u;
    int qx = windowX + int(token & 7u), qy = windowY + int(token >> 3u);
    uint8_t q = uint8_t(0);
    if (qx >= 0 && qy >= 0 && qx < int(pc.width) && qy < int(pc.height)) {
      q = qkv[(uint(qy) * pc.width + uint(qx)) * stride3 + headBase + component];
    }
    qs[i] = q;
    uint keyLocal = inverseTiledToken(token);
    int kx = windowX + int(keyLocal & 7u), ky = windowY + int(keyLocal >> 3u);
    uint8_t k = uint8_t(0), v = uint8_t(0);
    if (kx >= 0 && ky >= 0 && kx < int(pc.width) && ky < int(pc.height)) {
      uint keyBase = (uint(ky) * pc.width + uint(kx)) * stride3 + headBase;
      k = qkv[keyBase + 32u + component];
      v = qkv[keyBase + 64u + component];
    }
    ks[i] = k;
    vs[i] = v;
  }
  for (uint i = thread; i < 64u * 64u; i += 128u) priors[i] = prior[head * 4096u + i];
  barrier();

  // S = Q K^T with the learned prior as the incoming FP16 accumulator.
  for (uint tile = subgroup; tile < 16u; tile += 4u) {
    uint qTile = tile >> 2u, kTile = tile & 3u;
    coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 32, gl_MatrixUseA> ma;
    coopMatLoad(ma, qs, qTile * 16u * 32u, 32u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
    coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 32, 16, gl_MatrixUseB> mb;
    coopMatLoad(mb, ks, kTile * 16u * 32u, 32u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutColumnMajor);
    coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator> mc;
    coopMatLoad(mc, priors, qTile * 16u * 64u + kTile * 16u, 64u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
    mc = coopMatMulAdd(ma, mb, mc);
    coopMatStore(mc, scores, qTile * 16u * 64u + kTile * 16u, 64u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
  }
  barrier();

  // Exponential weights, then the specified reduction, reciprocal and E4M3 publication.
  for (uint i = thread; i < 64u * 64u; i += 128u) scores[i] = expWeight(scores[i]);
  barrier();
  if (thread < 64u) {
    uint row = thread;
    float16_t total = softmaxSum(row);
    float16_t reciprocal = float16_t(1.0 / float(total));
    for (uint key = 0u; key < 64u; ++key) {
      precise float16_t normalized = scores[row * 64u + key] * reciprocal;
      weights[row * 64u + key] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(normalized)));
    }
  }
  barrier();

  // O = P V over the 64 physical keys as two k32 steps (four F13 groups in
  // tile order 0,1,2,3), FP16 accumulation from zero.
  for (uint tile = subgroup; tile < 8u; tile += 4u) {
    uint qTile = tile >> 1u, cTile = tile & 1u;
    coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator> mc =
        coopmat<float16_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 16, gl_MatrixUseAccumulator>(0.0);
    for (uint kb = 0u; kb < 64u; kb += 32u) {
      coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 16, 32, gl_MatrixUseA> ma;
      coopMatLoad(ma, weights, qTile * 16u * 64u + kb, 64u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      coopmat<floate4m3_t, gl_ScopeSubgroup, 32, 16, gl_MatrixUseB> mb;
      coopMatLoad(mb, vs, kb * 32u + cTile * 16u, 32u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
      mc = coopMatMulAdd(ma, mb, mc);
    }
    coopMatStore(mc, outputs, qTile * 16u * 32u + cTile * 16u, 32u, gl_CooperativeMatrixLayoutRowMajor);
  }
  barrier();

  for (uint i = thread; i < 64u * 32u; i += 128u) {
    uint token = i >> 5u, component = i & 31u;
    int qx = windowX + int(token & 7u), qy = windowY + int(token >> 3u);
    if (qx < 0 || qy < 0 || qx >= int(pc.width) || qy >= int(pc.height)) continue;
    uint index = (uint(qy) * pc.width + uint(qx)) * pc.channels + head * 32u + component;
    attended[index] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(outputs[i])));
  }
}
```

`src/vendor/opendlss_nr/shaders/window_normalize.comp`:

```comp
#version 460
// Cosine-attention Q/K normalization for the fused Swin blocks
// (the network's normalization order).
// One thread per (token, head); the square sums use the specified half
// reduction order: fma(low, low, f16(high*high)) for the 16 pairs, then a
// stride 8/4/2/1 tree, every add published as FP16.
#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types : require
#extension GL_GOOGLE_include_directive : require
#include "common.glsl"

layout(local_size_x = 256) in;

layout(push_constant) uniform Push {
  uint tokens;
  uint heads;
  uint channels;        // heads * 32
  uint scaleWordOffset; // per-head f32 learned scale, in 32-bit words within binding 4
} pc;

layout(std430, binding = 1) readonly buffer Qkv { float16_t qkv[]; };   // [tokens][channels*3] raw half
layout(std430, binding = 4) readonly buffer Aux { uint aux32[]; };
layout(std430, binding = 5) writeonly buffer Normalized { uint8_t normalized[]; }; // E4M3 [tokens][channels*3]

float16_t treeSum16(float16_t r[16]) {
  // reduction[c] += reduction[c + stride] for stride 8, 4, 2, 1.
  precise float16_t s8[8];
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 8u; ++c) s8[c] = r[c] + r[c + 8u];
  precise float16_t s4[4];
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 4u; ++c) s4[c] = s8[c] + s8[c + 4u];
  precise float16_t s2[2];
  s2[0] = s4[0] + s4[2];
  s2[1] = s4[1] + s4[3];
  return s2[0] + s2[1];
}

void main() {
  uint id = gl_GlobalInvocationID.x + gl_GlobalInvocationID.y * 65535u * 256u;
  if (id >= pc.tokens * pc.heads) return;
  uint token = id / pc.heads;
  uint head = id % pc.heads;
  // Native fused-Swin QKV weights are head-major: q, k, v of one head are
  // three consecutive 32-channel groups.
  uint base = token * pc.channels * 3u + head * 96u;

  float16_t q[32];
  float16_t k[32];
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 32u; ++c) {
    q[c] = qkv[base + c];
    k[c] = qkv[base + 32u + c];
  }
  float16_t r[16];
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 16u; ++c) {
    precise float16_t highSquare = q[c + 16u] * q[c + 16u];
    r[c] = fma(q[c], q[c], highSquare);
  }
  float16_t qSum = treeSum16(r);
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 16u; ++c) {
    precise float16_t highSquare = k[c + 16u] * k[c + 16u];
    r[c] = fma(k[c], k[c], highSquare);
  }
  float16_t kSum = treeSum16(r);
  float16_t qNorm = float16_t(inversesqrt(float(qSum)));
  float16_t kNorm = float16_t(inversesqrt(float(kSum)));
  float16_t scale = float16_t(uintBitsToFloat(aux32[pc.scaleWordOffset + head]));
  for (uint c = 0u; c < 32u; ++c) {
    precise float16_t nq = q[c] * qNorm;
    precise float16_t nqs = nq * scale;
    precise float16_t nk = k[c] * kNorm;
    normalized[base + c] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(nqs)));
    normalized[base + 32u + c] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(nk)));
    normalized[base + 64u + c] = uint8_t(e4m3CodeFromF16Bits(f16Bits(qkv[base + 64u + c])));
  }
}
```
